65810.recognize_zh: 兩顆兩側嗜中性球之間的大型異型細胞緊貼成對，體積遠大於嗜中性球，核大而圓、染色質細緻，細胞質嗜鹼且周圍帶許多小空泡，形態不符合正常血球，提示周邊血中的循環腫瘤細胞；但僅憑形態無法確定來源。
features: Two large atypical cells in close apposition, each much larger than adjacent neutrophils
Large round-to-oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin and indistinct nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm; one cell surrounded by numerous small clear vacuoles/blebs
Cells appear cohesive rather than scattered individually
Flanking mature neutrophils with segmented nuclei
Normochromic red cells without nucleated red cells in this field
65810.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells and two mature neutrophils flanking a pair of large atypical cells. The atypical cells are closely apposed, with large round-to-oval nuclei, finely granular chromatin, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, one bordered by numerous small clear vacuoles. Their size, cohesion, and cytologic features are not typical of normal leukocytes. Findings are suggestive of circulating tumor cells; morphology alone cannot distinguish a non-hematopoietic malignancy from blasts, so immunophenotyping (flow cytometry or cytospin immunostains) and correlation with the marrow biopsy are required.

ddx.vs: Blasts are typically discohesive single cells with CD45 and lineage-specific markers on flow cytometry, whereas non-hematopoietic tumor cells are CD45 negative and often clustered.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray cytoplasm, and reactive lymphocytes have basophilic skirting, both occurring singly.
Megakaryocytic cells have dense, lobulated nuclei with granular pink cytoplasm and platelet budding.
Endothelial cells appear as elongated cohesive sheets with oval nuclei and bland chromatin, typically at the start of the smear.

65682.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球失去中央淡染區、較緻密，表面伸出長短不一、分布不規則且末端圓鈍的突起，即棘狀紅血球（acanthocytes/spur cells）；要和突起短而規則、仍保有中央淡染的皺縮紅血球（echinocytes）區分，本視野兩者並存。
features: Numerous acanthocytes: dense red cells lacking central pallor with few irregularly spaced projections of variable length, often with knobbed tips
Admixed echinocyte-like cells with more numerous short regular spicules
Occasional teardrop-like and irregularly contracted red cells
No red cell agglutination, schistocytes or parasites in this field
Monocyte with folded nucleus and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm at upper right
65682.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous acanthocytes, dense red cells lacking central pallor with a few irregularly spaced projections of varying length and knob-like ends. Some echinocyte-like cells with shorter, evenly spaced spicules are also present. A monocyte is seen, and no schistocytes or red cell inclusions are identified. In a patient with cirrhosis and hepatosplenomegaly, the prominence of acanthocytes is consistent with spur cell hemolytic anemia of advanced liver disease.

ddx.dx: Echinocytes (burr cells, including drying artifact or uremia)
ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10–30 short, regularly spaced spicules and usually retain central pallor, whereas acanthocytes have fewer irregular projections and are dense.
These inherited disorders produce similar acanthocytes but present with malabsorption, neurologic signs and low lipoproteins rather than cirrhosis.
Distinguished by splenectomy history (with Howell-Jolly bodies) or Kell antigen weakness rather than liver disease.
PK deficiency may show echinocytic spiculated cells after splenectomy but has congenital hemolysis without liver disease and low PK enzyme activity.

exam.answer_en: Spur cell (acanthocytic) hemolytic anemia of advanced liver disease — dense acanthocytes with few irregular knobbed projections
pearls_zh: 考法：指著無中央淡染、突起少而長短不一的紅血球問名稱（acanthocyte/spur cell），再追問與 echinocyte（burr cell）的差別與臨床情境。
機轉：晚期肝硬化時異常脂蛋白使紅血球膜游離膽固醇增加（cholesterol/phospholipid 比例上升），膜變僵硬，經脾臟修飾成 spur cell 並被破壞。
臨床意義：spur cell anemia 出現在末期肝病，代表肝功能極差、預後不良；溶血通常要靠肝臟移植才能根本改善。
其他 acanthocyte 成因：abetalipoproteinemia（MTTP 突變，脂肪吸收不良、低 LDL）、McLeod phenotype（XK 基因，Kell 抗原弱表現）、neuroacanthocytosis、脾切除後。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被誤認為 echinocyte（乾燥假影或尿毒症）：echinocyte 有 10–30 個短而規則、均勻分布的小刺且多保有中央淡染；acanthocyte 緻密、突起少且不規則、末端鈍圓。

quiz.q: 圖中這些緻密、帶有少數不規則長突起的紅血球叫什麼？最常見於哪種成人疾病背景？
quiz.a: Acanthocytes (spur cells)；末期肝硬化的 spur cell hemolytic anemia

65746.recognize_zh: 左圖骨髓抹片中漿細胞的細胞質塞滿大小不一、圓形淡藍色的球狀包涵體（Russell bodies），把核擠到一邊，形成像一串葡萄的 Mott cell；右圖 H&E 切片中亦見細胞質充滿淡染圓形小球的細胞，兩者皆為免疫球蛋白堆積。
features: Panel A: plasma cells whose cytoplasm is filled with numerous round, pale blue, homogeneous globules of varying size (Russell bodies)
Panel A: nuclei compressed and eccentric, with coarse chromatin, giving a grape-cluster (Mott cell) appearance
Panel A: adjacent plasma cells and lymphoid cells without inclusions
Panel B: marrow section with increased plasmacytoid cells and cells distended by multiple pale eosinophilic round globules
Panel B: globules produce a bubbly, vacuolated cytoplasm; nuclei eccentric
65746.describe_en: Composite image. The bone marrow aspirate (A) shows plasma cells whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous round, homogeneous, pale blue globules of varying size that compress the eccentric nucleus, producing Mott cells. The corresponding core biopsy (B) shows an increased plasma cell infiltrate with scattered cells containing multiple pale eosinophilic intracytoplasmic globules. The globules represent Russell bodies formed by accumulated immunoglobulin in the endoplasmic reticulum. Mott cells are not specific for neoplasia; in the setting of increased clonal plasma cells, findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Mott cells also occur in chronic inflammation, but the plasma cells are polytypic by kappa/lambda staining and not markedly increased.
Dutcher bodies are single PAS-positive immunoglobulin pseudoinclusions overlying the nucleus, typical of lymphoplasmacytic or marginal zone lymphoma, rather than multiple cytoplasmic globules.

ddx.dx: Foamy histiocytes or storage cells (Gaucher, Niemann-Pick)
ddx.vs: Storage cells have small central nuclei with wrinkled or finely vacuolated cytoplasm and are CD68 positive, CD138 negative.
Signet ring cells contain mucin (mucicarmine/PAS positive) in a single large vacuole, form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin positive.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma with Mott cells — plasma cells filled with multiple Russell bodies on aspirate (A) and globule-laden plasma cells on biopsy (B)
pearls_zh: 考法：左右對照題，考官問「抽吸片與切片中同一構造分別長怎樣」：抹片中為淡藍圓球，H&E 切片中為淡嗜伊紅性圓球；兩者皆為堆積的免疫球蛋白（Russell bodies）。
Russell bodies 為 PAS 陽性；可用 κ/λ IHC 或 ISH 在切片上顯示輕鏈限制，同時以 CD138 IHC 評估漿細胞比例，避免抹片稀釋造成低估。
Mott cell 本身無診斷性：慢性發炎與反應性漿細胞增多也會出現；診斷 myeloma 仍需克隆性漿細胞 ≥10% 加 myeloma-defining event。
Myeloma 評估必備：SPEP/immunofixation、血清游離輕鏈、鈣、腎功能、全身低劑量 CT 或 PET-CT/MRI，以及 CD138 分選 FISH 風險分層。
exam.pitfall_zh: 切片中易把充滿圓球的漿細胞誤認為泡沫組織球或 signet-ring 癌細胞：前者核小居中、細胞質細空泡；本例為偏心漿細胞核與均質圓球，CD138 與輕鏈 IHC 可確認。

quiz.q: A 圖漿細胞內大量淡藍圓球是什麼成分？在 B 圖 H&E 切片中呈什麼顏色？
quiz.a: Russell bodies（堆積的免疫球蛋白）；淡嗜伊紅性（粉紅）圓球

65554.recognize_zh: 四格 CSF 抹片中，個別細胞的核偏心、細胞質藍色且帶空泡、右下那顆有核旁淡染區與成塊染色質，是漿細胞；CSF 正常不應出現漿細胞，骨髓瘤病人要考慮中樞神經侵犯。
features: Four-panel composite of isolated cells in a sparse CSF cytospin
Cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm
Cytoplasmic vacuolation in several cells
Size variation: larger immature-appearing cells with finer chromatin and a smaller mature plasma cell with clumped chromatin and paranuclear clearing
Clean paucicellular background with rare red cells
65554.describe_en: CSF cytospin (composite of four fields) shows scattered isolated plasma cells in a paucicellular background. The cells have eccentric round nuclei, moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm with vacuoles, and variable maturity, ranging from larger cells with finer chromatin to a small mature-appearing plasma cell with clumped chromatin and paranuclear clearing. No lymphocytes, neutrophils, or macrophages are present in these fields. In a patient with plasma cell myeloma, findings are consistent with CNS involvement by myeloma, ideally confirmed by flow cytometry for clonal plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cells in CSF (infection, demyelinating disease)
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells occur with a lymphocyte-rich pleocytosis and are polytypic, whereas these are isolated atypical plasma cells without an inflammatory background.
Reactive lymphocytes have central nuclei with cytoplasm spreading around them and lack eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear hof.
Macrophages have folded or bean-shaped nuclei, paler gray vacuolated cytoplasm, and often phagocytosed debris rather than deeply basophilic cytoplasm.

65170.recognize_zh: 流式散佈圖中紫色族群落在 CD45 陰性（約 10^0）、側向散射低至中等的區域（gate A），與右側 CD45 陽性的正常造血細胞明顯分開，表示骨髓中有大量非造血細胞。
features: Left plot (FS vs SS): highlighted population with wide forward scatter range and low to intermediate side scatter
Right plot (CD45 vs SS): gated population A is CD45-negative with low to intermediate side scatter
Normal CD45-positive hematopoietic populations (granulocytes with high SS, lymphocytes/monocytes) are displaced to the right in gray
Large proportion of events in the CD45-negative gate, indicating extensive non-hematopoietic infiltration
Lineage cannot be assigned from these scatter/CD45 plots alone
65170.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the bone marrow shows a large population of events that are CD45 negative with low to intermediate side scatter and variable forward scatter (gate A), clearly separated from the CD45-positive normal granulocytic, monocytic, and lymphoid populations. CD45 negativity in this gate indicates non-hematopoietic cells (or, less commonly, CD45-negative hematolymphoid cells such as erythroid precursors or some plasma cells or blasts), so further markers such as CD56 and GD2 are needed for lineage assignment. In the context of the accompanying morphology and CD56-positive staining, findings are consistent with bone marrow infiltration by metastatic neuroblastoma.

ddx.vs: Erythroid precursors are CD45-negative to dim but express CD71 and CD235a and lack bright CD56, and they lie in a lower forward scatter region.
Lymphoblasts may be CD45-negative but express CD19, CD10 and TdT, which neuroblastoma cells lack.

ddx.dx: Other small round blue cell tumors (Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These are also CD45-negative and may express CD56, so separation needs GD2 (neuroblastoma), CD99, or myogenin/desmin by IHC.
Debris shows very low forward scatter and fails viability dye gating, unlike the broad forward scatter distribution of this population.

65234.recognize_zh: 中倍下骨小樑之間的骨髓腔已無造血細胞，被疏鬆纖維化間質取代，其中散布小巢與條索狀的深染上皮腫瘤細胞，符合轉移性癌侵犯骨髓並伴隨纖維化反應。
features: Bony trabeculae with intertrabecular spaces replaced by loose desmoplastic fibrous stroma
Scattered small nests and cords of hyperchromatic epithelial cells within the stroma
Cohesive tumor clusters with nuclear crowding and retraction artifact
Absence of normal hematopoietic elements and fat in this field
Small capillaries and extravasated red cells in the stroma
65234.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate power shows bony trabeculae with intertrabecular marrow space replaced by loose desmoplastic fibrous stroma. Within the stroma are scattered small cohesive nests and cords of hyperchromatic epithelial cells, many surrounded by retraction spaces. Normal hematopoiesis and marrow fat are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma involving the bone marrow with a desmoplastic reaction, in keeping with the known invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast.

ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis shows fibrosis with atypical megakaryocyte clusters and streaming hematopoietic cells, not cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests.
Lobular carcinoma appears as subtle single discohesive cells, E-cadherin negative, rather than cohesive nests and cords.
Hodgkin involvement shows scattered large Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30/CD15-positive) in a mixed inflammatory background rather than epithelial nests.
Morphology cannot establish origin; breast primary is supported by GATA3/ER/HER2 immunostains.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic breast carcinoma in bone marrow — intertrabecular desmoplastic stroma with small nests of hyperchromatic tumor cells
pearls_zh: 考法：中倍問「骨小樑間為何沒有造血與脂肪？」答：轉移癌取代骨髓並伴 desmoplastic reaction。
Invasive lobular carcinoma 常單排散在、E-cadherin 陰性，易被當成淋巴球或漿細胞而漏看；ductal 多成巢、E-cadherin 陽性。
纖維化可用 reticulin／trichrome 評估；轉移癌造成的是 secondary fibrosis，不屬於 MPN。
流式以 CD45 gating 為主，易漏掉非造血腫瘤細胞，轉移癌仍需靠切片與 IHC 確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤診為 primary myelofibrosis；PMF 有群聚異型巨核細胞、無 cytokeratin 陽性細胞巢，且常有 JAK2/CALR/MPL 突變。

quiz.q: 本圖骨小樑間的骨髓腔被什麼取代？
quiz.a: Desmoplastic 纖維間質夾雜轉移癌細胞巢

65298.recognize_zh: 散在的淋巴球比紅血球大一些，細胞質淡藍而量中等，核呈多角形、部分有線狀切跡（cleft），染色質中度凝集、無明顯核仁；比典型 CLL 大且核形不規則，符合 CLL 伴 trisomy 12 的非典型形態。
features: Scattered medium-sized lymphocytes, larger than classic small CLL cells
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with polygonal cell outlines
Angular nuclei, several with linear nuclear clefts
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Normochromic red cells with small platelets; no smudge cells in this field
65298.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased lymphocytes. The cells are small to medium sized with moderate pale cytoplasm, angular nuclei with occasional linear clefts, and moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli. Red cells and platelets are morphologically unremarkable. The findings are consistent with atypical CLL morphology, as seen with trisomy 12, and should be confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Cleaved nuclei overlap with MCL, which is CD23-negative and cyclin D1-positive with t(11;14).
FL cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and deep notches and are CD10+/BCL2+ and CD5-negative.
HCL cells have abundant cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections and an oval to bean-shaped nucleus, and are CD103+/CD25+/CD11c+/annexin A1+.

65106.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 kappa 免疫染色：整片有明顯的背景染色（血清免疫球蛋白），濾泡及其周圍的大細胞未見明確 kappa 強陽性；只有右側濾泡間區一條帶狀的強陽性漿細胞，與 lambda 染色對照可看出濾泡相關漿母細胞為 lambda 偏向。
features: Diffuse moderate background staining of interstitium and follicular dendritic meshwork, limiting interpretation
Concentric follicles (left and center) without distinct strongly kappa-positive large cells
A band of strongly kappa-positive plasma cells in an interfollicular zone on the right
Scattered isolated kappa-positive plasma cells elsewhere
Strongly stained vessel walls/serum within vascular channels
65106.describe_en: Lymph node section immunostained for kappa light chain shows considerable diffuse background staining, including the follicular dendritic cell meshwork of concentrically arranged follicles. No distinct strongly kappa-positive large cells are identified in and around the follicles, where lambda-positive plasmablasts were seen, whereas a band of kappa-positive mature plasma cells is present in one interfollicular area and scattered positive cells occur elsewhere. The title's statement that plasma cells are kappa-negative is therefore only partly reflected, as a subset of interfollicular plasma cells is kappa-positive and the background limits interpretation. Taken with the lambda stain, findings support lambda-predominant follicle-associated plasmablasts, consistent with HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease; kappa/lambda ISH would give cleaner assessment.

ddx.vs: Reactive nodes show roughly twice as many kappa-positive as lambda-positive plasma cells in all compartments, not a lambda-skewed follicle-associated population.
A kappa-restricted process would show sheets of strongly kappa-positive cells with near-absent lambda, the opposite of this case.
Serum immunoglobulin causes diffuse extracellular and FDC staining, so only strong, crisp cytoplasmic staining should be counted, ideally confirmed by ISH.

64978.recognize_zh: 一顆雙核巨噬細胞的細胞質右上方有數個小型卵圓形微生物，中心深染、外圍有清楚透明暈（halo），大小約為血小板等級且位於細胞內，符合被吞噬的莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）酵母形體。
features: Large macrophage with two oval nuclei and abundant pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm with frayed borders
A few small (about 2-4 µm) oval intracellular organisms in the upper cytoplasm
Organisms with a dark crescent-shaped staining center surrounded by a clear halo
No kinetoplast or bar-like structure appreciated; resolution is limited and the image is blurred
Background lymphocytes and crenated red cell aggregates
64978.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate (or smear) shows a large binucleated macrophage with vacuolated cytoplasm containing a few small oval intracellular organisms, each with a darkly staining crescentic center and a surrounding clear halo. The organisms are few in number and the image resolution is limited, so fine detail such as budding or a kinetoplast cannot be assessed. The morphology favors small intracellular yeasts. Findings are consistent with phagocytosed Histoplasma capsulatum; confirmation with GMS/PAS stains, culture or antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a surrounding clear halo, and are GMS-negative.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated with a central transverse septum dividing by fission rather than budding.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic with a central nucleus and no halo, and are GMS-negative.
Platelets are granular purple fragments without a well-defined wall and clear halo.

exam.answer_en: Histoplasma capsulatum in a bone marrow macrophage — small intracellular oval yeasts with a dark crescent center and clear halo
pearls_zh: 考法：指巨噬細胞內 2–4 µm 帶透明暈的小卵圓體，問病原；答 Histoplasma capsulatum 酵母形，並要求與 Leishmania、Talaromyces marneffei 鑑別。
特殊染色：GMS 與 PAS 陽性（真菌細胞壁），Giemsa 上的透明暈為染色收縮假象而非真正莢膜；尿液或血清 Histoplasma antigen 可輔助診斷。
播散性 histoplasmosis 多見於免疫低下（HIV CD4 低、移植、TNF 抑制劑）；可引起全血球低下與 secondary HLH。
治療：重症以 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導，之後改 itraconazole 維持；HIV 病人需同時啟動 ART。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Leishmania amastigote（有 kinetoplast 棒狀構造、無透明暈）；台灣與東南亞需再區分 Talaromyces marneffei，其以中央橫隔分裂而非出芽。

quiz.q: 巨噬細胞內帶透明暈、無 kinetoplast 的小卵圓微生物最可能是什麼？哪兩種特殊染色可確認其為真菌？
quiz.a: Histoplasma capsulatum（酵母形）；GMS 與 PAS。

64722.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見數個中大型、核質比高的異常細胞，核染色質細緻並有明顯核仁，細胞質灰藍色無顆粒，部分核呈凹陷或腎形，是循環中的 BPDCN 母細胞；形態本身非特異，需流式確認 CD123/CD4/CD56。
features: Three medium-to-large atypical mononuclear cells with high-to-intermediate N:C ratio
Round to indented or kidney-shaped nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
One or more distinct nucleoli
Pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm, focally with small vacuoles near the nucleus
Background red cells largely unremarkable; a smudged platelet/cell fragment at the lower right
64722.describe_en: The peripheral blood smear shows several circulating medium-to-large atypical mononuclear cells. These cells have finely dispersed chromatin, distinct nucleoli, round to indented or reniform nuclei, and a moderate amount of agranular gray-blue cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified, and the red cells show no significant morphologic abnormality. The cells are morphologically consistent with blasts; in the context of a CD4+/CD56+/CD123+ phenotype, findings are consistent with peripheral blood involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts often show fine azurophilic granules, folded nuclei and NSE/lysozyme positivity with CD14/CD11b expression, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular, NSE-negative and bright CD123+.
Lymphoblasts typically have scant cytoplasm and express TdT with B- or T-lineage markers, unlike the lineage-negative CD123+/TCF4+ BPDCN cells.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin, abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, and a spectrum of forms, rather than a uniform population with blastic chromatin and nucleoli.
Lymphoma cells tend to be more pleomorphic with deeply basophilic, often vacuolated cytoplasm and express mature B or T markers on flow.

64402.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球比周圍正常紅血球明顯小、染色深、完全沒有中央淡染區（central pallor），視野中還有多顆類似的小而圓的細胞，加上較大淡藍的多染性紅血球，符合免疫性溶血的微球形紅血球。
features: Numerous small, round, densely staining red cells lacking central pallor (microspherocytes; arrow)
Marked anisocytosis with admixed larger normochromic red cells and polychromatic macrocytes
Occasional irregular/folded red cell forms; no clear schistocytes
A lymphocyte at the top of the field; scattered platelets present
64402.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisocytosis with numerous small, dense, round red cells lacking central pallor (microspherocytes), admixed with larger normochromic red cells and polychromatic macrocytes indicating reticulocytosis. No significant schistocytes or agglutination is seen in this field. Platelets appear adequate. In a newborn with a positive direct antiglobulin test, findings are consistent with immune-mediated hemolysis due to ABO incompatibility (hemolytic disease of the newborn).

ddx.vs: Hereditary spherocytosis shows similar spherocytes but a negative DAT, family history and abnormal EMA binding test.

ddx.dx: Rh hemolytic disease of the newborn
ddx.vs: Rh disease typically shows fewer spherocytes and more nucleated red cells/erythroblastosis, with maternal anti-D identified.
Microcytes of iron deficiency or thalassemia are small but retain or enlarge central pallor, while spherocytes are dense and pallor-free.
Artifactual spherocytes occur in the thin feathered edge where all cells lose pallor, whereas true spherocytes are admixed with normal biconcave cells in the optimal reading area.

exam.answer_en: Microspherocytes with polychromasia — immune hemolysis, here ABO hemolytic disease of the newborn (DAT positive)
pearls_zh: 考法：指箭頭處無中央淡染區的小而深染紅血球問名稱，再問區分遺傳性球形紅血球症與免疫溶血最關鍵的檢查：DAT（direct antiglobulin test）。
機轉：抗體包覆的紅血球被脾臟巨噬細胞部分移除細胞膜，表面積/體積比下降成球形；HS 則是 spectrin、ankyrin、band 3 等膜骨架缺陷。
ABO HDN 多見於 O 型母親、A 或 B 型新生兒（IgG anti-A/anti-B），第一胎即可發生；DAT 可能僅弱陽性，但抹片球形紅血球明顯。
實驗室：MCHC 升高、網狀紅血球增加、間接膽紅素升高；HS 可用 EMA binding test（flow cytometry）輔助診斷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易直接判為 hereditary spherocytosis；兩者抹片可相同，免疫性溶血 DAT 陽性，HS 則 DAT 陰性、常有家族史且 EMA binding 降低。

quiz.q: 要判斷圖中球形紅血球是免疫性還是遺傳性，第一步做哪項檢查？
quiz.a: DAT（direct Coombs test）。

64274.recognize_zh: 高倍下一個緊密的立體細胞團，細胞核大、深染、大小不一並互相重疊，核質比高、細胞邊界不清，上方另一群細胞質呈泡沫/空泡狀，符合肋膜積液中的腺癌細胞團。
features: Tight three-dimensional cluster of large epithelial cells with indistinct cell borders
Enlarged, hyperchromatic round to oval nuclei with anisonucleosis and overlap
High N:C ratio; nucleoli suggested but obscured by hyperchromasia and focus
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm; adjacent group with vacuolated, frothy cytoplasm
Image slightly out of focus, limiting chromatin and nucleolar assessment
64274.describe_en: Pleural fluid cytospin at high power shows a cohesive three-dimensional cluster of large atypical epithelial cells with crowded, overlapping, hyperchromatic nuclei showing anisonucleosis and high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. An adjacent group displays vacuolated, frothy cytoplasm. The image is slightly out of focus, which limits evaluation of nucleoli and chromatin. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma in the pleural fluid, in keeping with the known lung adenocarcinoma; confirmation by immunocytochemistry (e.g., TTF-1, Napsin A, MOC-31 versus calretinin) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive mesothelial cells form flat groups with windows, have uniform nuclei with a single small nucleolus, and stain for calretinin and WT1 rather than epithelial markers.
Mesothelioma is calretinin/WT1/D2-40 positive and TTF-1/MOC-31 negative, with BAP1 loss or CDKN2A deletion.
Histiocytes form loose aggregates of cells with bean-shaped bland nuclei and foamy cytoplasm and are CD68/CD163 positive.

64146.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片視野幾乎全被脂肪細胞佔據，只剩細長血管與少數梭形基質細胞，右上角為骨小樑，看不到造血細胞；這是高度低細胞性（aplastic）骨髓的樣子，但需與低細胞性 MDS 區分。
features: Bone marrow core space almost entirely replaced by mature adipocytes
No identifiable erythroid, myeloid, or megakaryocytic precursors in this field
Residual thin capillaries and scattered spindled stromal/endothelial nuclei
Edge of a bony trabecula at the upper right confirms an intertrabecular space was sampled
No fibrosis, gelatinous transformation, granulomas, or infiltrate visible
64146.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows an intertrabecular space almost completely occupied by mature fat, with only thin vascular channels and a few spindled stromal nuclei. Hematopoietic elements are not identified in this field, and there is no fibrosis, gelatinous (serous) transformation, or abnormal infiltrate. A single field cannot establish overall cellularity, so the whole core should be assessed and a subcortical-only sample excluded. The findings are consistent with a markedly hypocellular (aplastic) marrow; distinction between aplastic anemia and hypocellular myelodysplastic neoplasm requires evaluation of residual hematopoiesis for dysplasia, blast count (CD34 IHC), and cytogenetic/molecular studies.

ddx.vs: Morphology of an empty field cannot separate it; hypo-MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes, clustered CD34+ blasts, or MDS-defining cytogenetic abnormalities in residual marrow.
Requires at least 20% blasts in residual cellular areas, usually highlighted by CD34 or CD117 immunohistochemistry.
Subcortical marrow in older adults is physiologically fatty; adequate cores (>1.5 cm of evaluable intertrabecular marrow) avoid underestimating cellularity.
Shows pink-to-basophilic amorphous extracellular material between shrunken fat cells, which is absent here.

exam.answer_en: Markedly hypocellular (aplastic) marrow — intertrabecular space replaced by fat with no hematopoietic elements; exclude hypocellular MDS
pearls_zh: 考法：切片問細胞密度與鑑別；答幾乎全為脂肪的 aplastic marrow，重點是與 hypocellular MDS、hypocellular AML 區分並確認取樣足夠（非皮質下區）。
Severe aplastic anemia（Camitta）：骨髓細胞密度 <25%，並符合 ANC <0.5、血小板 <20、網狀紅血球 <20（×10⁹/L）中至少兩項；ANC <0.2 為 very severe。
必查：PNH clone（FLAER flow）、cytogenetics/NGS、先天性骨髓衰竭（年輕者做 chromosome breakage 排除 Fanconi anemia、telomere length）。
治療：年輕且有相合供者考慮 allogeneic HSCT；否則 hATG + cyclosporine 加 eltrombopag 免疫抑制治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤為 hypocellular MDS：MDS 殘存造血細胞有 dysplasia（尤其巨核細胞）、CD34+ blast 增加、reticulin 增加或克隆性核型異常；AA 則殘存細胞形態正常、以淋巴球與漿細胞為主。

quiz.q: 此骨髓切片幾乎全為脂肪，對年輕病人診斷 aplastic anemia 前必須排除哪個先天性疾病？用什麼檢查？
quiz.a: Fanconi anemia；chromosome breakage test（DEB/MMC）。

64018.recognize_zh: 這是骨盆與雙側股骨的CT定位片（scout image，非形態學圖片），右側股骨近端內側到坐骨之間有一團不規則、斑駁的骨密度陰影，符合血友病A病人肌肉出血後的異位性骨化。
features: Frontal CT scout (topogram) of the pelvis and both femora
Irregular mottled ossific density medial to the right proximal femur extending toward the ischium/inferior pubic ramus
Additional mottled density projects over the contralateral hip region, of uncertain significance on a scout image
Femoral diaphyses appear intact without fracture or destructive lesion
Limited detail inherent to scout imaging
64018.describe_en: Frontal CT scout image of the pelvis and both thighs shows an irregular, mottled ossific density in the medial right proximal thigh between the femoral metaphysis and the ischium/inferior pubic ramus. A similar mottled density also projects over the opposite hip region, which cannot be characterized further on this projection. The femoral shafts appear intact. In a patient with hemophilia A, the right-sided lesion corresponds to heterotopic ossification after intramuscular bleeding, better characterized on the cross-sectional images; this is a radiologic image without histologic detail.

ddx.vs: Pseudotumors appear as expansile lytic or soft tissue masses with bone erosion rather than organized mottled ossification.
Osteochondromas show cortical and medullary continuity with the parent bone, which requires cross-sectional imaging to assess.

ddx.dx: Soft tissue calcification (dystrophic or tumoral calcinosis)
ddx.vs: Amorphous calcification lacks the cortical rim and trabecular pattern of true heterotopic bone seen on CT.

63954.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆大型巨噬細胞，細胞質豐富、布滿空泡並含淡染的細胞碎片，周圍是正在成熟的顆粒球（中性顆粒球、骨髓球、嗜酸性球）；此張看得到含碎屑的活化巨噬細胞，但未清楚見到完整吞噬的紅血球或有核細胞，需結合 HLH 臨床與實驗室標準。
features: Large macrophage (roughly 3-4 times the diameter of neighboring granulocytes) in the center of the field (20 um scale bar)
Abundant foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm containing pale granular cellular debris
Intact phagocytosed red cells or nucleated cells are not clearly identified within the macrophage
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with neutrophils, granulated myelocytes, an eosinophil and a basophilic granulated cell
Smeared/ruptured cells with scattered free granules at the lower field
63954.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows maturing granulocytic elements, including neutrophils, myelocytes and eosinophils, in a background of red cells and smudged cells. A large macrophage in the center has abundant, vacuolated cytoplasm containing pale cellular debris; clearly intact engulfed red cells, platelets or nucleated cells are not identified in this field. Findings indicate activated macrophages with phagocytosed debris, which can be seen in hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis but are not specific on their own. Correlation with HLH diagnostic criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, soluble CD25) is recommended.

ddx.dx: Reactive macrophages after chemotherapy, transfusion or infection
ddx.vs: Debris-laden or occasional hemophagocytic macrophages are common in stressed marrows and do not indicate HLH without the clinical and laboratory criteria.
Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm and sea-blue histiocytes have blue granules, rather than vacuoles with phagocytosed debris.

ddx.dx: Erythrophagocytic leukemic blasts (e.g. AML with t(8;16))
ddx.vs: Leukemic phagocytes are blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli, whereas this is a mature macrophage in a background without increased blasts.

ddx.dx: Tingible body macrophages in a lymphoid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages sit among sheets of neoplastic lymphoid cells and contain apoptotic nuclear bodies, which are not present here.

63826.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球前驅細胞明顯增生，許多原紅血球與嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞有深藍色細胞質、核大且染色質較開放（megaloblastoid），反映溶血下的紅系增生；此形態本身不能診斷 PNH，需以流式細胞儀檢測 GPI-anchored 蛋白缺失。
features: Erythroid hyperplasia with numerous proerythroblasts and basophilic erythroblasts
Erythroid precursors with intensely basophilic cytoplasm, some with perinuclear clearing
Nuclei relatively large with open, finely stippled chromatin, suggesting megaloblastoid change and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony
Admixed granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes/myelocytes with granules) and occasional band forms
No increase in blasts or ringed dysplastic features evident in this field
63826.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle-adjacent area with marked erythroid hyperplasia. Numerous proerythroblasts and basophilic erythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm are present, and many erythroid precursors have enlarged nuclei with open, finely stippled chromatin, consistent with megaloblastoid change. Granulocytic precursors show maturation without obvious dysplasia in this field. These findings indicate a regenerative erythroid response and are nonspecific; PNH requires flow cytometric demonstration of GPI-anchored protein-deficient granulocytes/monocytes (FLAER, CD24, CD14) and red cells (CD59). Findings are consistent with erythroid hyperplasia with megaloblastoid features in a patient with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria.

ddx.vs: True megaloblastic anemia also shows giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils and corrects with vitamin replacement; low B12/folate and elevated MMA/homocysteine confirm it.
Parvovirus produces giant proerythroblasts with intranuclear inclusions and cytoplasmic vacuoles in an otherwise erythroid-depleted marrow, not diffuse erythroid hyperplasia.
MDS shows significant dysplasia (nuclear budding, multinuclearity, ring sideroblasts) and clonal cytogenetics, whereas PNH is defined by GPI-anchor deficiency on flow cytometry.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows ≥30% proerythroblasts forming a dominant immature population with TP53 alteration, rather than a maturing erythroid series.

63890.recognize_zh: 印片抹片中一顆大型原紅血球：核圓、染色質細緻並可見小核仁，細胞質深藍且沿周邊布滿一圈小空泡；周圍大多是骨髓細胞、後髓細胞與帶狀核嗜中性球，成熟中的紅系前驅細胞幾乎看不到，符合紅系抑制。
features: Large proerythroblast with round nucleus, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous small clear vacuoles concentrated at the periphery
Background dominated by granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands) with normal granulation
Paucity of maturing erythroid precursors
Adjacent myelocyte and a few small dark cells/nuclear debris
63890.describe_en: Bone marrow touch imprint smear shows predominantly maturing granulocytic precursors, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band neutrophils, with a striking paucity of maturing erythroid precursors. A large proerythroblast is present with a round nucleus, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm studded with peripheral vacuoles. The cytoplasmic vacuolation is nonspecific and can be seen with viral infection, drugs or toxins. Findings are consistent with a vacuolated proerythroblast in a marrow with erythroid suppression, compatible with pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Chloramphenicol, alcohol or copper deficiency cause vacuoles in both erythroid and myeloid precursors, often with ring sideroblasts; clinical history and copper levels separate them.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of vacuolated proerythroblasts rather than a single precursor in a granulocyte-rich marrow.
Burkitt cells have similar basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are B cells with coarser chromatin, form a monotonous population and are CD10/CD20-positive.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and are nonspecific esterase-positive, lacking the dark blue erythroid cytoplasm.

63698.recognize_zh: 血片以小型、核圓且染色質緻密的淋巴球為主；其中一顆較大的淋巴球核呈卵圓形，細胞質向兩端拉成細長尾巴（紡錘形），另有細胞可見單側小突起；背景紅血球皺縮成棘狀。
features: Predominance of small lymphoid cells with round nuclei, condensed chromatin, and scant cytoplasm
One larger lymphoid cell with an oval nucleus and bipolar, long tapering cytoplasmic extensions (fusiform)
Occasional cells with a short unipolar cytoplasmic projection
Nucleoli not discernible at this resolution; no cytoplasmic granules
Diffusely crenated (echinocytic) red cells, likely artifact; few platelets
63698.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Leishman) shows increased small lymphoid cells with round nuclei, condensed chromatin, and scant cytoplasm. One larger lymphoid cell has an oval nucleus with bipolar attenuated cytoplasmic tails giving a fusiform shape, and occasional cells show a short polar cytoplasmic projection; distinct villous projections and a clearly giant cell are not well demonstrated in this image. Red cells show diffuse crenation, likely artifactual. In the setting of massive splenomegaly, the findings are compatible with circulating splenic marginal zone lymphoma cells, but fusiform stretching can be produced by smearing and the image alone is not diagnostic; flow cytometry and splenic or marrow histology are required.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with circumferential fine projections and are CD25/CD103/CD123/annexin A1 positive, unlike the polar projections and CD103-negative profile of SMZL.
Artifactual spindling affects lymphocytes in thick, dragged areas regardless of lineage, whereas true villous cells show short polar villi on well-spread cells.
CLL cells are small and round with block-like clumped chromatin and frequent smudge cells, and are CD5/CD23 positive by flow.
Transformed cells are distinctly larger with open chromatin and prominent nucleoli, which are not appreciable here.

63634.recognize_zh: 視野中有許多兩端尖細、呈新月或鐮刀形的紅血球（sickle cells），夾雜體積較大、偏藍灰色的多染性紅血球（polychromasia），右側還有一顆有核紅血球（nucleated RBC），符合鐮刀型貧血溶血危象的血片。
features: Numerous elongated, crescent-shaped sickle cells (drepanocytes) with pointed ends
Larger bluish-grey polychromatic red cells indicating reticulocytosis
Nucleated red blood cell with condensed nucleus (right), consistent with an orthochromatic/late normoblast
Occasional folded, oat-shaped and target-like red cells
Scattered platelets; no leukocytes in this field
63634.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous sickle cells with elongated crescent shapes and pointed ends, accompanied by occasional oat-shaped and folded forms. There is polychromasia with larger bluish red cells, and a nucleated red blood cell with a condensed nucleus is present. Platelets are present in normal-appearing form. Findings are consistent with sickle cell anemia with active hemolysis and marrow response, in keeping with a crisis.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows fewer classic sickle cells and characteristic straight-edged HbC crystals and 'folded' or 'Washington monument' cells with many target cells.
Sickle trait smears are essentially normal without sickle cells under ordinary conditions.
HbS/beta-thalassemia shows sickle cells with microcytosis, hypochromia and more target cells, with elevated HbA2 on electrophoresis.
Elliptocytes have rounded blunt ends and parallel sides rather than tapered pointed ends.

exam.answer_en: Sickle cell anemia in hemolytic crisis — numerous sickle cells with polychromasia and nucleated red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指兩端尖細的新月形紅血球問名稱，再指多染性大細胞與有核紅血球問意義；答溶血加骨髓代償性造血。
分子與檢查：HBB 基因 β6 Glu→Val（HbS）；HPLC 或電泳定量 HbS/HbF；sickle solubility test 在 trait 也陽性，無法區分 trait 與疾病。
危象分型：vaso-occlusive、splenic sequestration、hyperhemolysis 與 aplastic crisis（parvovirus B19，網狀紅血球極低）；本片多染性明顯不符 aplastic。
治療連結：hydroxyurea 增加 HbF 減少危象；中風或急性胸症候群可行 exchange transfusion。脾自體梗塞後血片可見 Howell-Jolly bodies。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 elliptocytes/pencil cells 混淆：後者兩端鈍圓、見於缺鐵或遺傳性橢圓紅血球症；sickle cell 兩端尖細。HbSC 則鐮刀細胞較少、靶形細胞多並可見 HbC 結晶。

quiz.q: 圖中多染性紅血球與有核紅血球代表什麼？如何與 parvovirus B19 引起的 aplastic crisis 區分？
quiz.a: 溶血後骨髓代償性造血；aplastic crisis 時網狀紅血球極低、缺乏多染性

63570.recognize_zh: 血片中一顆分葉核的顆粒球，胞質內散布多個亮藍綠色、邊界清楚的團塊狀包涵體，與一般紫紅色顆粒明顯不同；配合臨終前多重器官衰竭病史，符合「藍綠色死亡結晶」（green death crystals）。
features: Segmented neutrophil-sized cell with a coarsely lobulated, dark purple nucleus
Multiple bright blue-green, refractile, irregular to globular cytoplasmic inclusions distributed through the cytoplasm
Inclusions distinct from normal lilac neutrophilic granules and from Döhle bodies
Surrounding red cells unremarkable
Photograph taken of a screen with moiré grid artifact, limiting fine detail
63570.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil containing several bright blue-green, sharply demarcated cytoplasmic inclusions, distinct from normal secondary granules and toxic changes. Image quality is limited by screen-capture moiré artifact, so fine inclusion shape and granule detail cannot be fully assessed. Surrounding red cells are unremarkable. In a critically ill patient with multi-organ failure, the findings are consistent with blue-green neutrophilic inclusions ('death crystals'), which are associated with acute liver injury, lactic acidosis and high short-term mortality and should prompt notification of the clinical team.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale grey-blue, poorly defined peripheral cytoplasmic patches and toxic granules are dark purple fine granules, not bright refractile blue-green globules.
Organisms have uniform shape with internal structure or a halo and stain purple-blue rather than bright green.
Malarial hemozoin is brown-black and hemosiderin golden-brown, while bilirubin crystals in neutrophils are yellow-gold rather than blue-green.
Chédiak-Higashi granules are large purple-grey granules present in all granulocytes in a congenital setting, not acquired blue-green crystals in a dying patient.

63314.recognize_zh: 視野中滿布胞質深藍、邊緣有泡狀突起的芽細胞，中央一顆特別巨大的多核細胞（三個核、胞質含空泡），即急性白血病中的腫瘤巨細胞樣芽細胞（tumour giant cell）。
features: Large multinucleated tumour giant cell with three nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Cluster of small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles within the giant cell
Background population of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Frequent cytoplasmic blebs/budding along the blast cell membranes
Few maturing myeloid cells; scattered red cells and platelets
63314.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and frequent cytoplasmic blebs. Among them is a markedly enlarged tumour giant cell with three nuclei and vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm. Normal hematopoietic maturation is largely effaced in this field. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with tumour giant cell-like blasts; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry and cytochemistry, and the cytoplasmic blebbing raises consideration of a megakaryoblastic or monocytic component.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts show prominent cytoplasmic blebs and may form multinucleated cells, and are confirmed by CD41/CD61 expression with MPO negativity.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or other non-hematopoietic tumour
ddx.vs: Metastatic cells form cohesive clusters with syncytial arrangement and are CD45-negative and keratin-positive, unlike discohesive blasts.
Megakaryocytes have one lobulated nucleus with granular cytoplasm and osteoclasts have many separate uniform nuclei with abundant granular cytoplasm, not blast-like chromatin and deep basophilia.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe nuclei and are CD30+/ALK+ by immunophenotyping rather than myeloid markers.

63250.recognize_zh: 臨床照片組圖：一名年長女性臉部、下頷與頸部佈滿多發、大小不一的紫紅至暗紫色斑塊、丘疹與結節，下唇旁有隆起紫色結節，另一處皮膚可見中央暗紫、周圍紅暈的硬結節；多發紫色浸潤性皮膚病灶配合急性白血病病史，應懷疑白血病皮膚浸潤（leukemia cutis），需切片確認。
features: Multiple violaceous to plum-colored macules, papules and plaques on the face, jaw and neck
Lesions vary from a few millimeters to several centimeters and are partly confluent
Raised, dome-shaped violaceous nodule near the lower lip/chin
Separate firm-appearing dark purple nodule with a slightly scaly surface and an erythematous violaceous halo
Scattered pinpoint petechial red macules in adjacent skin
63250.describe_en: Clinical photographs of an elderly woman show multiple violaceous to plum-colored macules, papules and plaques distributed over the face, mandibular region and neck, ranging from a few millimeters to several centimeters and focally confluent. A raised violaceous nodule is present near the lower lip, and a separate indurated dark purple nodule with a surrounding erythematous halo is shown in close-up, with scattered petechiae nearby. The appearance of multiple infiltrative violaceous lesions in a patient with acute leukemia is suggestive of leukemia cutis; skin biopsy with immunohistochemistry is required, as in this case showing a CD45+/CD34+ dermal infiltrate.

ddx.vs: Purpura from thrombocytopenia is flat and non-palpable without induration, whereas leukemia cutis forms firm infiltrated papules, plaques and nodules.
Sweet syndrome presents as tender edematous erythematous pseudovesicular plaques with a neutrophilic dermal infiltrate without blasts on biopsy.
BPDCN produces similar bruise-like violaceous nodules in elderly patients, but the dermal infiltrate is CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCF4+ and usually CD34-negative.
These can form purple nodules but show a lymphoid (CD3/CD20) or HHV8-positive vascular spindle-cell infiltrate rather than CD34+ myeloid blasts.

63186.recognize_zh: 抹片邊緣聚集數顆異常細胞，核深度摺疊或呈雙葉（蝴蝶狀），胞質含細小顆粒且較淡，缺乏正常的成熟嗜中性球分葉，符合低顆粒型急性前骨髓性白血病。
features: Small aggregate of medium to large immature cells at the edge of a red cell-dense area
Deeply folded, bilobed or lobulated nuclei with fine chromatin
Moderate pale cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules
Occasional binucleate-appearing / butterfly configuration
Background of normocytic red cells; few platelets visible
63186.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small aggregate of abnormal immature myeloid cells at the edge of a thicker area of the film. The cells are medium to large with moderate pale cytoplasm containing fine granules and deeply folded, bilobed or lobulated nuclei with fine chromatin. Auer rods are not clearly identified at this magnification, and platelets are sparse. Findings are consistent with the hypogranular (microgranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts show grey vacuolated cytoplasm and are NSE positive, whereas APL cells are strongly MPO positive and carry PML::RARA.
Dysplastic neutrophils have condensed mature chromatin and pink secondary cytoplasm, not fine immature chromatin.
Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclei with condensed chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm rather than granular cytoplasm with fine chromatin.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, microgranular variant — aggregate of immature cells with deeply folded bilobed (butterfly) nuclei and fine granules
pearls_zh: 考法：少量聚集在抹片邊緣的細胞也可能是 APL；考官常要你先講出「bilobed/butterfly nucleus」再做出微顆粒型 APL 的判斷。
細胞化學：APL 細胞 MPO 與 Sudan black B 強陽性、NSE 陰性或弱，是與單核球性白血病最快的區分工具。
變異型 RARA 融合：ZBTB16::RARA 對 ATRA 與 arsenic 反應差，STAT5B::RARA 亦抗 ATRA；因此確診要驗到具體融合對象。
ICC 2022 將 APL 歸為 AML with recurrent genetic abnormalities 並設 ≥10% 母細胞（含異常前骨髓細胞）門檻，WHO 5th 則不設門檻。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為分葉異常的發育不良嗜中性球或 Sézary cell；兩者染色質成熟濃縮，此處細胞染色質細緻、胞質帶顆粒，屬不成熟前骨髓細胞。

quiz.q: 要快速區分這些摺疊核細胞是 APL 還是 monocytic leukemia，最簡單的細胞化學染色為何？
quiz.a: MPO（APL 強陽性）與 NSE（單核球系陽性）

63122.recognize_zh: CD10 染色低倍下，強陽性細胞沿骨小樑周圍形成寬帶並向間質延伸，中央含脂肪的造血區相對陰性；這種骨小樑旁 CD10+ 分布提示濾泡中心來源的 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: IHC for CD10 on bone marrow core biopsy, low power
Strong staining of dense cellular bands along trabeculae (paratrabecular)
Positive infiltrate extends into interstitium in broad sheets
Central intertrabecular areas with fat and hematopoiesis are largely negative
Germinal center immunophenotype of the infiltrate
63122.describe_en: CD10 immunostain at low power highlights a dense infiltrate forming broad paratrabecular bands and interstitial sheets, while the intertrabecular fat and residual hematopoietic areas are largely negative. The pattern mirrors the distribution of the lymphoma on H&E and B-cell stains. CD10 expression indicates a germinal center B-cell phenotype, supporting marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma with transformation.

ddx.vs: Burkitt is CD10+ but shows diffuse medium-sized cells with Ki-67 ~100%, BCL2 negativity, and MYC rearrangement.
Precursor B cells are CD10+ but also TdT/CD34 positive and are interstitial rather than paratrabecular sheets.
MCL can be paratrabecular but is CD10-negative, CD5+, and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.

63058.recognize_zh: 黑箭頭是小型巨核細胞，細胞質深藍，含兩到三個彼此分離的小圓核；紫箭頭是雙葉、顆粒稀少的嗜中性球（假性 Pelger-Huët），合併表示骨髓發育不良。
features: Dysplastic megakaryocyte (black arrow): small cell with 2-3 widely separated round dense nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Dysplastic neutrophils (purple arrows): bilobed pince-nez (pseudo-Pelger-Huet) nuclei with hypogranular pale cytoplasm
Other granulocytic precursors with irregular, clumped nuclei
Scattered erythroid precursor and red cells in a moderately cellular field
63058.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows granulocytic precursors and scattered neutrophils. A small megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated round nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm is present. Several neutrophils show bilobed pseudo-Pelger-Huet nuclei with markedly hypogranular cytoplasm. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic and granulocytic dysplasia in a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Inherited Pelger-Huet neutrophils have normal granulation and affect nearly all neutrophils without megakaryocytic dysplasia.
Drug effect lacks dysplastic megakaryocytes and reverses after withdrawal.
Reactive megakaryocytes are large with lobated nuclei rather than small cells with separated round nuclei.

62994.recognize_zh: S100 免疫染色中，大型組織球的細胞質與細胞核呈強陽性，細胞質內可見被包覆、未染色（藍色）的完整淋巴球，這是 emperipolesis 的免疫染色表現，支持 Rosai-Dorfman 型組織球。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm showing strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S100 staining
Unstained (hematoxylin-blue) intact lymphocytes enclosed within the S100-positive cytoplasm (emperipolesis)
Some histiocytes appear multinucleated or contain several engulfed cells
Background small lymphocytes and plasma cells are S100-negative
62994.describe_en: S100 immunostain highlights large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm showing strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining. Several of these cells contain intact, unstained lymphocytes within their cytoplasm, highlighting emperipolesis. The background lymphocytes are negative. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman-type (S100-positive, emperipolesis-bearing) histiocytes.

ddx.vs: LCH cells are also S100+ but are CD1a+/langerin+, have grooved nuclei and lack emperipolesis.
IDC sarcoma forms sheets of atypical S100+ spindle cells without emperipolesis, whereas these are discrete large histiocytes engulfing lymphocytes.
Melanoma cells are S100+ but show nuclear atypia and SOX10/HMB45/Melan-A positivity, without lymphocyte engulfment.

exam.answer_en: Rosai-Dorfman-type histiocytes on S100 immunostain — strong S100+ large histiocytes with intact unstained lymphocytes in cytoplasm (emperipolesis)
pearls_zh: 考法：指 S100 陽性大細胞內的藍色未染小細胞，問這個現象叫什麼（emperipolesis）與診斷（Rosai-Dorfman disease）。
RDD 組織球免疫表型：S100+、CD68+、CD163+，CD1a−、langerin（CD207）−。
典型表現為年輕人雙側無痛性巨大頸部淋巴結腫大（sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy），淋巴竇擴張充滿組織球。
部分 RDD 帶 MAPK 路徑突變（如 KRAS、MAP2K1），在 WHO 5th 歸於 histiocytic/dendritic cell neoplasms。
Emperipolesis 指完整活細胞穿入另一細胞胞質，被吞入細胞未被破壞；與 phagocytosis 不同。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Langerhans cell histiocytosis：LCH 也 S100+，但 CD1a+/langerin+、核有溝紋、背景嗜伊紅性球多，且無 emperipolesis。

quiz.q: S100 陽性組織球胞質內含完整淋巴球，這個現象叫什麼？提示哪個疾病？
quiz.a: Emperipolesis；Rosai-Dorfman disease

62866.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見兩顆晚期紅血球母細胞含有兩個大小相等的圓形核（雙核紅血球母細胞），另有多顆體積大、染色質較開放、細胞質深藍的早期紅血球母細胞（megaloblastoid 樣），是先天性紅血球生成不良性貧血第二型（CDA II）的特徵。
features: Binucleate late erythroblasts with two equal-sized, round, dense nuclei
Large early erythroblasts with open, megaloblastoid-appearing chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Occasional erythroblast with a dumbbell/lobulated nucleus
Granulocytic precursors and a segmented neutrophil with normal granulation
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis
62866.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid precursors at several stages of maturation. Two late erythroblasts contain two equal-sized, round nuclei (binucleation), and another shows a lobulated dumbbell-shaped nucleus. Several large early erythroblasts have open, megaloblastoid-appearing chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Granulocytic maturation appears unremarkable. Equal-sized binucleate late erythroblasts are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II in the appropriate clinical and genetic context.

ddx.vs: CDA I shows megaloblastoid erythroblasts with internuclear chromatin bridges and spongy (Swiss cheese) heterochromatin on electron microscopy, with CDAN1 mutation.
Megaloblastic anemia shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony across all erythroid stages plus giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, with low B12 or folate.
MDS occurs in older patients with multilineage dysplasia, possible increased blasts and clonal cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities.
CDA III shows giant multinucleated erythroblasts with up to 12 nuclei rather than predominantly binucleate cells.

exam.answer_en: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II (HEMPAS) — equal-sized binucleate late erythroblasts in marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指「兩個大小相等圓核的晚期紅血球母細胞」問診斷；CDA II 的雙核主要出現在晚期（polychromatic/orthochromatic）階段。
CDA II 為體染色體隱性，致病基因 SEC23B；舊稱 HEMPAS（hereditary erythroblastic multinuclearity with positive acidified serum test）。
特殊檢查：SDS-PAGE 顯示 band 3 低糖化（條帶較窄、泳動較快）；電顯可見紅血球母細胞膜下雙層膜（peripheral double membrane）。
臨床：網狀紅血球反應相對不足、黃疸、脾腫大、膽結石；即使未輸血也常出現鐵過載，需追蹤 ferritin 並考慮排鐵。
CDA 分型對照：CDA I（CDAN1）染色質橋與 spongy heterochromatin；CDA III（KIF23）巨大多核紅血球母細胞。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 MDS 紅系異生或巨母紅血球性貧血；CDA II 以年輕病人、雙核大小相等且集中於晚期紅血球母細胞、其他系列正常來區分。

quiz.q: 圖中雙核晚期紅血球母細胞提示哪一型 CDA？其致病基因為何？
quiz.a: CDA type II；SEC23B

62738.recognize_zh: Perls 鐵染色高倍下，一個巨噬細胞的胞質與伸出的突起內含深藍到藍黑色的含鐵血黃素顆粒與團塊，周圍環繞紅色複染的有核細胞，即骨髓儲存鐵陽性的巨噬細胞。
features: Macrophage with irregular, dendritic cytoplasmic processes staining grey-blue
Coarse dark blue-black hemosiderin granules and clumps within the macrophage cytoplasm
A pale pink engulfed or overlying cell within the macrophage
Surrounding nucleated cells with red nuclear counterstain; few fine blue granules in scattered cells
Orange background red cells and plasma
62738.describe_en: Perls (Prussian blue) stain of a bone marrow aspirate at high power shows a macrophage with dendritic cytoplasmic processes containing dark blue to blue-black hemosiderin granules and aggregates, surrounded by nucleated marrow cells in the red counterstain. Only rare fine blue granules are seen in adjacent cells, and no ring sideroblasts are present in this field. A single field cannot grade storage iron, which should be assessed on particles at low power. Findings demonstrate positive macrophage storage iron.

ddx.vs: Iron granules are located within erythroid precursors in a perinuclear ring rather than within the dendritic cytoplasm of a macrophage.
Precipitate is refractile, irregular and lies in the background or over cells rather than in a cell with defined processes.

ddx.dx: Hemosiderin-laden macrophage versus melanin or pigment
ddx.vs: Only hemosiderin gives Prussian blue positivity; other pigments remain brown or black without blue reaction.

62674.recognize_zh: BCL6 染色中，一個結節內大多數細胞核呈強弱不等的核染色，界線清楚；結節外周圍的小淋巴球核則為陰性（藍色），顯示結節由生發中心（germinal center）B 細胞組成。
features: Intermediate power: a large nodule in which most nuclei show moderate-to-strong nuclear BCL6 staining
Staining intensity variable among positive cells
Sharp boundary with surrounding BCL6-negative small lymphocytes (blue nuclei)
Scattered positive nuclei beyond the nodule edge
Nuclear (not cytoplasmic) localization
62674.describe_en: BCL6 immunohistochemistry at intermediate power shows a large nodule composed predominantly of cells with moderate-to-strong nuclear BCL6 staining, sharply demarcated from the surrounding BCL6-negative small lymphocytes, with a few positive cells at the periphery. BCL6 confirms germinal center B-cell derivation of the nodular population but does not distinguish neoplastic from reactive follicles. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma when combined with BCL2 coexpression in the follicles.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles are also BCL6 positive, so BCL2 negativity of germinal center cells and polarized Ki-67 are required to separate them.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Colonizing marginal zone cells are BCL6 and CD10 negative, leaving only residual germinal center cells positive.

ddx.dx: Nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma (angioimmunoblastic type)
ddx.vs: Neoplastic TFH cells can be BCL6 positive but are CD3/CD4 positive with PD1 and CXCL13, and have expanded FDC meshworks outside follicles.

62610.recognize_zh: Lambda 原位雜交低倍圖：右側小腸黏膜固有層內的正常漿細胞呈深藍黑色陽性（內部對照），左側腫瘤結節幾乎不著色，表示腫瘤不表現 lambda，提示 kappa 限制性。
features: Low-power ISH section of small bowel wall with tumor on the left and mucosa on the right
Numerous dark blue-black lambda-positive plasma cells in the lamina propria of villi (internal positive control)
Tumor nodules infiltrating submucosa/muscularis are essentially negative for lambda
Fibromuscular septa and vessels separate tumor nodules from mucosa
62610.describe_en: Lambda light chain in situ hybridization shows strong signal in scattered normal plasma cells of the adjacent small intestinal lamina propria, which serve as an internal positive control. The neoplastic infiltrate occupying the deeper bowel wall is essentially negative for lambda. Together with diffuse kappa positivity in the tumor, this indicates kappa light-chain restriction and a clonal plasma cell proliferation, consistent with plasmacytoma-like post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates show a mixture of kappa- and lambda-positive cells (ratio roughly 2:1), unlike the lambda-negative tumor here.
Strong signal in mucosal plasma cells on the same slide confirms the assay worked, so tumor negativity is genuine.

ddx.dx: Non-plasmacytic lymphoma lacking light chain mRNA
ddx.vs: A lesion negative for both kappa and lambda would suggest a non-secretory or non-plasma-cell neoplasm, whereas this tumor is kappa-positive.

62546.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中白血球很少（只見兩顆淋巴球與一顆單核球樣細胞），血小板也稀少，紅血球形態大致正常，呈現血球減少的背景，與 RCC 的臨床表現相符但不具特異性。
features: Few leukocytes in a wide field: two small lymphocytes and one monocytoid cell with an indented nucleus
Neutrophils not seen in this field, suggesting neutropenia
Platelets markedly reduced
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic with mild anisocytosis
No circulating blasts identified
62546.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-medium power shows reduced numbers of leukocytes, with only two small lymphocytes and one monocytoid cell in the field and no neutrophils. Platelets are markedly decreased. Red cells are predominantly normocytic and normochromic with mild anisocytosis. No blasts or dysplastic forms are identified. Findings suggest pancytopenia, which is nonspecific but compatible with refractory cytopenia of childhood in the appropriate clinical and marrow context.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia produces the same blood picture and is separated by a markedly hypocellular marrow without dysplasia.
ALL frequently presents with cytopenias but typically shows circulating blasts with fine chromatin and high N:C ratio, which are absent here.
Immune thrombocytopenia usually shows large platelets with isolated thrombocytopenia and normal leukocytes, unlike multilineage reduction.

62482.recognize_zh: 整片脾臟切片的極低倍掃描圖中，佈滿大量大小不一、紫藍色、部分融合的擴大白髓結節，結節間為被擠壓的粉紅色紅髓，呈微結節（micronodular）模式，是脾邊緣區淋巴瘤的典型分布。
features: Whole-mount scanning view of a spleen section
Innumerable expanded, round basophilic white pulp nodules of variable size throughout the section
Some nodules coalescing into larger confluent areas
Intervening eosinophilic red pulp compressed into narrow cords between nodules
Resolution too low for cytologic assessment
62482.describe_en: Scanning-magnification H&E section of spleen shows a diffuse micronodular pattern with innumerable expanded, basophilic white pulp nodules of variable size, some of which coalesce. The red pulp is compressed into narrow eosinophilic bands between the nodules. Cytologic detail and the biphasic zonation of the nodules cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a white pulp-based lymphoid proliferation, compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma forms nodules of centrocytes and centroblasts that are CD10 and BCL6 positive, lacking the marginal zone rim of paler cells.
Mantle cell lymphoma also expands white pulp but is composed of CD5 and cyclin D1-positive cells with scant cytoplasm.
Hairy cell leukemia diffusely infiltrates red pulp with blood lakes and atrophic white pulp, the opposite of this white pulp-predominant pattern.
Reactive hyperplasia shows normally sized, well-spaced follicles with polarized germinal centers and polytypic B cells.

exam.answer_en: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma — micronodular white pulp expansion throughout spleen with compressed red pulp
pearls_zh: 考法：整片脾臟低倍掃描，問病變主要在白髓還是紅髓；白髓微結節擴張指向 SMZL，紅髓瀰漫浸潤則要想到 HCL 或 SDRPL。
表型：CD20+、CD5−、CD10−、CD103 常陰性、cyclin D1 陰性，IgM/IgD 常陽性；結節常呈雙相（中心小淋巴球、外圍較淡的邊緣區細胞）。
遺傳：del(7q) 是最常見的細胞遺傳異常之一；常見 NOTCH2、KLF2 突變；無特異性易位。
臨床：脾腫大為主、淋巴結病變少，骨髓常見 intrasinusoidal 浸潤；部分與 HCV 相關，抗病毒治療可能使淋巴瘤緩解。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 CLL/SLL 或 MCL 侵犯脾臟：兩者也可呈白髓結節，但為 CD5 陽性（MCL 另 cyclin D1+）；SMZL 為 CD5 陰性、有邊緣區分化。

quiz.q: 此脾臟掃描圖主要受侵犯的是紅髓還是白髓？最可能診斷為何？
quiz.a: 白髓（微結節型）；Splenic marginal zone lymphoma

62418.recognize_zh: 低倍下一團由許多厚壁血管組成的病灶，血管壁被均質、淡粉紅、無細胞的物質增厚（疑似類澱粉 amyloid 沉積），周圍有脂肪與出血；但視野上方與右側可見骨小樑與脂肪性骨髓，組織較像骨/骨髓而非淋巴結副皮質區，類澱粉需以 Congo red 證實。
features: Nodular focus of numerous thick-walled blood vessels with markedly expanded walls
Vessel walls replaced by pale, homogeneous, acellular eosinophilic material suggestive of amyloid
Intervening adipose tissue and loose fibrous stroma within the lesion
Hemorrhage along the left edge of the fragment
Bony trabeculae and fatty hematopoietic marrow at the top and right, with an irregular basophilic (calcified/cement-line) focus
No lymph node capsule, sinuses or follicles identifiable in this field
62418.describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows a nodular aggregate of numerous thick-walled vessels whose walls are expanded by pale, homogeneous, acellular eosinophilic material, with intervening adipose tissue and fibrous stroma and hemorrhage at the left edge. Bony trabeculae with fatty hematopoietic marrow are present at the top and right of the fragment, and no lymph node architecture (capsule, sinuses, follicles) is recognizable, so the tissue appears to be bone/marrow rather than paracortical lymph node as captioned. The vascular wall thickening is suggestive of amyloid deposition, which must be confirmed by Congo red with apple-green birefringence and typed (e.g., AL light chain). In a patient with plasma cell myeloma, findings are suggestive of AL amyloid angiopathy.

ddx.vs: Hyaline change is Congo red-negative and usually involves small arterioles in hypertension/diabetes rather than forming a mass-like cluster of expanded vessels.
Vascular malformations have muscular or fibrous walls with collagen rather than amorphous Congo red-positive deposits.
LCDD deposits are Congo red-negative and show granular non-fibrillar deposits by electron microscopy.
Fibrinoid necrosis is brightly eosinophilic with nuclear debris and inflammation of the vessel wall rather than bland acellular expansion.

62354.recognize_zh: 幾乎所有腫瘤細胞都呈強而瀰漫的 CD3 棕色膜狀（及胞質）染色，核為淡藍色、形狀不規則，確立腫瘤細胞為 T 細胞系。
features: Strong, diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic CD3 staining in virtually all tumor cells
Sheet-like growth of medium-sized cells with high N:C ratio
Nuclei (pale on counterstain) oval to irregular and angulated
Only rare negative interstitial or endothelial cells
62354.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 shows strong, diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic staining in virtually all tumor cells, which form a sheet of medium-sized cells with irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Negative cells are limited to scattered stromal and endothelial elements. This establishes T-cell lineage and, together with nuclear TdT expression, supports T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PTCL is CD3+ but TdT-negative and CD1a-negative, with pleomorphic mature cells and frequent loss of pan-T antigens.
Thymic lymphocytes are CD3+ TdT+ but are admixed with cytokeratin-positive epithelial cells and show a lobulated architecture.
ETP-ALL is cytoplasmic CD3+ but CD1a-negative, CD8-negative, CD5 weak/negative and expresses stem cell or myeloid markers such as CD34, CD117 or CD13/CD33.

62290.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球前驅細胞明顯增多且體積偏大，核染色質呈開放、細點篩網狀，但細胞質已呈深藍或開始血紅素化（核質發育不同步），並見有絲分裂像與腎形核的巨大粒細胞前驅細胞，符合巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Increased erythroid precursors, many enlarged (megaloblasts) relative to adjacent red cells
Open, finely stippled 'sieve-like' chromatin retained in maturing erythroid precursors
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony: immature-appearing nuclei with deeply basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm
Mitotic figure in an erythroid precursor (bottom of field)
Large myeloid precursors with open chromatin and reniform nuclei suggestive of giant metamyelocytes
Background red cells include macrocytes and occasional teardrop forms
62290.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked erythroid hyperplasia with a predominance of enlarged erythroid precursors. The precursors display open, finely stippled sieve-like chromatin that is disproportionately immature relative to their basophilic or polychromatic cytoplasm, indicating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, and a mitotic figure is present. Admixed large granulocytic precursors with open chromatin and reniform nuclei are suggestive of giant metamyelocytes. No increase in blasts is evident in this field. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis, as seen in vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia consists of sheets of very immature proerythroblasts with vacuolated cytoplasm and TP53 alterations, rather than a full maturation spectrum that corrects with B12/folate.
MDS shows megaloblastoid erythroids with multilineage dysplasia (hypolobated megakaryocytes, hypogranular neutrophils) and ring sideroblasts, persisting with normal B12/folate.
Drug effect is morphologically identical and is distinguished only by medication history with normal vitamin levels.
CDA shows binucleated/multinucleated erythroblasts and internuclear chromatin bridges with isolated erythroid dysplasia and normal granulopoiesis.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — megaloblastic erythroid precursors with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony plus giant metamyelocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：除紅血球系外，考官常指大型、核呈腎形而染色質開放的顆粒球前驅細胞，問名稱：giant metamyelocyte，是 megaloblastic 變化的骨髓系證據。
周邊血對應：hypersegmented neutrophils（常用定義為 5 葉以上佔 >5%，或出現 6 葉以上）、oval macrocytes，並可有全血球減少。
機轉：B12 或 folate 缺乏導致 DNA 合成受損，核成熟落後於細胞質（asynchrony）；RNA/血紅素合成相對正常。
Giant metamyelocytes 在補充治療後消失較慢，比紅血球系變化更持久，可協助回溯診斷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 藥物也可造成相同形態，易誤判為營養缺乏：methotrexate、hydroxyurea、azathioprine、nitrous oxide 等會引起 megaloblastic 變化，需詢問用藥史。

quiz.q: 圖中大型、腎形核且染色質開放的顆粒球前驅細胞稱為什麼？其周邊血對應的中性球變化為何？
quiz.a: Giant metamyelocyte；hypersegmented neutrophils

61970.recognize_zh: CD3 免疫染色中，真皮內密集的小到中型淋巴球幾乎全部呈強烈細胞膜陽性，緊貼陰性的毛囊／表皮上皮（右上方淡藍區），上皮內只有少數陽性細胞；T 細胞為主的密集真皮浸潤支持 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病。
features: Dense dermal infiltrate with strong membranous CD3 staining in the large majority of lymphoid cells
Positive cells are small to medium-sized with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Negative squamous/follicular epithelium at upper field with only rare intraepithelial CD3-positive cells
Scattered CD3-negative cells within the infiltrate (B cells, histiocytes)
A small negative adnexal duct is embedded in the infiltrate at lower field
61970.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 on a skin biopsy shows a dense dermal infiltrate in which the large majority of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells show strong membranous staining. The infiltrate abuts adnexal and squamous epithelium, which contains only rare CD3-positive cells, and encloses a small negative adnexal duct. Scattered CD3-negative cells are interspersed. Findings indicate a T-cell-predominant dermal infiltrate, consistent with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder in conjunction with CD4 predominance and a minor CD30-positive component.

ddx.vs: Mycosis fungoides shows CD3-positive cells colonizing the epidermis with Pautrier microabscesses rather than a dermal nodule with minimal epidermal involvement.
Reactive T-cell pseudolymphomas are polyclonal, mixed with many B cells and eosinophils, and lack PD-1-positive atypical medium-sized cells.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Aggressive cutaneous PTCL is also CD3-positive but has many large pleomorphic cells and frequent loss of pan-T antigens.

61906.recognize_zh: 高倍下真皮小血管周圍被小至中型淋巴球緊密環繞並侵入血管壁，血管腔內有紅血球與纖維蛋白樣物質，形成血管中心性（angiocentric）浸潤；細胞核略不規則但異型性不高，這種血管中心性、輕度異型的T/NK細胞浸潤是HV-LPD的特徵之一。
features: Small dermal vessel cuffed and permeated by lymphocytes (angiocentric/angioinvasive pattern)
Vessel lumen containing red cells and pale eosinophilic fibrinoid material
Infiltrating cells are small to medium-sized with round to slightly irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Only mild cytologic atypia; no large pleomorphic cells evident
Background dermal collagen with interstitial lymphocytes and scattered extravasated red cells
61906.describe_en: High-power examination of the dermis shows a small vessel surrounded and infiltrated by small to medium-sized lymphocytes with slightly irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm, with red cells and fibrinoid material in the lumen. Lymphocytes also extend interstitially between collagen bundles. Cytologic atypia is mild, and large pleomorphic cells are not identified. The angiocentric infiltrate of mildly atypical lymphocytes, in conjunction with EBER positivity and a cytotoxic phenotype, is consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: ENKTL is also angiocentric and EBER-positive but typically shows more pleomorphic medium-to-large cells with extensive necrosis and occurs outside the photodistributed childhood HV setting.
Vasculitis shows neutrophils with nuclear dust or reactive lymphocytes around vessels that are EBER-negative, without a dense interstitial atypical infiltrate.
LyP contains large CD30-positive atypical cells in a mixed inflammatory background and is EBER-negative.

61842.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片可見真皮被一片淡染、較均質的浸潤取代，正常網狀膠原束被推擠，表皮大致正常；單看低倍只能提示真皮組織球浸潤，需高倍見泡沫狀組織球與 Touton 巨細胞才支持 Erdheim-Chester 病。
features: Two skin punch/wedge biopsies at scanning magnification
Unremarkable epidermis with preserved rete pattern
Dermis expanded by a diffuse, pale, hypercellular infiltrate replacing reticular collagen
Infiltrate extends into deep dermis around adnexal structures
Cellular detail not resolvable at this magnification
61842.describe_en: Scanning-magnification sections of two skin biopsies show an intact epidermis overlying a dermis that is expanded by a diffuse, pale-staining infiltrate which effaces the normal reticular dermal collagen and surrounds adnexal structures, extending to the deep margin. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification; higher power is required to confirm foamy histiocytes and Touton giant cells. In the clinical and radiologic context, the pattern is compatible with cutaneous involvement by Erdheim-Chester disease.

ddx.vs: Xanthomas contain foamy histiocytes but lack clonal BRAF V600E and are typically more superficial and not associated with systemic long-bone sclerosis.
JXG shares the CD68+/CD163+/CD1a- phenotype but presents as solitary lesions in children without systemic ECD features, and distinction may require clinical/radiologic correlation.
Morphea shows thickened hyalinized collagen with a sparse perivascular lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate rather than a histiocyte-rich infiltrate.
NXG shows zones of necrobiosis, bizarre giant cells, and cholesterol clefts and is associated with paraproteinemia.

61714.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多數為中大型芽細胞：染色質細緻、胞質灰藍，其中一個細胞的胞質周邊可見一圈小空泡（像珍珠項鍊），夾雜小淋巴球與一個分葉核嗜中性球；這種胞質邊緣微空泡是 BPDCN 常見線索。
features: Predominance of intermediate-to-large blasts with round to irregular nuclei and finely dispersed chromatin
Moderate gray-blue, agranular cytoplasm
Small cytoplasmic vacuoles, in one cell arranged along the cell periphery ('pearl necklace' pattern)
Scattered small mature lymphocytes and a segmented neutrophil
Occasional cells with irregular, tapering cytoplasmic outlines; smear stretch artifact (strand) across the field
61714.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows numerous intermediate-to-large blasts with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm. Several cells contain small cytoplasmic vacuoles, which in one cell are distributed along the inner cell membrane in a peripheral necklace-like pattern. Scattered small lymphocytes and a segmented neutrophil are present, and Auer rods are not seen. Findings are suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, which requires confirmation by flow cytometry or IHC (CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4, TCL1).

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei, more abundant cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and nonspecific esterase positivity, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular, MPO/NSE-negative and CD123-bright.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm with high N:C ratio and express TdT and B- or T-lineage markers rather than CD4/CD56/CD123.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are CD34+/CD117+ with CD13/CD33 and lack CD4/CD56/TCF4 co-expression.

61650.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片滿布異常前骨髓細胞，核呈雙葉或摺疊，胞質充滿粉紫色顆粒，多個細胞內可見成束的 Auer 小體（faggot cells），是 APL 的經典型態。
features: Sheet of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm
Nuclei reniform, folded, or bilobed with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli
Dense azurophilic granules spilling into the background
Multiple cells with bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells)
Few residual lymphocytes; normal hematopoiesis largely replaced
61650.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is diffusely replaced by abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm packed with azurophilic granules. Nuclei are reniform, folded, or bilobed, with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli. Several cells contain bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells). Normal hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced. Findings are morphologically characteristic of acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type); PML::RARA should be confirmed urgently and all-trans retinoic acid initiated without waiting for genetic results.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) blasts usually contain single long slender Auer rods and salmon granules with prominent hofs, not multiple Auer rod bundles in hypergranular promyelocytes.
Recovering promyelocytes have round nuclei with a Golgi hof and orderly maturation to myelocytes, without Auer rods.

ddx.dx: APL variant with non-PML RARA partner (e.g., ZBTB16::RARA)
ddx.vs: ZBTB16::RARA shows more regular nuclei, fewer Auer rods, and ATRA resistance; genetic testing is required to separate.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular type (marrow) — sheets of abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and faggot cells (bundled Auer rods)
pearls_zh: 考法：指胞質內成束 Auer rods 的細胞問名稱：faggot cell，幾乎等同 APL；MPO 細胞化學強陽性。
遺傳：t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2) PML::RARA；變異型 ZBTB16::RARA 與 STAT5B::RARA 對 ATRA 反應差，ICC 2022 將 RARA 變異夥伴另列。
Microgranular variant（M3v）：顆粒在光鏡下不明顯、核雙葉「butterfly」、WBC 常高並與 FLT3-ITD 相關，仍有 PML::RARA 與 DIC 風險。
急症處置：一懷疑即給 ATRA；DIC/纖溶亢進需輸血小板與 fibrinogen/cryoprecipitate，避免在凝血未矯正前做侵入性處置。
治療：非高危（WBC ≤10×10^9/L）以 ATRA＋ATO 為標準；高危加化療（如 anthracycline）或 gemtuzumab ozogamicin。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 AML with t(8;21)：t(8;21) 芽細胞可有單根長 Auer rod 與核周 hof、嗜中性球發育不良，但缺乏成片雙葉核過度顆粒細胞與成束 Auer rods；後者需 RUNX1::RUNX1T1。

quiz.q: 骨髓抹片中胞質內含成束 Auer rods 的細胞稱為什麼？最具診斷性的融合基因是什麼？
quiz.a: Faggot cell；PML::RARA（t(15;17)）。

61586.recognize_zh: 脾臟紅髓被混合性髓系細胞浸潤：有核型卵圓或凹陷的未成熟骨髓單核系細胞、分節或帶狀核的成熟中性球，以及深染圓核的紅血球前驅細胞，散布於紅血球之間；在幼兒脾腫大的情境下符合 JMML 的紅髓浸潤。
features: Diffuse expansion of splenic red pulp by a mixed hematopoietic infiltrate
Immature myelomonocytic cells with oval to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Admixed maturing granulocytes with band and segmented nuclei
Erythroid precursors with small, round, dense nuclei
Red cells packed between infiltrating cells in cords and sinuses; no discrete white pulp in this field
61586.describe_en: H&E section of spleen shows diffuse expansion of the red pulp by a mixed hematopoietic infiltrate. The infiltrate is composed of immature myelomonocytic cells with oval to indented nuclei and fine chromatin, admixed with maturing granulocytes with band and segmented nuclei and erythroid precursors with small dense round nuclei, set among red cells in the cords and sinuses. Sheets of blasts are not evident at this magnification. In a young child with splenomegaly, monocytosis and a RAS-pathway mutation, findings are consistent with red pulp involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Also trilineage with megakaryocytes and erythroid islands, but lacks a monocytic predominance and occurs with marrow failure/fibrosis or hemolysis rather than a clonal RAS-pathway myeloproliferation.
Shows sheets of monotonous blasts (CD34/CD117+) rather than a mixture of maturing granulocytic, monocytic and erythroid cells.
Red pulp contains histiocytes with engulfed hematopoietic cells, without a myelomonocytic proliferation.
Similar splenic infiltrate but occurs in adults; CML is excluded by BCR::ABL1 testing.

61522.recognize_zh: 淋巴結低倍影像中，寬厚的粉紅色膠原纖維帶把淋巴組織切割成多個圓形結節，結節內可見散在的小透明空隙（lacunar 細胞），這種「纖維帶包圍結節」的架構是結節硬化型 CHL 的低倍特徵。
features: Nodal architecture effaced by multiple rounded cellular nodules
Broad bands of pink collagen separating and encircling the nodules
Scattered small clear spaces within nodules corresponding to lacunar cells
Nodules composed predominantly of small lymphocytes at this magnification; individual cytology not resolvable
61522.describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows effacement of the normal architecture by multiple rounded cellular nodules separated and encircled by broad bands of collagen. The nodules contain a dense lymphoid population with numerous scattered clear spaces representing lacunar cells. Cytologic detail is not resolvable at this magnification. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype, to be confirmed by identification of CD30+, CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells.

ddx.vs: NLPHL forms large vague nodules without broad collagen bands, containing CD20+ LP (popcorn) cells rather than lacunar cells.
FL shows back-to-back crowded follicles of centrocytes and centroblasts without dense collagen bands or lacunar cells, and is CD10+/BCL2+.
Nodular lymphocyte-rich CHL has small-lymphocyte nodules with regressed germinal centers but lacks the broad sclerotic bands of nodular sclerosis.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymph node with capsular/trabecular fibrosis
ddx.vs: Reactive nodes retain follicles with germinal centers and sinuses, and fibrosis is limited to the capsule and trabeculae without nodules of lacunar cells.

exam.answer_en: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis — low-power effaced node divided into rounded nodules by broad collagen bands
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍架構題—問「此淋巴結正常架構是否保留、結節由什麼包圍」；寬厚膠原帶分隔結節是 NSCHL 的低倍診斷線索。
NSCHL 的膠原帶在偏光下呈雙折射，且常伴莢膜增厚；低倍可見結節內散在透明空隙，即 lacunar cells。
低倍架構只能提示，確診仍須找到 HRS/lacunar 細胞並以 IHC（CD30、CD15、PAX5 弱陽性）證實。
臨床連結：年輕成人、縱膈大腫塊（bulky mediastinal disease）常見，影響分期與放射治療規劃。
exam.pitfall_zh: 低倍下易誤認為 follicular lymphoma 的結節或纖維化反應；FL 為背對背濾泡且無寬厚膠原帶，NSCHL 結節由粉紅膠原帶包圍並含 lacunar 空隙。

quiz.q: 這張低倍淋巴結影像中，把組織分成多個結節的粉紅色結構是什麼？提示哪一型 Hodgkin lymphoma？
quiz.a: 寬厚的膠原纖維帶；nodular sclerosis classic Hodgkin lymphoma

61458.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中紅血球堆疊成一串串線性排列（錢串狀，rouleaux），而非葡萄串狀凝集；箭頭處有一顆循環漿細胞，核偏位、胞質深藍並有核旁淡染區，合看支持多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Red cells arranged in linear stacks of several cells (rouleaux) throughout a relatively thin area of the smear
Aggregates are linear, not irregular grape-like clusters (not agglutination)
Single circulating plasma cell (arrow) with eccentric round nucleus, clumped chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm, and perinuclear hof
Occasional platelets; no other leukocytes in field
Red cells otherwise normochromic
61458.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows prominent rouleaux formation, with red cells forming linear coin-stack aggregates in the reading area, and no irregular clumping suggestive of agglutination. A single circulating plasma cell (arrow) with an eccentric nucleus, coarse chromatin, and basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof is present. Rouleaux reflects increased plasma proteins such as a monoclonal immunoglobulin. Findings are suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm; serum protein electrophoresis with immunofixation, free light chains, and bone marrow evaluation are recommended, and a plasma cell count should be reported given the definition of plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Agglutinates form irregular three-dimensional grape-like clumps that do not disperse with saline, unlike linear stacks of rouleaux.
Artifactual overlap occurs only in thick parts of the smear, whereas true rouleaux persists in the thin reading area.
Polyclonal increases in fibrinogen or immunoglobulin also cause rouleaux, so an M-protein must be shown by immunofixation.
