Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant, less deeply basophilic cytoplasm without a well-formed hof, and appear with other reactive forms.

exam.answer_en: Rouleaux formation with a circulating plasma cell — suggestive of plasma cell neoplasm (paraproteinemia)
pearls_zh: 考法：看紅血球線性疊錢狀排列，問「這叫什麼、機轉為何」→ rouleaux，因血漿中大分子蛋白（M-protein、fibrinogen）降低紅血球表面負電荷排斥。
Rouleaux 必須在血片薄區（reading area）判讀；厚區紅血球本就重疊，是常見假影。
與 agglutination 區分：rouleaux 為規則線性疊錢且加生理食鹽水可分散；agglutination 為不規則成團，食鹽水不易打散（如 cold agglutinin）。
箭頭漿細胞提醒須計算循環漿細胞：IMWG 2021 將 plasma cell leukemia 定義修訂為周邊血 clonal plasma cells ≥5%。
臨床連結：ESR 顯著升高、血型鑑定時可造成假凝集；需 SPEP/IFE、serum FLC 與骨髓檢查。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為紅血球凝集（agglutination）；rouleaux 呈整齊硬幣堆疊且可被 saline replacement 打散，agglutination 則為不規則葡萄串狀團塊。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球呈疊錢狀排列的現象叫什麼？如何在實驗室與 agglutination 區分？
quiz.a: Rouleaux；saline replacement（食鹽水取代）可打散 rouleaux

61394.recognize_zh: CD20 免疫染色中，多顆大型細胞與免疫母細胞呈中等強度的細胞膜與細胞質棕色染色，勾勒出大而淡染的細胞核，背景大量小細胞與組織球大多為陰性；大細胞 CD20 陽性支持 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍而非典型霍奇金淋巴瘤。
features: Scattered large cells and immunoblasts with moderate membranous and cytoplasmic CD20 staining
Positive large cells outline big pale vesicular nuclei, some lobated
One small cell at the bottom with crisp strong membranous CD20, consistent with a residual small B cell
Most background small cells and histiocytes negative
Positive cells scattered singly and in loose clusters within the infiltrate
61394.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry highlights numerous scattered large cells and immunoblasts with moderate membranous and cytoplasmic staining surrounding large vesicular nuclei. Occasional small reactive B cells show strong membranous staining, whereas the majority of the background small cells and histiocytes are negative. The large cells do not form confluent sheets. CD20 expression by the giant cells and immunoblasts, in combination with EBER positivity, is consistent with EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer and argues against classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HRS cells are CD20-negative or only weakly positive in a minority of cells, with CD15 positivity and weak PAX5.
Scattered large CD20+ B cells in a T-cell and histiocyte background but typically EBER-negative, forming nodal or systemic disease rather than a localized ulcer.
Strongly CD20+ LP cells sit within nodules of small B cells with CD21+ meshworks and are EBER-negative.

61266.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指是一大片細胞質淡藍、界線不清的細胞群，裡面散布十多個圓至橢圓、偏心、染色質呈網狀並有小核仁的單核；和周邊的顆粒球、紅血球比起來細胞明顯較大，這是造骨細胞（osteoblast）成群排列的典型樣子。
features: Sheet-like cluster of large cells with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders (arrow)
Single round to oval nuclei, eccentrically placed, with reticular/stippled chromatin and small nucleoli
Nuclei evenly spaced and fairly uniform in size without molding or significant pleomorphism
Surrounding normal marrow elements: myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils and a degranulated/crushed cell
Eyepiece photograph with background red cells; perinuclear Golgi zone not clearly resolved
61266.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows, at the arrow, a cohesive sheet of large mononuclear cells with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and indistinct borders. The nuclei are round to oval, eccentric and uniform, with reticular chromatin and small nucleoli, without nuclear molding or atypia. The surrounding marrow contains maturing granulocytes at various stages. Findings are consistent with a cluster of osteoblasts, a normal marrow constituent that is more frequent in children and in areas of active bone remodeling.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Malignant clusters show nuclear pleomorphism, molding, high N:C ratio and coarse or irregular chromatin, unlike the uniform eccentric nuclei here.
Plasma cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm, clock-face chromatin and a hof abutting the nucleus, and are smaller.
An osteoclast is a single giant cell with multiple nuclei in shared granular cytoplasm rather than a group of separate mononuclear cells.
Histiocytes have bean-shaped nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm with phagocytosed debris.

exam.answer_en: Osteoblast cluster in bone marrow aspirate — sheet of large cells with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and uniform eccentric nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指一大片細胞，考官問「這是轉移癌嗎？」答：否，是 osteoblasts；核一致、無塑形或多形性。
Osteoblast 與漿細胞比較：osteoblast 較大、染色質網狀細緻、核仁小、Golgi 區遠離核；漿細胞較小、車輪狀染色質、hof 緊貼核。
Osteoblast 常與 osteoclast 同時出現；兒童、青少年及代謝性骨病（如副甲狀腺機能亢進、骨折後）時較多。
若懷疑轉移腫瘤，應以骨髓切片與 IHC（cytokeratin 等）確認，抹片中的單一細胞團不宜單憑型態下診斷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 成片大細胞易被誤判為轉移性癌或 small round blue cell tumor；osteoblast 核大小一致、間距平均、細胞質豐富，腫瘤則有核重疊、塑形、多形性與高核質比。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指的細胞群最可能是什麼？在哪個年齡層的骨髓抽吸最常見？
quiz.a: Osteoblasts（良性骨髓成分）；兒童與青少年

61202.recognize_zh: 血液抹片下方有一顆巨大血小板，大小與周圍紅血球相當，中央有紫紅色顆粒區、周邊為淡染透明區，旁邊中性球顆粒正常，這種紅血球大小的巨血小板是 Bernard-Soulier 症候群的典型表現。
features: Giant platelet approximately the size of adjacent red cells
Clustered central purple granules (granulomere) with a pale gray peripheral hyalomere
Band/segmented neutrophil with normal cytoplasmic granulation and no visible Döhle-like inclusions
Normocytic, normochromic red cells with central pallor
Low-resolution, enlarged image limits fine granule detail
61202.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high magnification shows a giant platelet comparable in size to the surrounding red cells, with a central aggregate of purple granules and a pale hyalomere. An adjacent neutrophil shows normal granulation without Döhle-like inclusions, and red cells are normocytic and normochromic. No platelet clumping is present in this field. Findings are consistent with macrothrombocytopenia as seen in Bernard-Soulier syndrome, confirmed by absent ristocetin-induced platelet agglutination that does not correct with normal plasma and decreased CD42b/CD42a expression by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Giant platelets occur with Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils and normal ristocetin agglutination.
Also shows large platelets and thrombocytopenia but has enhanced, not absent, low-dose ristocetin-induced aggregation due to gain-of-function GPIBA variants.
Large platelets are pale and agranular rather than containing a well-granulated granulomere.

exam.answer_en: Bernard-Soulier syndrome — red-cell-sized giant platelet with normal granules; neutrophil without Döhle-like inclusions
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指和紅血球一樣大的顆粒性細胞，問「這是什麼？」→ giant platelet；接著看旁邊中性球有沒有 Döhle-like inclusion，用來區分 BSS 與 MYH9-related disorder。
機轉與遺傳：GPIb-IX-V 複合體（vWF 受體）缺陷，致病基因 GP1BA、GP1BB、GP9，典型為體染色體隱性。
血小板功能：ristocetin-induced platelet agglutination 缺失，且加入正常血漿無法矯正（vWD 可矯正）；對 ADP、collagen、epinephrine 聚集正常。Flow 顯示 CD42b、CD42a 減少。
Impedance 血球計數儀會把巨大血小板算成紅血球而低估血小板數；常被誤診為 ITP 而接受不必要的類固醇或脾切除。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 MYH9-related disorder：兩者都有巨大血小板，但 MYH9 的中性球胞質有淡藍 Döhle-like inclusion 且 ristocetin 反應正常；本圖中性球顆粒正常、無包涵體，較支持 BSS。

quiz.q: 圖中巨大血小板的病人做 ristocetin 聚集試驗會有什麼結果？加正常血漿能否矯正？
quiz.a: Ristocetin 誘導的聚集缺失；加入正常血漿無法矯正（缺陷在血小板 GPIb-IX-V）

61138.recognize_zh: 抹片中大量破碎紅血球（schistocytes）與小型紅血球碎片，但真正的血小板幾乎看不到；病人血小板直方圖沒有正常峰、曲線一路往大體積端上升，RBC 直方圖左側出現小碎片肩部，代表儀器把紅血球碎片誤算成血小板。
features: Platelet histogram (A): absence of a normal platelet peak with a continuously rising curve toward the upper threshold, unlike the normal right-skewed peak (B)
RBC histogram (C): small left-sided shoulder of small particles compared with the normal RBC curve (D)
Smear (E): numerous schistocytes including helmet cells, triangular and irregular fragments, and microspherocytes
Marked paucity of true platelets on the smear
Occasional polychromatophilic red cells; a single leukocyte and a small dark nucleated cell are present
61138.describe_en: Composite figure. The patient's platelet volume histogram lacks a discrete platelet population and instead shows a steadily rising curve extending into the larger-volume range, while the red cell histogram shows a left shoulder of small particles. The corresponding peripheral blood smear shows numerous schistocytes, including helmet and triangular forms and microspherocytes, with occasional polychromatophilic cells, and true platelets are markedly decreased. Findings indicate that small red cell fragments are being counted as platelets by the impedance analyzer, spuriously elevating the automated platelet count and masking severe thrombocytopenia; confirm by smear review, optical/fluorescent or immunologic platelet count, and evaluate for a thrombotic microangiopathy.

ddx.dx: Microcytosis (e.g., severe iron deficiency, thalassemia) causing pseudo-normal platelet count
ddx.vs: Microcytic red cells shift the RBC curve globally leftward and on smear are intact hypochromic cells rather than fragmented helmet and triangular forms.

ddx.dx: Giant platelets or platelet clumping causing falsely low counts
ddx.vs: Those produce spuriously low counts with clumps or large platelets visible on the smear, the opposite direction of error from fragment interference.
Morphology is shared; separation requires PT/aPTT/fibrinogen/D-dimer, ADAMTS13 activity and clinical context.

exam.answer_en: Spurious platelet count from red cell fragments — schistocytes counted as platelets (abnormal PLT/RBC histograms) masking severe thrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 判讀方式：正常血小板直方圖是右偏的單峰並於上閾值前回到基線；本例曲線無峰且持續上升到上閾值，同時 RBC 直方圖左側出現小顆粒肩部，提示紅血球碎片或小紅血球干擾計數。
原理：impedance 法依體積計數，約 2–20 fL 範圍內的顆粒皆計為血小板；schistocytes、microspherocytes、極小紅血球會使血小板數假性偏高，巨大血小板或聚集則使其假性偏低。
處置：出現 histogram flag 時必須看抹片，並以 optical（PLT-O）、fluorescent（PLT-F）或 immunoplatelet（CD61）計數確認真實血小板數。
臨床急症連結：大量 schistocytes 加嚴重血小板低應立即評估 TMA，檢查 ADAMTS13 活性、LDH、haptoglobin、網狀紅血球與凝血功能；疑 TTP 時不應等報告才開始 plasma exchange。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被忽略的陷阱是只看自動血小板數：碎片被計入後數值看似正常或僅輕度下降，延誤 TTP/DIC 診斷；需對照直方圖與抹片中真實血小板極少的事實。

quiz.q: 本例 impedance 血小板數會高估還是低估？原因為何？
quiz.a: 高估；紅血球碎片體積落在血小板計數範圍而被算成血小板

61074.recognize_zh: 一個未變大的紅血球內含兩個由藍色細胞質環與紅紫色染色質點構成的小環狀體（ring form），同一紅血球多重感染，周圍紅血球正常，符合惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）型態。
features: Single infected red cell that is not enlarged relative to neighboring cells
Two delicate ring-form trophozoites within the same red cell (multiple infection), each with a thin blue cytoplasmic ring and small red-purple chromatin dot
No Schuffner stippling, pigment, or mature trophozoites/schizonts visible in this field
Remaining red cells normocytic without other inclusions; a small platelet nearby
Parasitemia cannot be estimated from this single high-power field
61074.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows a normal-sized red cell containing two small, delicate ring-form trophozoites with thin cytoplasm and discrete chromatin dots. The infected cell is not enlarged and lacks stippling, and no gametocytes, schizonts or pigment are seen in this field. Surrounding red cells are unremarkable. In a traveler returning from Africa with cyclic fever, findings are consistent with malaria, with multiply infected non-enlarged red cells favoring Plasmodium falciparum; species confirmation and parasitemia quantification on thick and thin films or antigen testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Babesia rings are more pleomorphic, lack pigment and gametocytes, and may form tetrad (Maltese cross) arrangements, with tick exposure rather than travel to endemic malaria areas.
Vivax and ovale infect enlarged red cells with Schuffner dots and thicker, amoeboid trophozoites, and multiple rings per cell are uncommon.
A superimposed platelet shows granular purple content without a ring-shaped cytoplasm and differs in focal plane from the red cell.
Early knowlesi rings mimic falciparum, but later band forms resemble P. malariae and the exposure is Southeast Asia rather than Africa.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum malaria — multiple delicate ring forms within a single non-enlarged red cell
pearls_zh: 考法：指著含兩個環狀體的紅血球問物種；falciparum 線索：細小環、雙染色質點、單一紅血球多重感染、accolé form、紅血球不變大。
falciparum 周邊血通常只見 ring 與香蕉形 gametocyte；成熟滋養體與 schizont 因 cytoadherence 滯留於微血管。
厚片用於偵測（敏感度高），薄片用於物種鑑定與 parasitemia 計算；高寄生率為重症瘧疾指標之一。
重症瘧疾首選 IV artesunate；falciparum 可致腦性瘧、嚴重貧血、低血糖、急性腎損傷與 ARDS。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Babesia；Babesia 環狀體更多形、可見 Maltese cross 四聯體、無瘧色素與 gametocyte，病史為壁蝨暴露而非瘧疾流行區旅遊。

quiz.q: 非洲返國發燒病人，一個未變大的紅血球內含兩個細小環狀體，最可能是哪一種瘧原蟲？
quiz.a: Plasmodium falciparum

61010.recognize_zh: 腰椎矢狀面 MRI：一節椎體訊號明顯且不均勻地變亮，其餘多節椎體呈斑駁（patchy）訊號變化，代表骨髓被瀰漫或斑塊狀浸潤，在貧血合併背痛的病人需考慮骨髓瘤。
features: Sagittal MRI of the lumbar spine
One vertebral body with diffuse, heterogeneous (speckled) high signal replacing normal marrow
Adjacent vertebral bodies with mottled/patchy signal heterogeneity
Vertebral body heights and intervertebral discs grossly preserved in this view; no obvious large soft-tissue mass
Subcutaneous and posterior fat appear bright, so this particular frame appears T1-weighted rather than fat-suppressed STIR
61010.describe_en: Sagittal MRI of the lumbar spine shows diffuse heterogeneous signal change within one vertebral body and patchy, mottled signal abnormalities in several other lumbar vertebrae, indicating marrow replacement. Vertebral heights appear largely preserved without an obvious compression fracture or paraspinal mass in this single slice. Note that fat in the subcutaneous and posterior soft tissues is bright, so this frame looks T1-weighted rather than the STIR sequence stated in the caption; sequence identity should be confirmed. In the clinical context of anemia and low back pain, a diffuse/variegated marrow infiltration pattern is suggestive of plasma cell myeloma and should be correlated with SPEP and marrow biopsy.

ddx.vs: Metastases usually produce discrete focal lesions often involving pedicles, and require biopsy with epithelial markers to separate from myeloma.
Hemangiomas show T1 and T2 hyperintensity with vertical coarse trabeculae and are solitary incidental lesions, not multilevel patchy changes with anemia.
Reconversion is usually symmetric and follows normal marrow distribution without lesions brighter than disc on STIR; marrow biopsy resolves uncertainty.

60946.recognize_zh: 血片中許多橢圓形與大橢圓形紅血球，部分細胞中央有一至數條橫向裂隙或脊（stomatocytic ovalocytes），加上 Advia 細胞圖呈高血紅素濃度的逗號形分布，符合東南亞卵圓形紅血球症（SAO）。
features: Oval and macro-ovalocytic red cells with anisopoikilocytosis
Some ovalocytes with one or more transverse slits/ridges (stomatocytic ovalocytes)
No spherocytes; no significant polychromasia in these fields
Analyzer volume vs hemoglobin concentration cytograms: comma-shaped cloud shifted toward high hemoglobin concentration (hyperchromic cells)
60946.describe_en: Advia RBC volume/hemoglobin concentration cytograms from three patients show a comma-shaped distribution with an increased population of hyperchromic red cells. Corresponding peripheral blood smears show anisopoikilocytosis with numerous ovalocytes and macro-ovalocytes, several of which contain one or more transverse slits or ridges, without spherocytes. Findings are suggestive of Southeast Asian ovalocytosis, to be confirmed by reduced eosin-5'-maleimide binding and the SLC4A1 27-bp (9-amino-acid) deletion.

ddx.vs: HE cells are thin elongated elliptocytes without central transverse slits, and red cells are not rigid macro-ovalocytes.
Stomatocytes are round cells with a single mouth-like slit rather than oval cells with multiple ridges, and EMA binding is typically normal.
HS shows spherocytes lacking central pallor, whereas SAO smears lack spherocytes despite both reducing EMA binding.
Megaloblastic macro-ovalocytes lack slits and are accompanied by hypersegmented neutrophils and high MCV.

exam.answer_en: Southeast Asian ovalocytosis — stomatocytic ovalocytes/macro-ovalocytes with transverse slits or bars, hyperchromic comma-shaped analyzer cytogram
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中央有一至兩條橫向裂隙或橫槓的卵圓形紅血球問名稱 → stomatocytic ovalocyte，是 SAO 的特徵；另可能給 Advia 細胞圖問高血紅素濃度族群的意義。
分子基礎：SLC4A1（band 3）27-bp 缺失（9 個胺基酸），幾乎都是異型合子；紅血球膜變硬。基因檢測可直接確診，EMA binding 常下降。
臨床：多數無症狀或僅輕微溶血，可有新生兒黃疸；在瘧疾流行區對嚴重（腦性）惡性瘧有保護作用，是族群篩選的典型例子。
東南亞族群常見，台灣新住民與移工族群血片也可能遇到；報告時描述形態並建議基因確認，避免不必要的溶血或脾切除評估。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤為 hereditary elliptocytosis：HE 為對稱橢圓或棒狀、無中央橫向裂隙，常有明顯溶血；SAO 為較寬的卵圓形並帶 1–2 條橫槓，溶血輕微。也勿與 megaloblastic macro-ovalocytes 混淆。

quiz.q: 圖中帶有中央橫向裂隙的卵圓形紅血球提示哪種遺傳疾病？其致病基因與突變型態為何？
quiz.a: Southeast Asian ovalocytosis；SLC4A1（band 3）27-bp 缺失

60882.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有兩個明顯比中性球大的細胞，核形不規則、有凹摺，胞質淡藍、邊緣帶有小而清楚的空泡，與周圍正常造血細胞形態格格不入，需懷疑轉移性腫瘤（此例為肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤）。
features: Two large atypical cells, roughly twice the size of adjacent neutrophils, with high N:C ratio
Irregular, folded/notched nuclei with finely granular deep-purple chromatin; nucleoli not clearly seen
Scant pale blue cytoplasm with small, discrete, clear marginal vacuoles
Adjacent basophil and maturing neutrophils/bands appear morphologically normal
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis
60882.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows two large atypical cells distinct from the background hematopoietic elements. They have irregular, folded nuclei with dense but finely granular chromatin and scant pale blue cytoplasm containing small clear vacuoles, most prominent at the cell periphery. Surrounding neutrophils, bands and a basophil appear unremarkable. The morphology alone is not lineage-specific and could be mistaken for blasts; in the clinical context and with corroborating biopsy immunohistochemistry, findings are consistent with metastatic alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia (monoblasts) or B-lymphoblastic leukemia
ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are discohesive and CD45/CD34/TdT or MPO positive by flow or cytochemistry, whereas rhabdomyosarcoma cells are CD45 negative and often form clumps; desmin/myogenin on the biopsy resolves this.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous sharply punched-out vacuoles and express CD19/CD10 with MYC rearrangement.
Neuroblastoma cells are smaller, form clumps or rosettes with fibrillary neuropil, and are CD56+/CD45- with PHOX2B and GD2 positivity.
Ewing cells show vacuolated (PAS+ glycogen) cytoplasm too, but are CD99/NKX2.2 positive and myogenin negative.

60818.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中造血細胞稀少，中央為數個大型多核細胞，其細胞核呈許多分開、大小一致的圓形核（separated nuclear lobes），胞質藍紫色；在 GATA2 缺乏症中這類核分離的異常巨核細胞是重要線索，但需與破骨細胞鑑別。
features: Paucicellular aspirate field with few hematopoietic cells and abundant red cells and fat vacuoles
Cluster of large multinucleated cells containing numerous widely separated, small, round, uniform nuclei
Abundant purple-blue, finely granular cytoplasm without pink osteoclast-type granules
Scattered small lymphocytes and few myeloid/erythroid precursors in the background
60818.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypocellular-appearing field with few hematopoietic precursors, scattered small lymphocytes and prominent fat vacuoles. A cluster of large multinucleated cells is present, each containing multiple widely separated, round, uniform nuclei within abundant purple-blue granular cytoplasm. These cells most likely represent dysplastic megakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes, although osteoclasts should be excluded by CD61 immunostaining. In a patient with marrow failure, these findings are suggestive of GATA2 deficiency-associated hypocellular marrow with megakaryocytic dysplasia; GATA2 sequencing, flow cytometry for monocytopenia and B/NK-cell deficiency, and cytogenetics are recommended.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have similar separated uniform nuclei but often show visible nucleoli, paler cytoplasm with fine pink-red granules and are CD61-negative/CD68-positive.
Acquired aplastic anemia is hypocellular without megakaryocytic dysplasia and lacks monocytopenia and B/NK lymphopenia typical of GATA2 deficiency.
Hypoplastic MDS also shows separated-lobe megakaryocytes and requires cytogenetic/molecular clonality, with germline GATA2 testing to identify predisposition.

60626.recognize_zh: 抹片中許多缺乏中央淡染區的小而深染球形紅血球，並可見兩顆球形紅血球互相黏貼成「成對」（箭頭），背景另有多染性大紅血球，符合自體免疫溶血性貧血。
features: Numerous small, dense, round red cells lacking central pallor (spherocytes/microspherocytes)
Pairs of spherocytes adherent or overlapping to form 'doublets' (arrows), reflecting antibody-mediated red cell agglutination
Admixed larger, slightly bluish polychromatophilic red cells indicating reticulocytosis
Moderate anisocytosis with occasional teardrop/elongated forms, likely partly smear artifact
Scattered neutrophils without significant abnormality; platelets present
60626.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisocytosis with many spherocytes and microspherocytes that lack central pallor. Several spherocytes are closely apposed in pairs, forming doublets (arrows), a pattern that suggests red cell agglutination by antibody. Larger polychromatophilic red cells are present, consistent with a reticulocyte response. No schistocytes or red cell inclusions are evident. Findings are suggestive of autoimmune (warm) hemolytic anemia; a direct antiglobulin test is recommended.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes are also present, but HS is DAT negative with a family history and does not typically show antibody-mediated doublets/agglutinates.
Cold agglutinins produce larger irregular clumps of red cells that disperse on warming, rather than scattered doublet spherocytes.
Rouleaux are linear stacks of normal-shaped discocytes like coins, not paired spherocytes lacking central pallor.
MAHA shows schistocytes (helmet cells, fragments) and thrombocytopenia rather than predominant intact spherocytes.

exam.answer_en: Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia (suggested) — numerous spherocytes forming adherent doublets with polychromasia; DAT required
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指兩顆黏在一起、無中央淡染區的小深染紅血球，問名稱（doublet spherocytes）與意義——抗體導致紅血球凝集，提示 immune hemolysis 而非 HS。
必做檢查：direct antiglobulin test（warm AIHA 多為 IgG ± C3）、LDH↑、haptoglobin↓、間接膽紅素↑、reticulocyte↑；osmotic fragility 在 AIHA 與 HS 都會升高，不能用來區分。
病因篩檢：warm AIHA 約半數為 secondary——CLL 等淋巴增生疾病、SLE、藥物、免疫缺陷；應做 flow、ANA 等。
治療：第一線為 corticosteroids，常早期合併 rituximab；嚴重貧血仍可輸血（可能不相容也不應延誤）；溶血病人應補充 folic acid。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 hereditary spherocytosis：兩者都有 spherocytes 與 polychromasia，但 HS 為 DAT 陰性、有家族史、EMA binding test 異常，且通常不見抗體介導的 doublets；AIHA 為 DAT 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中成對黏附的球形紅血球提示何種機轉？下一步最關鍵的檢查為何？
quiz.a: 抗體介導的紅血球凝集/免疫性溶血；direct antiglobulin test（DAT, Coombs test）。

60690.recognize_zh: 兩顆已成熟、核分成 3–4 葉的嗜中性球，其中下方細胞的淡粉紅細胞質內可見細長針狀的 Auer 小體；成熟嗜中性球帶有 Auer 小體，提示 APL 經全反式維甲酸（ATRA）誘導分化後的表現。
features: Two mature neutrophils with 3–4 segmented nuclear lobes and condensed chromatin
Slender needle-like Auer rods within the pale pink cytoplasm of the lower neutrophil (two to three rods)
Cytoplasm with sparse fine granulation; no hypergranular promyelocyte features
Background red cells normocytic with a few stomatocyte-like forms; scattered platelets
60690.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mature segmented neutrophils with condensed chromatin and pale cytoplasm. One neutrophil contains several slender cytoplasmic Auer rods, and no abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes are present in this field. Auer rods are normally confined to blasts and abnormal promyelocytes, and their presence in terminally differentiated neutrophils indicates maturation of the leukemic clone. Findings are consistent with differentiation of acute promyelocytic leukemia cells following all-trans retinoic acid therapy.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation (Auer rods in maturing cells)
ddx.vs: Dysplastic maturing neutrophils with Auer rods can occur in AML with t(8;21) or MDS, so treatment history and PML::RARA status are needed to separate them.
Döhle bodies are pale blue irregular patches at the cytoplasmic periphery, not sharp needle-shaped azurophilic rods.
Phagocytosed crystals are usually refractile, variable in shape and seen in many cells, whereas Auer rods are uniform azurophilic MPO-positive rods.
Platelets are granular and lie in a different plane, whereas Auer rods are thin, linear and intracytoplasmic.

60434.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下淋巴結被模糊的大結節取代，結節內深藍色小淋巴球之間散布大量不規則的淡粉紅色小區塊（由組織球與 LP 細胞構成），使結節看起來像被蟲蛀過的「蛀蝕狀（moth-eaten）」外觀，是 NLPHL 的低倍線索。
features: Effacement of lymph node architecture by vague, large, poorly demarcated nodules
Nodules composed of dark small lymphocytes interrupted by numerous irregular pale pink patches, giving a moth-eaten appearance
Pale areas correspond to clusters of epithelioid histiocytes and scattered large cells (not resolvable at this power)
No sclerotic bands, necrosis, or residual normal follicles with polarized germinal centers
Cytologic detail of LP cells cannot be evaluated at this magnification
60434.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows effacement of the normal architecture by vague, large nodules. The nodules consist of sheets of small dark lymphocytes interspersed with numerous irregular pale areas, producing a mottled, moth-eaten appearance; there are no fibrous bands, necrosis or normal polarized germinal centers. The pale foci likely represent histiocytes and scattered large neoplastic cells, which require higher magnification and immunohistochemistry (CD20, OCT2, CD21, PD-1) to confirm. The pattern is suggestive of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: NSCHL has nodules delineated by broad collagen bands with lacunar HRS cells in a mixed inflammatory background, which are absent here.
FL shows more numerous, uniform, crowded follicles lacking mantle zones, without the mottled histiocyte-rich pale patches.
THRLBCL has a diffuse rather than nodular pattern with histiocytes and rare large B cells, lacking small B-cell-rich nodules and CD21 meshworks.
PTGC nodules are few and admixed with reactive follicles, and lack LP cells and the moth-eaten histiocytic pattern.

60370.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成群的中大型芽細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻均勻、細胞質少且呈淡藍色無顆粒，並伴隨許多被擠壓破裂的 smudge 細胞，符合淋巴芽細胞（relapsed B-ALL）。
features: Clusters of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with fine, homogeneous chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous to small
Scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Numerous smudged/crushed cells with streaked nuclear chromatin
Normal hematopoietic precursors not evident in this field
60370.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cohesive-appearing clusters of medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not seen. Numerous smudge cells are present, and residual normal hematopoietic elements are not evident in this field. In conjunction with the CD34+, TdT+, CD79a+, CD10+ immunophenotype, findings are consistent with relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Agranular AML blasts can look identical; MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117 expression and absence of B-lineage markers separate them.
Morphologically indistinguishable; cytoplasmic CD3 positivity without CD79a/CD19 defines T lineage.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are TdT-/CD34- with surface light chain.
Hematogones are smaller with homogeneous condensed chromatin, lack nucleoli and do not form a dominant population.

exam.answer_en: Relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia — marrow replaced by agranular high N:C blasts with fine chromatin and smudge cells; lineage (CD19/CD10/CD79a/TdT/CD34+) set by flow
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著無顆粒、核質比高、染色質細緻的芽細胞問「myeloid 還是 lymphoid？」——形態無法判定 lineage，答案必須是 flow cytometry（B lineage：CD19、cCD79a、CD10、TdT）與 MPO 陰性。
復發 ALL 必考：若曾接受 blinatumomab 或 CD19 CAR-T，復發可能為 CD19-negative（antigen escape），flow gating 不能只靠 CD19，需用 CD22、CD24、cCD79a 等輔助。
復發時要重新做細胞遺傳/分子（BCR::ABL1、KMT2A 重排、Ph-like 病變、TP53），可能出現新的 clonal evolution，並影響 TKI 或標靶治療選擇。
MRD（flow 或 NGS/PCR）是 ALL 最重要的預後因子之一；追蹤 MRD 時要注意 hematogones 與殘存 blast 的表型差異（hematogones 呈連續成熟光譜）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 AML with minimal differentiation 或 hematogones；AML 需 MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117 陽性，hematogones 較小、染色質緻密且 flow 呈正常成熟曲線，不會形成單一取代骨髓的族群。

quiz.q: 圖中這群無顆粒、核質比高的芽細胞，要確定是 B-ALL 復發，最關鍵的下一步檢查是什麼？若病人曾接受 CD19 CAR-T 要注意什麼？
quiz.a: Flow cytometry 免疫表型（CD19、CD10、cCD79a、TdT、CD34；MPO 陰性）；注意 CD19-negative relapse，需用 CD22/cCD79a 等其他 B 標記 gating。

60178.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片以大片脂肪為主，造血細胞只占約10–20%，夾在骨小樑之間的脂肪空隙中仍可見三系造血與少數巨核細胞；低細胞性骨髓發育不良（hypocellular MDS）要與再生不良性貧血區分，此倍率下難以評估巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Markedly hypocellular marrow (approximately 10–20% cellularity) dominated by adipocytes
Residual hematopoietic cells in thin cords between fat cells, with trilineage representation
A few megakaryocytes present, some appearing small with compact nuclei (dysplasia difficult to assess at this power)
Bony trabeculae at left and right with normal lamellar appearance
No fibrosis, lymphoid aggregates, granulomas or blast clusters evident
60178.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows a hypocellular marrow for age, with approximately 10–20% cellularity between intact bony trabeculae. Residual hematopoiesis is trilineage and arranged in thin interstitial cords, with scattered megakaryocytes, some of which appear small. No fibrosis, lymphoid aggregates, or clusters of immature cells are seen. Megakaryocytic dysplasia is better assessed at higher power and on aspirate smears; in that context, the findings are consistent with a hypocellular myelodysplastic syndrome (refractory cytopenia with unilineage dysplasia).

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia has markedly reduced or absent megakaryocytes without dysplasia, whereas hypocellular MDS retains megakaryocytes with dysplastic forms and may show clusters of CD34-positive cells.
Elderly marrow may be fatty, but without peripheral cytopenias or dysplastic megakaryocytes.
Hypoplastic AML shows ≥20% blasts among the residual cells, usually identifiable as CD34-positive clusters.
Therapy-related hypoplasia has a history of exposure, often serous fat atrophy and regenerative foci, and recovers over time.

60114.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中 CD45 dim/低側散射的芽細胞群占 77%，CD3 與 CD7 同時強陽性、CD5 陽性，而 CD19、CD10、CD34、CD4、CD8 皆陰性；T 系抗原加上芽細胞閘門位置即可判讀為 T 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: CD45 vs SSC plot: dominant blast gate (77.17%) with dim-to-moderate CD45 and low side scatter
Blasts are CD3+ and CD7+ (bright co-expression) and CD5+
CD19 and CD10 negative, excluding B-lineage
CD34 negative; CD4 and CD8 double negative
CD2 largely negative with a minor positive subset
Per the legend, TdT negative and HLA-DR positive
60114.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the bone marrow aspirate shows a dominant population (77%) in the CD45 dim-to-moderate, low side-scatter blast region, with a reduced granulocyte population. The blasts express CD3 (surface and cytoplasmic per legend), CD7 and CD5, with CD2 largely negative, and lack CD19, CD10, CD34, CD4 and CD8. TdT is reported negative and HLA-DR positive, an unusual combination for T-lineage blasts. The immunophenotype is consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia; the TdT/CD34-negative, CD1a-unknown profile warrants exclusion of a mature T-cell neoplasm by blast morphology and additional markers (CD1a, CD99).

ddx.vs: Mature T-cell neoplasms are CD45 bright, TdT/CD34/CD1a negative and usually CD4+ or CD8+, whereas these cells sit in the CD45-dim blast gate with blast morphology.
ETP-ALL requires CD1a-/CD8-, CD5 dim/negative (<75%) and stem/myeloid marker expression (CD34, HLA-DR, CD13, CD33, CD117); the bright CD5 here argues against it.
MPAL T/myeloid requires MPO or monocytic differentiation in addition to cytoplasmic CD3, which is not shown.
B-ALL blasts are CD19+ and usually CD10+ and cCD3-negative, the opposite of this profile.

30482.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片低倍即可見許多帶不規則尖刺的棘狀紅血球（acanthocytes），高倍下部分紅血球含單一深紫小點（Howell-Jolly 小體），並有標靶細胞與凹陷紅血球，這組合提示功能性脾功能低下。
features: Numerous acanthocytes with few irregular spicules of variable length
Occasional Howell-Jolly bodies as small round dense purple inclusions in red cells
Scattered target cells and red cells with irregular pallor/pits
Largely normocytic red cells with preserved central pallor in most cells
Adequate platelets; a small lymphocyte in the field
30482.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa; low and high power) shows a prominent population of acanthocytes with irregularly spaced spicules, together with scattered target cells and occasional red cells containing Howell-Jolly bodies. White cells present in the field appear morphologically unremarkable and platelets are adequate. There is no evidence of red cell agglutination or significant schistocytosis. Findings are consistent with hyposplenism; in a patient with an anatomically present spleen this indicates functional hyposplenism, which can be corroborated by pitted red cell counts or splenic imaging.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, evenly spaced regular projections around the whole cell, whereas acanthocytes have few irregular spicules of unequal length.

ddx.dx: Liver disease with spur cell anemia
ddx.vs: Spur cell anemia shows acanthocytes with hemolysis in advanced cirrhosis but no Howell-Jolly bodies unless the spleen is also nonfunctional.
These produce nearly uniform acanthocytosis with low lipids or neurologic disease and lack Howell-Jolly bodies.
The blood film is identical, and only history or imaging distinguishes absence of the spleen from a present but nonfunctional spleen.

exam.answer_en: Functional hyposplenism — acanthocytes, target cells and Howell–Jolly bodies on blood film
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會分別指棘狀紅血球、標靶細胞與 Howell-Jolly body，問「這三者一起出現代表什麼器官功能異常」；答脾臟功能低下（hyposplenism）。
脾低下抹片組合：Howell-Jolly bodies（最常用）、acanthocytes、target cells、Pappenheimer bodies、nucleated RBC，並可見血小板與淋巴球增加。
確認方法：干涉相差顯微鏡計數 pitted（pocked）red cells，或以 99mTc 標記受熱紅血球掃描評估脾臟攝取；脾臟影像存在不等於功能正常。
臨床：常見於 celiac disease、sickle cell disease、慢性 GVHD、SLE、酒精性肝病；需莢膜菌疫苗接種並教育發燒時就醫。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 acanthocyte 誤認為 echinocyte（burr cell）：echinocyte 有 10–30 個短而規則、均勻分布的突起，多為製片假象或尿毒；acanthocyte 突起少、長短不一且分布不規則。

quiz.q: 抹片同時出現 acanthocytes、target cells 與 Howell-Jolly bodies，但影像上脾臟仍存在，應診斷什麼？
quiz.a: Functional hyposplenism（功能性脾臟低下）。

19922.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中聚集大量形態一致的中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質中度凝集，並有單一明顯的中央核仁與中等量淡藍色細胞質，佔滿視野的前淋巴球（prolymphocyte）支持前淋巴球白血病（PLL）。
features: Numerous monomorphic medium-sized lymphoid cells dominating the nucleated population
Moderate N:C ratio with a distinct rim of pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Single conspicuous central nucleolus in most cells
No small mature lymphocyte background or smudge cells in this field; red cells and platelets unremarkable
19922.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a monomorphic population of medium-sized lymphoid cells, about twice the size of red cells, with round to oval nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, a single prominent central nucleolus, and moderate pale-blue agranular cytoplasm. No background of small mature lymphocytes, smudge cells, hairy projections, or cytoplasmic vacuoles is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a prolymphocytic proliferation (prolymphocytic leukemia); lineage assignment by flow cytometry and exclusion of leukemic mantle cell lymphoma by cyclin D1/t(11;14) studies are required.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma may show identical nucleolated cells and is separated by CD5 expression with cyclin D1/SOX11 positivity and t(11;14).
T-PLL cells often have cytoplasmic blebs and smaller nucleoli and express T-cell antigens (CD3, CD7, often CD4) with inv(14)/t(14;14) TCL1A rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: These cells have prominent nucleoli but also villous or hairy cytoplasmic projections, lack CD25/annexin A1, and are BRAF V600E negative.
CLL retains a population of small lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and smudge cells and has fewer than 55% prolymphocytes.

exam.answer_en: Prolymphocytic leukemia — monomorphic medium-sized lymphoid cells with a single prominent central nucleolus dominating the smear
pearls_zh: 考法：血片幾乎全是帶明顯中央核仁的中型淋巴樣細胞，考官問「診斷與下一步」；答案：prolymphocytic proliferation，先做 flow 分 B 或 T 系。
T-PLL：多為 CD4+CD8−（也可雙陽或 CD8+）、CD7 強表現；TCL1A 重排（inv(14)/t(14;14)）或 MTCP1（t(X;14)）；常見於 ataxia-telangiectasia；一線治療常用 alemtuzumab。
B 系：WHO 5th 不再列 B-PLL，須排除 cyclin D1/t(11;14) 陽性的 MCL 與 CLL prolymphocytic progression；ICC 2022 仍保留 B-PLL（prolymphocytes >55%）。
臨床：典型為高淋巴球計數、明顯脾腫大，淋巴結腫大較少，病程較 CLL 進展快。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最重要的陷阱是 leukemic mantle cell lymphoma 的 prolymphocytoid 變異型，形態幾乎相同；必須以 cyclin D1 IHC 或 t(11;14) FISH 排除，不能只憑形態下 PLL 診斷。

quiz.q: 血片如圖以帶單一中央核仁的中型淋巴樣細胞為主，flow 顯示 CD4+、CD7 強陽性的 T 細胞，最可能的診斷與典型基因異常為何？
quiz.a: T-prolymphocytic leukemia；TCL1A 重排（inv(14) 或 t(14;14)）。

15122.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片左下方為成片大型組織球，細胞質豐富淡粉紅、呈皺紙樣（wrinkled tissue paper）紋理、核小偏位，即高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cells，箭頭）；右上方則為密集的小型深染未成熟細胞取代正常造血，對應高雪氏症合併急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, finely striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei (Gaucher cells, arrows)
Gaucher cells occupy the left and lower portions of the field
Separate densely cellular area of small to medium cells with dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm, consistent with an immature myeloid infiltrate
Scattered erythroid/red cell elements and fat spaces between the two components
Blast cytology cannot be fully assessed at this magnification
15122.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows two distinct components. Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm having a fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' texture and small eccentric nuclei are present in the lower and left portions of the field (arrows), consistent with Gaucher cells. The remaining marrow space is replaced by a dense infiltrate of small to medium-sized cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm, suggestive of an immature myeloid (blast) population, although cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Gaucher disease with concomitant acute myeloid leukemia, as stated in the legend; blast enumeration on the aspirate and immunohistochemistry (CD34, CD117, MPO) would be needed for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma or other high-turnover disorders
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look identical, but they occur in the setting of the underlying neoplasm with normal glucocerebrosidase activity, whereas true Gaucher disease shows low enzyme activity and GBA1 mutations.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial infection with foamy histiocytes (e.g., MAI in HIV)
ddx.vs: Infected histiocytes have a similar striated cytoplasm but contain acid-fast bacilli on AFB/Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Niemann-Pick cells have bubbly vacuolated, lipid-laden cytoplasm rather than fibrillary wrinkled-paper texture, and filipin/sphingomyelinase testing differs.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive, cytokeratin-positive and CD68-negative, unlike CD68-positive Gaucher cells.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher disease with concurrent AML — sheets of wrinkled-tissue-paper Gaucher cells beside a dense infiltrate of immature blasts
pearls_zh: 考法：一張切片兩種成分，考官先指箭頭問 Gaucher cell，再問旁邊密集小圓細胞是什麼；兩者都要答出來，不要只看到儲積細胞。
Gaucher disease：GBA1 變異致 glucocerebrosidase 缺乏、glucosylceramide 堆積於巨噬細胞；Gaucher cell PAS 陽性、TRAP 陽性，確診靠酵素活性與基因檢測。
血液腫瘤關聯：Gaucher disease 病人發生 MGUS 與 multiple myeloma 的風險增加；其他血液惡性腫瘤亦有報告，出現無法解釋的血球變化或 blasts 時需做骨髓評估。
AML 確認需在抽吸抹片計數 blasts，並以 CD34、CD117、MPO IHC 與 flow 證實；同時要記得高轉換率腫瘤本身也會產生 pseudo-Gaucher cells。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 AML 或 CML 中的 pseudo-Gaucher cells 當成真正 Gaucher disease；型態相似，需以 glucocerebrosidase 活性與 GBA1 檢測區分，且本例要同時辨認旁邊的 blast 浸潤。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指胞質呈皺紙狀的大型組織球是什麼細胞？其缺乏的酵素為何？
quiz.a: Gaucher cell；glucocerebrosidase（β-glucosidase，GBA1）

1170.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有數個巨大的巨噬細胞，淡藍灰色細胞質布滿波浪狀纖維條紋，像揉皺的絲綢或皺紙（crumpled tissue paper），核小且偏位，夾雜在正常造血細胞之間，是高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）的典型外觀。
features: Multiple very large histiocytes with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Cytoplasm shows wavy fibrillary striations giving a crumpled tissue paper/wrinkled silk appearance
Small eccentric nuclei, often obscured by overlapping cells
Cells occur in loose aggregates among normal maturing myeloid and erythroid cells
Background fat vacuoles; no phagocytosed red cells
1170.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows mixed maturing hematopoietic cells together with several very large histiocytes containing abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with a wavy fibrillary, 'crumpled tissue paper' texture and small eccentric nuclei. The histiocytes occur singly and in loose aggregates and do not show hemophagocytosis. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells, supporting Gaucher disease; confirmation with glucocerebrosidase activity and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, atypical mycobacteria)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are nearly identical on Wright stain but occur with a primary neoplasm or infection and normal enzyme activity.
These histiocytes show foamy soap-bubble vacuoles or sea-blue granules rather than fibrillary striations.

ddx.dx: Crushed megakaryocytes or smeared stromal cells
ddx.vs: Crushed cells produce streaked nuclear chromatin without intact cell borders or small eccentric nuclei within striated cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher disease — several Gaucher cells with wavy fibrillary crumpled-tissue-paper cytoplasm among normal marrow cells
pearls_zh: 考法：抽吸抹片上數個大型組織球成群出現，問「這些細胞代表什麼疾病、下一步怎麼確診」→ Gaucher disease，驗 glucocerebrosidase 活性與 GBA1。
型別：type 1（非神經型）最常見，常在 Ashkenazi 族群見到 N370S（N409S）變異；type 2 為急性嬰兒神經型、type 3 為亞急性神經型。
血液表現：脾功能亢進與骨髓浸潤造成血小板低下與貧血，常以脾腫大、血小板低下或出血首先就診，易被當成 ITP 或淋巴瘤轉介血液科。
與 Niemann-Pick 區分：Niemann-Pick（SMPD1，sphingomyelin 堆積）為泡沫狀空泡胞質的 foam cell 或 sea-blue histiocyte，而非纖維條紋。
exam.pitfall_zh: 抹片推擠破壞的 megakaryocyte 或間質細胞可呈大片淡染胞質而被誤認；Gaucher cell 有完整細胞邊界、小偏位核與一致的纖維條紋胞質。

quiz.q: 脾腫大合併血小板低下，骨髓見這些皺紙狀胞質的組織球，確診應做哪兩項檢查？
quiz.a: Glucocerebrosidase 酵素活性與 GBA1 基因檢測

2962.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球系停在前骨髓細胞（promyelocyte）與骨髓細胞階段，可見許多帶顆粒、有核周淡染區的大型前骨髓細胞，卻幾乎沒有桿狀核或分葉中性球，並伴隨嗜酸性前驅細胞與單核球，符合 Kostmann 症候群（嚴重先天性中性球減少症）的成熟停滯。
features: Granulocytic maturation arrest at the promyelocyte/myelocyte stage
Numerous large promyelocytes with azurophilic granules, eccentric nuclei, and perinuclear hof
Marked paucity of band and segmented neutrophils
Eosinophilic precursors with orange granules and scattered monocytes
Preserved erythroid precursors (small dark round nuclei) and lymphocytes
No increase in agranular blasts or Auer rods
2962.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with a granulocytic series that shows maturation arrest at the promyelocyte to myelocyte stage; promyelocytes with azurophilic granules and perinuclear hofs are numerous, whereas bands and segmented neutrophils are nearly absent. Eosinophilic precursors and monocytes are readily seen, and erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are present. Blasts are not increased and Auer rods are not identified. In an infant with severe chronic neutropenia, findings are consistent with severe congenital neutropenia (Kostmann syndrome); ELANE/HAX1 testing and surveillance for MDS/AML are recommended.

ddx.vs: APL shows sheets of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and faggot cells and PML::RARA, rather than a mixed marrow with arrest and preserved erythropoiesis.

ddx.dx: Marrow recovery after chemotherapy, infection, or G-CSF
ddx.vs: Regeneration shows a transient promyelocyte wave that matures to neutrophils on follow-up, without persistent congenital neutropenia.
Immune neutropenia usually shows normal or increased maturation up to bands with late-stage destruction and positive antineutrophil antibodies.
Clonal evolution shows increased blasts, dysplasia, and acquired CSF3R, monosomy 7, or RUNX1 abnormalities.

exam.answer_en: Severe congenital neutropenia (Kostmann syndrome) — marrow maturation arrest at promyelocyte/myelocyte stage, near absence of bands and neutrophils, eosinophilia and monocytosis
pearls_zh: 考法：問骨髓顆粒球系「停在哪個階段」→ promyelocyte/myelocyte；再注意伴隨的嗜酸性前驅細胞與單核球增加，是 SCN 的常見背景。
遺傳：最常見為 ELANE 變異（體染色體顯性）；Kostmann 原始家族為 HAX1（體染色體隱性），其他包括 G6PC3、GFI1 等。
治療：G-CSF 為主要治療，多數病人 ANC 可回升；對高劑量 G-CSF 無反應者應考慮異體造血幹細胞移植。
惡性轉化：SCN 有進展為 MDS/AML 的長期風險，後天性 CSF3R 截斷突變常先出現，再加上 RUNX1 突變時風險升高，需定期監測血球與骨髓。
exam.pitfall_zh: 大量前骨髓細胞易被誤判為 APL；SCN 的前骨髓細胞型態正常、無 Auer rod 或 faggot cell、無凝血異常，且臨床為嬰兒期反覆嚴重細菌感染。

quiz.q: 嬰兒反覆嚴重細菌感染，骨髓顆粒球系停在前骨髓細胞階段，最常見的致病基因為何？主要治療為何？
quiz.a: ELANE；G-CSF

13266.recognize_zh: 低倍下是成片、黏合度差的大型異型細胞，核深染、不規則、有馬蹄形或腎形輪廓，部分腫瘤細胞的細胞質內可見被吞入的紅血球，符合間變性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）合併吞噬紅血球現象。
features: Diffuse sheets of large, discohesive pleomorphic cells
Hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei including kidney- and horseshoe-shaped forms
Moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Several tumor cells contain intracytoplasmic red cells (erythrophagocytosis)
Scattered extravasated red cells; no cohesive nests or glandular architecture
13266.describe_en: Section (H&E) shows effacement by diffuse sheets of large, discohesive, pleomorphic cells. The cells have hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei with frequent kidney- and horseshoe-shaped forms and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. Several tumor cells contain engulfed red cells. No cohesive nests or glands are identified. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma with tumor-cell erythrophagocytosis; confirmation with CD30, ALK, and T-cell/cytotoxic markers is required.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is CD20/PAX5-positive and usually lacks hallmark horseshoe nuclei and uniform strong membranous/Golgi CD30.
Histiocytic sarcoma has abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, expresses CD163/CD68 and lacks ALK and cytotoxic T-cell markers.
HLH phagocytes are bland histiocytes without the sheet-like atypical large-cell infiltrate seen here.
Carcinoma tends to form cohesive clusters and is keratin-positive, whereas ALCL is keratin-negative and CD30-positive.

3794.recognize_zh: 一顆大型組織球（巨噬細胞）的細胞質內包著十多顆完整、圓形深染的小核（被吞噬的淋巴球等有核細胞），自身核較大、染色較淡；這是噬血現象（hemophagocytosis），配合 CLL 背景提示 HLH。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale, finely vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm
More than ten engulfed intact round nucleated cells, mostly small lymphocyte-sized, within the cytoplasm
Macrophage nucleus larger and paler with open reticular chromatin
Adjacent granulocytes and small mature lymphocytes in the background
Well-preserved engulfed cells with dense chromatin
3794.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage containing numerous intact phagocytosed nucleated cells, predominantly small lymphocyte-sized cells with dense chromatin, within abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm. Background small mature lymphocytes and granulocytes are present. The finding represents hemophagocytosis; in a patient with CLL and compatible clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, hyperferritinemia, hypertriglyceridemia, elevated sCD25), this supports secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, although hemophagocytosis alone is neither sensitive nor specific.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis involves intact cells passing through a megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, not a histiocyte with a single oval nucleus.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are S100-positive and usually involve lymph nodes, while HLH macrophages are S100-negative and occur with systemic hyperinflammation.
Tingible body macrophages contain fragmented pyknotic apoptotic debris rather than multiple intact, well-preserved nucleated cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive hemophagocytosis after transfusion or sepsis
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; HLH is a clinical diagnosis requiring HLH-2004 criteria rather than the histiocyte alone.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis (CLL-associated HLH) — large histiocyte containing more than ten intact, round, dark engulfed nucleated cells
pearls_zh: 考法：單一巨噬細胞特寫，考官指胞質內十多顆完整圓核，問現象名稱（hemophagocytosis）以及與巨噬細胞自身較大淡染核的區別。
HLH-2004 診斷：HLH 相關基因致病變異，或 8 項中符合 ≥5 項（發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球低下、高三酸甘油酯/低纖維蛋白原、組織噬血現象、NK 活性低、ferritin ≥500 ng/mL、sCD25 升高）。
成人次發性 HLH 誘因以感染（尤其 EBV）、惡性腫瘤（淋巴瘤）、自體免疫（MAS）為主；CLL 病人出現 HLH 應查 EBV、其他感染，並排除 Richter transformation。
實驗室線索：ferritin 極度升高、sCD25 升高、低 fibrinogen、肝功能異常與血球低下；骨髓噬血現象單獨出現（輸血、感染後）不等於 HLH。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 megakaryocyte emperipolesis：後者宿主細胞是具分葉大核、顆粒胞質的巨核細胞，細胞穿行其中；本圖宿主是核較小淡染的組織球，胞質內為被吞噬的完整細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中大型細胞內這十多顆深染圓核是什麼？宿主細胞是哪一種細胞？
quiz.a: 被吞噬的有核細胞（淋巴球等）＝hemophagocytosis；宿主為組織球/巨噬細胞。

3858.recognize_zh: 這是紅血球 CD59-FITC 流式直方圖，分成三群：I 型（正常 CD59 表現，主峰）、II 型（部分缺失，中間小峰）與 III 型（完全缺失，最左側峰）；出現 II/III 型 GPI 缺失紅血球即為 PNH 的診斷依據。
features: Single-parameter flow cytometry histogram of red cells stained with CD59-FITC (log scale)
Type I population: dominant peak near 10^2 with normal CD59 expression
Type II population: intermediate low peak around 10^1 with partial CD59 deficiency
Type III population: peak near 10^0 with complete CD59 deficiency
Distinct trimodal distribution with clear gaps between populations
3858.describe_en: Flow cytometric histogram of peripheral blood red cells stained with CD59-FITC demonstrates three distinct populations: type I cells with normal CD59 expression (dominant peak), type II cells with partial deficiency (intermediate peak), and type III cells with complete absence of CD59 (left-most peak). The presence of discrete type II and type III red cell populations indicates GPI-anchor deficiency. Findings are consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria; clone size should be confirmed on granulocytes and monocytes using FLAER with CD24/CD14, because red cell clone size is underestimated after hemolysis or transfusion.

ddx.vs: Isolated inherited CD59 deficiency shows uniform absence on all red cells and leukocytes with preserved CD55 and FLAER binding, rather than a mixed trimodal pattern.

ddx.dx: Recent transfusion or hemolysis masking PNH
ddx.vs: Transfused normal cells expand the type I peak and underestimate clone size, so granulocyte FLAER analysis is more reliable.
AIHA shows normal CD59 expression on all red cells with a positive direct antiglobulin test.

exam.answer_en: PNH clone by flow cytometry — RBC CD59 histogram showing type I (normal), type II (partial) and type III (complete deficiency) populations
pearls_zh: 判讀：依 CD59 強度分三群，type I 正常、type II 部分缺失、type III 完全缺失；報告需分別列出 type II 與 type III 比例，兩者合計為 RBC PNH clone。
RBC 克隆大小常被低估（溶血與輸血稀釋），克隆大小以嗜中性球/單核球 FLAER 合併 GPI 錨定抗原（CD24、CD157、CD14 等）的高敏感度流式為準。
機轉與臨床：後天性 PIGA 突變致 GPI 錨定蛋白（CD55、CD59）缺失，補體介導血管內溶血（Coombs 陰性）、血栓、骨髓衰竭；常與 aplastic anemia 並存。
治療：C5 抑制劑（eculizumab、ravulizumab）或近端補體抑制劑（pegcetacoplan、iptacopan）；使用補體抑制劑前需接種腦膜炎雙球菌疫苗。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易只看 RBC 且在近期輸血或大量溶血後判讀而低估甚至漏掉克隆；也常把 type II 小峰當成正常變異忽略，應以白血球 FLAER 流式確認。

quiz.q: 此 CD59 直方圖最左側的峰代表哪一型紅血球？為何評估 PNH 克隆大小應以顆粒球為主？
quiz.a: Type III（CD59 完全缺失）；RBC 克隆受溶血與輸血影響而被低估。

3474.recognize_zh: 這是胸部電腦斷層軸切肺窗影像，箭頭指向右肺一區血管紋路稀少、較透亮的區域（區域性灌流減少，類似 Westermark sign）；肺窗無法看清肺動脈內的血栓充填缺損，需搭配縱膈窗 CTPA 判讀。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced chest CT displayed in lung window at the level of the main bronchi
Arrow indicates a region of the right lung with relative hyperlucency and reduced vascular markings (regional oligemia)
Mild dependent posterior ground-glass density bilaterally
No consolidation, pleural effusion or pneumothorax evident on this slice
Pulmonary arterial filling defects cannot be assessed in this lung window
3474.describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced chest CT image in lung window shows an area of relative hyperlucency with attenuated vascular markings in the right lung (arrow), suggesting regional oligemia, with mild bilateral dependent ground-glass density and no consolidation, effusion or pneumothorax. These parenchymal findings are indirect and nonspecific; in the appropriate clinical context they are suggestive of pulmonary embolism with mosaic/regional hypoperfusion, and confirmation requires demonstration of intraluminal filling defects on CT pulmonary angiography in mediastinal window. A single slice limits assessment.

ddx.vs: Emphysema shows areas of low attenuation without visible walls and with destroyed parenchyma, usually upper-lobe predominant, rather than oligemia with preserved parenchyma.

ddx.dx: Air trapping from small airway disease
ddx.vs: Air trapping produces mosaic attenuation that accentuates on expiratory CT, whereas vascular mosaic perfusion does not change and vessels are small in the lucent areas.
CTEPH shows mosaic perfusion with webs, bands, enlarged central pulmonary arteries and bronchial collaterals.

1362.recognize_zh: 流式散點圖顯示主要族群落在 CD20+/CD23+ 象限（第 2 象限），CD23 明顯陽性而 CD20 僅中低強度（dim），這種 CD23 陽性、CD20 弱表現正是 CLL 與被套細胞淋巴瘤區分的重點。
features: Single two-parameter dot plot of CD23-PE (y-axis) versus CD20-PECy5 (x-axis)
Dominant population in quadrant 2, co-expressing CD23 and CD20
CD20 expression is moderate/dim, not reaching the bright upper range
CD23 expression is uniformly positive across the population
Minor double-negative events in quadrant 3 represent non-B cells
1362.describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plot shows a dominant B-cell population uniformly positive for CD23 with dim to moderate CD20 expression (quadrant 2), with a minor double-negative population representing non-B cells. Combined with CD5 co-expression and CD10 negativity, this immunophenotype supports chronic lymphocytic leukemia (Matutes score features include CD23 positivity and weak CD20/surface immunoglobulin). Light-chain restriction is not displayed in this figure.

ddx.vs: Usually CD23-negative or dim with bright CD20 and surface Ig, and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
Shows bright CD20 with CD11c, CD25, CD103 and CD123 positivity and is CD23-negative.
Typically bright CD20 and CD5-negative, with variable weak CD23.

exam.answer_en: CLL immunophenotype by flow — B-cell population bright for CD23 with dim CD20 expression
pearls_zh: 判讀：主族群位於 CD20+/CD23+ 象限，CD23 強陽性、CD20 僅 dim；這是 CLL 與 MCL（CD23 陰性/弱、CD20 較亮）區分的關鍵組合。
CLL 典型表型：CD19+、CD5+、CD23+、CD20 dim、sIg 輕鏈 dim 且單一（κ 或 λ）、CD200+、FMC7−、CD10−；Matutes score 可輔助與其他 B-LPD 區分。
CD20 dim 的臨床連結：anti-CD20 單株抗體仍是 CLL 組合療法的一部分（如 venetoclax + obinutuzumab）。
治療前必查：FISH（del(17p)、del(11q)、+12、del(13q)）、TP53 突變、IGHV 突變狀態；del(17p)/TP53 異常者避免化學免疫治療，優先 BTK inhibitor 或 venetoclax 為基礎療法。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把部分 CD23 弱陽性的 MCL 判為 CLL：CD23 表現有灰色地帶，CD5+ B 細胞若 CD20 亮、sIg 亮或 CD200 陰性，應加做 cyclin D1、SOX11 或 t(11;14) FISH。

quiz.q: 此散點圖中 CD23 與 CD20 的表現強度分別為何？這種組合最支持哪個診斷？
quiz.a: CD23 強陽性、CD20 dim；CLL（相對於 MCL）。

2386.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一團緊密黏聚、核質比高、核互相擠壓塑形（nuclear molding）的小圓藍細胞，旁邊有淡藍色纖維狀的神經絲背景（neuropil，箭頭），與周圍正常造血細胞明顯不同，提示轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Cohesive cluster of medium-sized tumor cells with very high N:C ratio, distinct from surrounding hematopoietic cells
Round to oval nuclei with nuclear molding and fine to slightly coarse chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant pale basophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Pale blue fibrillary neuropil-like material at the periphery of the cluster (arrows)
Background of normal trilineage hematopoietic precursors and lymphocytes
2386.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear contains a cohesive clump of non-hematopoietic small round blue cells set against a background of maturing trilineage hematopoiesis. The tumor cells have a high N:C ratio, scant cytoplasm, and molded round nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Pale fibrillary neuropil-like material surrounds the cluster (arrows). No Homer Wright rosettes are clearly formed in this field. In a child, findings are suggestive of metastatic neuroblastoma; confirmation by marrow biopsy immunohistochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin, GD2) and urine catecholamine metabolites is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are discohesive and lie singly without neuropil or nuclear molding, and they express TdT/CD19 or CD3 rather than neural markers.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells often show cytoplasmic vacuoles and multinucleated forms and are myogenin/desmin-positive, without fibrillary neuropil.
Ewing sarcoma cells contain PAS-positive glycogen vacuoles, are CD99/NKX2.2-positive with EWSR1 rearrangement, and lack neuropil.

ddx.dx: Clusters of normal hematogones or megakaryocyte nuclei
ddx.vs: Normal marrow cells do not form tight molded clumps embedded in fibrillary matrix.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic neuroblastoma in marrow — cohesive cluster of small round blue cells with nuclear molding and fibrillary neuropil
pearls_zh: 考法：指著骨髓抹片中黏聚的小圓藍細胞團與周邊淡藍纖維物質問「這團是什麼、箭頭那是什麼基質」；答 metastatic neuroblastoma 與 neuropil。
IHC 確認：PHOX2B、synaptophysin、chromogranin、GD2 陽性，CD45 陰性；生化檢查尿液 VMA/HVA 上升，影像用 MIBG scan。
預後關鍵：MYCN amplification 為不良預後；年齡（<18 個月較佳）、組織學分類（INPC）、染色體 11q 缺失亦納入 INRG 風險分層。
骨髓侵犯即屬遠處轉移（INRG stage M；嬰兒特殊型 MS 限皮膚、肝、少量骨髓）；分期時須雙側骨髓抽吸與切片。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 ALL 的 blasts；lymphoblast 單個分散、無 nuclear molding 與 neuropil，且 TdT/CD19 或 CD3 陽性，而神經母細胞瘤呈黏聚團塊。

quiz.q: 兒童骨髓抹片中這團核互相擠壓的小圓藍細胞及旁邊淡藍纖維物質，最可能診斷為何？可用哪個尿液檢查支持？
quiz.a: 轉移性 neuroblastoma（纖維物質為 neuropil）；尿液 VMA/HVA

1938.recognize_zh: 一群大型紅系前驅細胞，核圓形很大、染色質呈細點狀篩網樣（sieve-like），細胞質卻已呈灰藍色開始血紅素化，核質發育不同步；旁邊還有巨大後骨髓細胞，這是巨母紅血球（megaloblasts）的典型樣貌。
features: Clusters of large erythroid precursors with round nuclei and finely stippled, open sieve-like chromatin
Moderate grey-blue to polychromatic cytoplasm that is more mature than the nucleus (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Giant metamyelocyte with large folded nucleus and granular cytoplasm
Neutrophil with abnormal lobation adjacent to the precursors
Occasional small orthochromatic normoblasts and macrocytic red cells in the background
1938.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of enlarged erythroid precursors with large round nuclei containing finely stippled, open chromatin and moderately abundant grey-blue to polychromatic cytoplasm, demonstrating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. A giant metamyelocyte is present. No ring forms or excess blasts are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis, as seen in vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: Normoblasts show progressive chromatin condensation that matches cytoplasmic hemoglobinization, whereas these cells retain open fine chromatin despite polychromatic cytoplasm.
MDS megaloblastoid cells are accompanied by nuclear budding, multinuclearity, ring sideroblasts, and dysplastic megakaryocytes with normal vitamin levels.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, unlike the central round nuclei with sieve-like chromatin here.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic erythropoiesis — enlarged erythroid precursors with sieve-like open chromatin despite hemoglobinized cytoplasm, plus giant metamyelocyte
pearls_zh: 考法：指著灰藍胞質卻有細緻篩網狀核的紅系細胞問「這是 normoblast 還是 megaloblast」；判斷依據是核質不同步（胞質已血紅素化、核仍未濃縮）。
B12 與 folate 缺乏形態相同，要靠生化區分：methylmalonic acid 僅在 B12 缺乏時上升，homocysteine 兩者皆上升。
B12 缺乏可造成 subacute combined degeneration（後柱與側柱），神經症狀可在無貧血時出現；若只補 folate 可改善血象但神經損傷持續惡化。
治療反應：補充後數天內 reticulocyte 上升；治療初期可能出現 hypokalemia，且常合併的缺鐵會逐漸顯露，需追蹤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 plasma cells；漿細胞核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀並有 perinuclear hof，megaloblast 則為居中圓核、篩網狀細緻染色質。

quiz.q: 圖中紅系前驅細胞胞質已呈灰藍色，但核染色質仍細緻篩網狀，這種現象稱為什麼？最常見原因為何？
quiz.a: Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony（megaloblastic change）；vitamin B12 或 folate 缺乏

2770.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中一大片成群的小至中型圓形細胞，細胞質極少、染色質細緻，細胞間夾著淡藍色纖維狀基質（neuropil-like material），這種非造血細胞聚團提示轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Sheets and cohesive aggregates of small to intermediate-sized round cells, roughly 1.5-2 times a lymphocyte
High N:C ratio with scant, barely visible pale cytoplasm
Round to slightly molded nuclei with finely granular chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Pale blue-gray fibrillary material between tumor cells (neuropil-like matrix)
No rosettes or ganglionic differentiation evident in this field; normal hematopoietic elements are largely absent
2770.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows large cohesive aggregates of small round blue cells that largely replace normal hematopoietic elements in this field. The cells have a high N:C ratio, scant cytoplasm, round to focally molded nuclei with finely granular chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. Delicate pale blue fibrillary material is present between cells. Well-formed Homer Wright rosettes and ganglion cell differentiation are not identified. Findings are consistent with metastatic undifferentiated neuroblastoma; confirmation with immunohistochemistry (e.g., PHOX2B, synaptophysin) and urine catecholamines is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed as single cells without cohesive clusters, nuclear molding or fibrillary matrix, and are TdT/CD19 or CD3 positive rather than PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive.
Rhabdomyoblasts often show more cytoplasm, occasional vacuoles and multinucleated forms, lack neuropil, and are desmin/myogenin positive.
Ewing cells may have cytoplasmic vacuoles (PAS-positive glycogen) and lack neuropil; they are CD99/NKX2.2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are non-cohesive B cells.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic undifferentiated neuroblastoma — cohesive sheets of small round blue cells with scant cytoplasm and intervening fibrillary neuropil-like material
pearls_zh: 考法：骨髓抹片大片黏聚小圓藍細胞，考官問「造血細胞還是非造血腫瘤？依據？」；答黏聚成團、核相嵌、細胞間 neuropil 樣纖維基質，支持轉移性 neuroblastoma。
兒童 small round blue cell tumor 侵犯骨髓的鑑別：neuroblastoma、Ewing sarcoma、alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma、Burkitt/ALL；以 IHC 區分（PHOX2B / CD99+NKX2.2 / myogenin / TdT、CD19）。
Undifferentiated 亞型缺乏 neuropil 與 rosettes 時診斷較難，需 IHC（PHOX2B、synaptophysin）或分子檢查確認；INPC 分類中 undifferentiated 屬不良組織學。
檢查組合：尿液 VMA/HVA、MIBG scan、腫瘤 MYCN amplification 與 ALK 變異；高風險病人治療含 anti-GD2 抗體（dinutuximab）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 ALL 或 Burkitt 白血病；lymphoblast 分散單顆、無 molding 或纖維基質，Burkitt 胞質深藍帶脂質空泡，neuroblastoma 則黏聚成團。

quiz.q: 兒童骨髓抹片見圖中黏聚成片的小圓藍細胞與細胞間淡藍纖維物質，最可能診斷為何？列出一個確認用 IHC 標記。
quiz.a: 轉移性 neuroblastoma；PHOX2B（或 synaptophysin）

1234.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有許多單一型態的小型成熟淋巴球，大小約與紅血球相近，細胞質極少，染色質呈粗塊狀、塊狀分布的「足球樣/龜殼樣」（soccer ball chromatin），且無明顯核仁，符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）。
features: Increased numbers of small, monomorphic mature lymphocytes, about 1-1.5 times the diameter of a red cell
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Round nuclei with coarse, block-like clumped chromatin (soccer ball pattern)
Nucleoli inconspicuous in most cells
Occasional slightly larger lymphocyte with more cytoplasm; smudge cells not evident in this field
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; platelets present
1234.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increased number of small, monomorphic mature-appearing lymphocytes. The cells have scant cytoplasm, round nuclei with coarse block-like clumped chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli; an occasional slightly larger lymphocyte is present, but prolymphocytes are not increased in this field. Smudge cells are not seen here. Red cells show no significant morphologic abnormality and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia, pending flow cytometric confirmation (CD5+, CD23+, dim CD20 and dim surface light chain).

ddx.vs: MCL cells are often more pleomorphic with irregular or cleaved nuclei and less clumped chromatin, and are CD23-negative/cyclin D1-positive.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm and variable size, whereas these are monomorphic small cells; flow shows a polytypic population.
SMZL cells have villous polar cytoplasmic projections and more cytoplasm, and are CD5/CD23-negative.
FL cells are small with notched or cleft (buttock-like) nuclei and are CD10-positive, CD5-negative.

exam.answer_en: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia — monomorphic small mature lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm and coarse block-like 'soccer ball' chromatin
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著小淋巴球問細胞特徵與診斷；關鍵字是 soccer ball（龜殼樣）染色質、無明顯核仁，常伴 smudge cells（此圖不明顯）。
診斷門檻：周邊血 clonal B 細胞 ≥5×10⁹/L；低於此值且無淋巴結腫大等表現稱 monoclonal B-cell lymphocytosis（MBL）。
Flow 表型：CD5+、CD23+、CD20 dim、surface Ig（light chain）dim、CD200+、FMC7−、CD79b dim；Matutes score 4–5 分支持 CLL。
預後檢驗：del(17p)/TP53 突變與 IGHV 未突變者預後差（對 chemoimmunotherapy 反應差，傾向 BTK inhibitor 或 venetoclax 療法）；del(13q) 單獨存在預後佳。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 mantle cell lymphoma 白血病期混淆；MCL 核較不規則有切痕、CD23 多陰性、CD200 陰性、cyclin D1/SOX11 陽性並有 t(11;14)，形態相似時需靠 flow 與 FISH 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中小淋巴球若 flow 為 CD5+，哪兩個標記最能支持 CLL 而非 mantle cell lymphoma？
quiz.a: CD23+ 與 CD200+（MCL 多為 CD23−、CD200−）

1106.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中箭頭所指的大細胞，胞質塞滿大小不一的淡藍色圓形小球（Russell bodies），像一串葡萄，核被推到一旁，這就是 Mott 細胞（grape cell）。
features: Large cells with cytoplasm packed by multiple pale blue, round, sharply demarcated globules (arrows)
Grape-like/honeycomb appearance of Russell bodies obscuring the nucleus
Small eccentric nucleus with clumped plasma cell-type chromatin
Background of numerous small lymphocytes and plasma cells with trilineage hematopoiesis
Aspirate particle edge with red cell ghosts
1106.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered large cells whose cytoplasm is filled with numerous pale blue, round, sharply outlined globules imparting a grape-like appearance and displacing a small eccentric nucleus (arrows). These are Mott cells containing Russell bodies of accumulated immunoglobulin. The background contains increased small lymphocytes and plasma cells among maturing hematopoietic elements. Findings indicate plasmacytic differentiation with Mott cell change, which may be seen in marginal zone lymphoma, lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, myeloma or reactive states; light chain restriction studies are needed.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows sheets of atypical plasma cells with monotypic light chain expression, whereas Mott cells alone are nonspecific.
Histiocytes have a bland oval nucleus and finely vacuolated cytoplasm with small uniform vacuoles, not distinct refractile immunoglobulin globules.
Vacuolated blasts have fine immature chromatin and small punched-out lipid vacuoles in deep blue cytoplasm rather than large globules.

exam.answer_en: Mott cells (plasmacytic differentiation) — plasma cells distended by grape-like Russell bodies in a marrow with increased lymphocytes and plasma cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭細胞問「這叫什麼細胞？胞質球體是什麼？」答 Mott cell（grape/morula cell）與 Russell bodies（免疫球蛋白堆積於 rough ER）。
Mott cell 不具特異性：可見於反應性漿細胞增多（慢性感染、自體免疫）、myeloma、LPL 與 marginal zone lymphoma 伴漿細胞分化。
判斷良惡性要靠單株性：以 flow 或 κ/λ IHC/ISH 看 B 細胞與漿細胞是否輕鏈限制；合併 serum protein electrophoresis/immunofixation 找 M-protein。
Nodal MZL 表型：CD20+、CD5−、CD10−、BCL6−，無特異性標記，屬排除性診斷；需排除 LPL（MYD88 L265P）與 FL、MCL。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與泡沫狀組織球或含空泡的芽細胞混淆；Mott cell 內為實心淡藍色、邊界銳利的球體並具漿細胞型偏心核與車輪狀染色質，組織球為泡沫狀胞質、核較淡。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質塞滿淡藍色圓球的細胞叫什麼？這些圓球的成分為何？
quiz.a: Mott cell；Russell bodies，堆積的免疫球蛋白

4242.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織夾在脂肪細胞之間，可見成群紅血球系前驅細胞（圓核深染、核周亮暈）、帶嗜酸顆粒的顆粒球系細胞，以及一顆分葉核的巨核細胞，三系造血皆存在。
features: Normocellular marrow with hematopoietic tissue between adipocytes
Erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and perinuclear clear halos, some in small clusters
Granulocytic precursors including cells with eosinophilic granules
Megakaryocyte with lobulated nucleus and abundant cytoplasm
Sinusoids with red cells; no atypical infiltrate or fibrosis
4242.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy section shows normocellular marrow with hematopoietic tissue alternating with fat. Trilineage hematopoiesis is present, including erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and perinuclear halos, maturing granulocytic cells including eosinophil precursors, and normal-appearing megakaryocytes. No increase in blasts, lymphoid aggregates or non-hematopoietic infiltrate is seen. Findings are consistent with normal adult bone marrow.

ddx.vs: MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes (small hypolobated forms), abnormal localization of immature precursors and often hypercellularity for age.
Erythroid precursors with perinuclear halos can mimic plasma cells, but plasma cells have eccentric clock-face nuclei and are highlighted by CD138.

4178.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的紅血球呈灰藍紫色、沒有中央淡染區，和周圍粉紅色紅血球明顯不同，是多染性紅血球（polychromatophilic red cell）。
features: Single red cell (arrow) with diffuse grayish-blue/lilac coloration and no central pallor
Polychromatophilic cell is round and similar to or slightly larger than neighboring red cells
Background normochromic red cells with mild anisocytosis
Occasional irregularly shaped or crenated red cells (upper left)
Few platelets; no nucleated red cells or leukocytes in field
4178.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows predominantly normochromic red cells with mild anisocytosis and occasional irregular forms. A single red cell with diffuse bluish-gray staining and absent central pallor is present, representing a polychromatophilic red cell. These cells correspond to reticulocytes with residual RNA and reflect increased erythropoietic output when numerous. Findings are consistent with polychromasia; quantification by reticulocyte count is recommended in the setting of suspected hemolysis.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes are smaller and densely red-staining without central pallor, whereas this cell is bluish.
Stippling appears as discrete blue dots rather than diffuse blue-gray tint.
These have a visible purple nucleus, while a polychromatophilic cell is anucleate.

4050.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的是一顆有核紅血球（圓形緻密細胞核與灰藍色細胞質），背景有數個盔甲狀與三角形裂紅血球（schistocyte），血小板偏少，符合微血管病性溶血伴隨骨髓代償。
features: Nucleated red blood cell (arrow) with a round nucleus with clumped chromatin and grayish-blue cytoplasm
Scattered schistocytes including helmet cells and small triangular fragments
Occasional crenated cell and irregular poikilocytes
Red cells overlapping in stacks in thicker areas (preparation-related)
Only a rare platelet visible
4050.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered schistocytes, including helmet cells and small triangular fragments, with occasional crenated red cells. A nucleated red blood cell with clumped chromatin and polychromatophilic cytoplasm is present, and platelets appear decreased. Circulating nucleated red cells accompany the brisk erythropoietic response and marrow stress of severe hemolysis. Findings are consistent with microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, as seen in thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, with a nucleated red cell response.

ddx.vs: Nucleated red cells occur with immature granulocytes and teardrop cells rather than numerous schistocytes and thrombocytopenic hemolysis.
Similar smear but separated by consumptive coagulopathy on PT/aPTT, fibrinogen and D-dimer.
Lymphocytes have a thin rim of clear blue cytoplasm and less condensed chromatin than this normoblast.

3986.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒中以核呈橢圓或紡錘形的基質細胞與含深色吞噬碎屑/含鐵血黃素的巨噬細胞為主，周圍是大脂肪空泡，幾乎不見造血前驅細胞；這是化療後骨髓只剩基質與巨噬細胞的典型抑制期表現。
features: Marrow particle composed of stromal cells with oval to spindled nuclei and pale syncytial cytoplasm
Macrophages containing dark granular debris and golden-brown hemosiderin-like pigment
Large surrounding fat vacuoles
Marked paucity of granulocytic and erythroid precursors
No cohesive abnormal cell clusters or blasts identified
3986.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a particle composed predominantly of stromal cells with oval to spindled nuclei and macrophages containing dark phagocytic debris and pigment, set among large fat vacuoles. Hematopoietic precursors are markedly decreased. No blasts or foreign cell clusters are identified. Findings are consistent with a hypocellular, stroma-rich marrow with macrophage activity, compatible with chemotherapy effect in the aplastic phase.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia also yields stroma- and fat-rich particles; only the therapy history and subsequent regeneration separate them morphologically.
Carcinoma clusters show cohesive atypical cells with high N:C ratio and nuclear pleomorphism, whereas these bland stromal nuclei lack atypia.
Hypocellular leukemia retains a population of blasts, which are not present in this field.

3730.recognize_zh: 極低倍的血液抹片上，紅血球全面聚成不規則、斑駁的大團塊，白血球散布其間，整張片子呈地圖狀，是冷凝球蛋白引起的紅血球凝集。
features: Diffuse clumping of red cells into irregular, confluent aggregates across the entire field
Aggregates have a mottled, map-like pattern with clear intervening spaces
Scattered small leukocytes visible as blue dots
No linear rouleaux arrays
Cellular detail not assessable at this very low magnification
3730.describe_en: Very low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows widespread red cell agglutination, with red cells forming large, irregular, confluent clumps separated by clear spaces throughout the smear. Linear rouleaux are not seen, and individual cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with red cell agglutination, which in this context may be due to a cryoglobulin; warming the sample to 37°C, cryoglobulin testing and evaluation for HCV infection are recommended.

ddx.vs: Smear pattern is the same, so DAT (C3d positive) and cold agglutinin titer versus cryoglobulin precipitate testing are needed.
Rouleaux form linear stacks of red cells due to paraprotein, not irregular clumps.
Artifactual overlap is confined to thick areas and resolves in the monolayer, while agglutination persists across the feathered edge.

exam.answer_en: Cryoglobulin-induced red cell agglutination — widespread irregular confluent RBC clumps across the smear at very low power
pearls_zh: 考法：極低倍看不到細胞細節，考官問的是「整張片子的 pattern」：地圖狀凝集遍布整片、包括 feathered edge，才是真凝集而非厚區假象。
Mixed cryoglobulinemia（type II/III）與 HCV 關係最密切；臨床 Meltzer triad：紫斑（purpura）、關節痛、虛弱，可合併周邊神經病變與膜增生性腎絲球腎炎。
冷凝球蛋白沉澱在自動計數器中可被誤判為白血球或血小板，造成 pseudoleukocytosis 或 pseudothrombocytosis。
與 cold agglutinin disease 的區分：CAD 為 IgM 抗 I 抗原，DAT 呈 C3d 陽性並有溶血；cryoglobulin 則以保溫檢體測沉澱物與分型。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為抹片製作時的厚區重疊假象；假象只出現在較厚的抹片頭端，真正凝集會延伸到單層區與 feathered edge 仍成團。

quiz.q: 這張抹片的紅血球凝集若由 type II 冷凝球蛋白造成，最常相關的感染是什麼？
quiz.a: Hepatitis C virus（HCV）

3602.recognize_zh: 一顆分葉核嗜中性球，細胞質內有稍粗的紫色顆粒，細胞質邊緣左上方隱約有一小塊淡藍灰色、無顆粒的區域，即杜勒小體（Döhle body）；本張的杜勒小體不明顯，需仔細找細胞質周邊。
features: Segmented neutrophil with 2–3 lobes and condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm with fine to slightly coarse purple granules (mild toxic granulation)
Faint, pale blue-gray agranular patch near the cytoplasmic periphery (subtle Döhle body)
No cytoplasmic vacuolization
Background RBCs in a thick area with overlapping cells; scattered platelets
3602.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil with mildly coarse cytoplasmic granulation. A subtle, pale blue-gray, agranular cytoplasmic inclusion is present at the periphery of the cytoplasm, consistent with a Döhle body, although it is less conspicuous than in classic examples. No vacuoles are seen. Background red cells are in a thicker area of the smear and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with Döhle body formation, a reactive change seen with infection, inflammation, pregnancy, burns or growth factor therapy.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, more sharply defined and spindle-shaped, occur in all granulocytes, and are accompanied by giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
Chédiak-Higashi inclusions are giant, dark purple-red granules rather than pale blue agranular patches.
Artifactual pallor lacks a discrete blue-gray, rough-endoplasmic-reticulum-rich patch at the cell margin.

exam.answer_en: Döhle body (subtle) — faint pale blue-gray agranular patch at the periphery of a segmented neutrophil with mild toxic granulation
pearls_zh: 考法：本張 Döhle body 不明顯，考官測的是搜尋技巧：沿細胞質周邊找淡藍灰色、無顆粒的區域，並同時評估有無毒性顆粒與空泡。
Döhle body 是 rough ER 殘留，反映嗜中性球在骨髓成熟加速、細胞質成熟不完全；與 toxic granulation（primary granule 染色加深）常同時出現。
判讀 left shift 與毒性變化時，需同時看 band 比例、metamyelocyte 與空泡；空泡化對菌血症的提示價值高於單獨 Döhle body。
Chédiak-Higashi 的巨大顆粒為紫紅/灰色實心顆粒，與 Döhle body 的淡藍無顆粒斑塊外觀不同，常被放在同一題比較。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把細胞質邊緣變薄造成的淡染誤判為 Döhle body；真正的 Döhle body 是界線可辨、偏藍灰色的無顆粒斑塊，而非整圈邊緣均勻變淡。

quiz.q: 這顆嗜中性球要找 Döhle body，應看細胞的哪個位置？它是什麼細胞器的殘留？
quiz.a: 細胞質周邊；粗糙內質網（rough ER）

3666.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中紅血球大小一致、有中央淡染區，幾乎沒有異形紅血球，可見 4 顆型態正常的分葉核嗜中性球與足量散在的血小板，屬於正常血液抹片。
features: Red cells uniform in size and shape, normocytic and normochromic with central pallor about one-third of the cell diameter
No significant poikilocytosis, polychromasia, spherocytes, schistocytes or target cells
Four morphologically normal segmented neutrophils with 3–5 lobes and pink cytoplasm
Adequate numbers of scattered platelets of normal size without clumping
Monolayer area with minimal red cell overlap, appropriate for morphologic review
3666.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, examined in a well-spread monolayer, shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with normal central pallor and no significant anisopoikilocytosis. White cells present are morphologically normal segmented neutrophils without toxic change or hypersegmentation. Platelets are adequate in number and normal in size. Findings are consistent with a normal peripheral blood smear.

3538.recognize_zh: 一大片以小至中型淋巴球為主的細胞群，許多核有明顯的切跡或裂溝（cleaved nuclei），細胞質稀少，與深染的小淋巴球混雜，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的中心細胞（centrocytes）。
features: Sheet of small to medium lymphoid cells with scant pale cytoplasm
Many nuclei with distinct clefts, notches, or indentations (cleaved nuclei)
Chromatin moderately condensed with inconspicuous nucleoli
Admixed small dark mature-appearing lymphocytes and occasional larger cells
Cohesive-appearing crowded aggregate, likely from a particle
3538.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a crowded aggregate of lymphoid cells replacing normal hematopoietic elements in this field. The cells are small to medium sized with scant cytoplasm, and many show nuclear clefts and notches with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, admixed with small dark lymphocytes and occasional larger cells. Findings are consistent with involvement by a small cleaved B-cell lymphoma, compatible with follicular lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD10+ monotypic B cells) and biopsy is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mantle cells show more irregular but less deeply cleaved nuclei and are CD5+ cyclin D1+, whereas follicular lymphoma is CD10+ BCL6+ and CD5-.
CLL cells have round nuclei with block-like clumped chromatin and no clefts, with CD5+ CD23+ phenotype.
Hematogones have homogeneous smooth chromatin without clefting and show a maturing CD10/CD20/CD34 pattern on flow cytometry.

3346.recognize_zh: H&E 中倍率可見淋巴結被成片、看似有聚合性（cohesive）的大型細胞取代，細胞核空泡狀、核仁明顯、細胞質豐富淡染，其間夾雜小淋巴球；這種像癌細胞般成團生長的大型異型細胞是 ALCL 的典型外觀。
features: Effacement by sheets and cohesive nests of large atypical cells
Large vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli; some nuclei indented or kidney-shaped
Abundant pale amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Admixed small mature lymphocytes, concentrated in bands between tumor aggregates
Scattered clear spaces/apoptotic cells and a focus of eosinophilic material (possible vessel or keratin-like debris)
3346.describe_en: Section of lymph node at intermediate power shows effacement of normal architecture by sheets and cohesive aggregates of large atypical cells. The neoplastic cells have abundant pale amphophilic cytoplasm, large vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli, and occasional indented or kidney-shaped nuclear contours. Small mature lymphocytes are admixed and form bands between tumor aggregates, and scattered apoptotic cells are present. The cohesive growth can mimic metastatic carcinoma. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by strong uniform CD30 expression and ALK immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma shows true epithelial cohesion with cytokeratin positivity and lacks CD30/CD45 expression.
Hodgkin cells are CD15+/PAX5 weak+ with a mixed inflammatory background, whereas ALCL shows EMA/T-cell markers and often ALK.
DLBCL cells express CD20/PAX5 and typically lack hallmark horseshoe nuclei and sinusoidal growth.
Melanoma is S100/SOX10/HMB45 positive and negative for lymphoid markers.

3218.recognize_zh: 單一顆中性球大小的細胞，細胞質淡粉紅帶細顆粒，細胞核卻變成數顆互不相連、深藍黑色、邊緣平滑的均質圓球，這是核固縮加核碎裂的凋亡中性球，常見於血液放置過久才抹片。
features: Neutrophil-sized cell with pale pink cytoplasm containing fine granules
Nucleus replaced by several discrete round, dense, homogeneous dark blue fragments of varying size
No chromatin pattern or interlobar filaments between fragments
Cell outline intact; no vacuolization or ingested material
Background normochromic red cells and scattered normal platelets
3218.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic, normocytic red cells and scattered platelets. A cell with neutrophilic granular cytoplasm contains several discrete, round, dense and structureless nuclear fragments of varying size, representing pyknosis with karyorrhexis. There is no evidence of phagocytosed material or microorganisms.
