Findings are consistent with an apoptotic neutrophil, most often an in vitro artifact of prolonged sample storage before smear preparation.

ddx.vs: True hypersegmentation shows connected lobes with visible chromatin texture rather than separate homogeneous spheres.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil containing Howell-Jolly-like or cryoglobulin inclusions
ddx.vs: Inclusions sit within a neutrophil that still has its own intact segmented nucleus.
Erythroid precursors have agranular orange-grey hemoglobinized cytoplasm, unlike the granular neutrophilic cytoplasm here.
Dysplastic neutrophils are hypolobated or hypogranular with coarse clumped chromatin but retain a structured, non-fragmented nucleus.

3282.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以大量小而成熟的淋巴球為主，核圓、染色質呈粗塊狀（soccer-ball chromatin）、細胞質極少，另有破碎的 smudge cells；箭頭指的是一顆核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀的漿細胞樣細胞，符合 CLL 骨髓浸潤。
features: Predominance of small mature lymphocytes, slightly larger than red cells
High N:C ratio with round nuclei and coarsely clumped 'soccer-ball' chromatin
Scant pale blue cytoplasm; nucleoli inconspicuous
Smudge (basket) cells in the right upper and lower right field
Arrow: plasmacytoid cell with eccentric nucleus, clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hof
Occasional band neutrophil and a larger cell with more open chromatin (possible prolymphocyte)
3282.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a predominance of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by smudge cells. A plasmacytoid cell with an eccentric nucleus, clock-face chromatin and perinuclear clearing is indicated by the arrow, and occasional larger cells with more open chromatin and a band neutrophil are present. Normal hematopoietic elements are reduced in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, CD200+, dim sIg) is recommended, and the plasmacytoid cell should prompt consideration of lymphoplasmacytic differentiation if numerous.

ddx.vs: Mantle cells are slightly larger with irregular or cleaved nuclei and less clumped chromatin, and are CD23-negative/cyclin D1 and SOX11-positive.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, and is CD5/CD23-negative.
MZL cells have more abundant pale cytoplasm, sometimes villous projections, and are CD5/CD23-negative.
Hematogones have homogeneous smooth chromatin and show a maturation spectrum (CD10/CD34/TdT) without light chain restriction.

exam.answer_en: CLL/SLL involving marrow — sheets of small mature lymphocytes with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指的是漿細胞樣細胞，考官常問「這顆是什麼、在 CLL 背景出現代表什麼」；少量可見，若大量需考慮 lymphoplasmacytic differentiation 或 LPL。
Flow 必考：CD19+、CD5+、CD23+、CD200+，sIg 與 CD20 dim、單一輕鏈；CD5+ 但 CD23−、cyclin D1+/SOX11+ 則轉向 mantle cell lymphoma。
預後必查：FISH del(17p)、TP53 mutation、IGHV mutation status；del(17p)/TP53 異常與 unmutated IGHV 預後較差並影響標靶藥物選擇（BTK inhibitor、venetoclax）。
CLL 診斷需周邊血 monoclonal B cell ≥5×10⁹/L；未達且無淋巴結病變等表現者為 MBL。
注意 prolymphocyte 比例與大細胞：出現成片大型轉化細胞要想到 Richter transformation。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 mantle cell lymphoma 或 LPL；CLL 核圓、染色質塊狀、smudge cell 多，最終靠 CD23+/cyclin D1− 區分。

quiz.q: 此骨髓抹片的診斷為何？確認診斷時 flow cytometry 最關鍵的表型組合是什麼？
quiz.a: CLL/SLL；CD5+ CD23+ CD200+，sIg/CD20 dim、輕鏈限制

3154.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下細胞密度高、脂肪很少，細胞呈束狀流線狀（streaming）排列，夾雜散在的大型巨核細胞，並可見骨小樑，這種纖維化背景符合原發性骨髓纖維化。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with reduced fat spaces
Streaming, swirling pattern of spindle cells indicating stromal fibrosis
Scattered large megakaryocytes, some appearing clustered and with dark hyperchromatic nuclei
Bony trabecula at the lower right without obvious osteosclerosis at this power
Limited cytologic detail at this low magnification
3154.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with scant residual fat. The hematopoietic tissue has a streaming, fascicular architecture suggesting stromal fibrosis, with scattered large megakaryocytes, some with dark nuclei. A bony trabecula is present at the lower right. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a fibrotic myeloproliferative neoplasm such as primary myelofibrosis; reticulin and trichrome stains for fibrosis grading and molecular studies (JAK2, CALR, MPL) are recommended.

ddx.dx: Post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: These show identical marrow fibrosis and are distinguished by documented prior PV or ET history rather than morphology.
MDS with fibrosis has small hypolobated dysplastic megakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia in blood and marrow instead of large bizarre MPN-type megakaryocytes.
Metastatic tumor forms cohesive nests or glands of epithelial cells that are keratin positive among the fibrosis.
This entity has an acute presentation with increased CD34-positive blasts (20% or more) and small dysplastic megakaryocytes.

exam.answer_en: Primary myelofibrosis marrow biopsy — hypercellular marrow with streaming fibrotic architecture and clustered atypical megakaryocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍切片考「架構」：高細胞密度、流線狀排列（fibrosis）、成群大型巨核細胞；答 fibrotic MPN/PMF，並說要做 reticulin 染色分級。
纖維化分級：reticulin（silver）染色 MF-0 至 MF-3，trichrome 評估 collagen；overt PMF 需 MF-2 或以上。
PMF 巨核細胞特徵：大小不一、成群、核深染呈 cloud-like 或 balloon-shaped，N:C 比異常；與 ET 的大而成熟 staghorn 核不同。
預後工具：DIPSS/DIPSS-plus、MIPSS70；JAK inhibitor（ruxolitinib 等）用於症狀與脾腫大，allo-HSCT 為唯一可能治癒方式。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 MDS with fibrosis；MDS 巨核細胞小、分葉少（micromegakaryocyte）並有多系 dysplasia，PMF 巨核細胞大而異型、成群。

quiz.q: 此切片呈流線狀排列與成群異型巨核細胞，要評估纖維化程度應加做哪一種特殊染色？
quiz.a: Reticulin（silver）stain，必要時加 trichrome

3026.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一個有核紅血球，小而圓、深染的偏心核，周圍有淡灰藍色（多染性）的細胞質，大小接近紅血球；背景可見數個橢圓形紅血球，可放在溶血性貧血脈絡下理解。
features: Nucleated red blood cell slightly larger than surrounding RBCs
Small, round, eccentric nucleus with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin and no nucleoli
Moderate amount of gray-blue (polychromatophilic) cytoplasm
Morphology of a polychromatophilic to orthochromatic normoblast
Background RBCs include some oval/elongated forms; small platelet clump present
3026.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating nucleated red blood cell with a small, round, eccentric nucleus with dense clumped chromatin and a moderate amount of gray-blue polychromatophilic cytoplasm, corresponding to a late polychromatophilic normoblast. The background red cells are normochromic and include scattered oval to elongated forms; no spherocytes or schistocytes are prominent in this field. Circulating nucleated red cells indicate increased or stressed erythropoiesis, as in hemolytic anemia, and should be enumerated per 100 white cells with correction of the WBC count if numerous.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a thin rim of clear blue cytoplasm and slightly less dense chromatin, whereas the normoblast has gray-blue hemoglobinized cytoplasm and a pyknotic nucleus.
Plasma cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and cartwheel chromatin rather than grayish polychromatophilic cytoplasm.
Marrow infiltration shows NRBCs together with immature granulocytes and teardrop cells, whereas hemolysis shows NRBCs with polychromasia and hemolysis-related poikilocytes.

exam.answer_en: Circulating nucleated red blood cell (polychromatophilic normoblast) — dense eccentric nucleus with gray-blue hemoglobinized cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這顆有核細胞問「lymphocyte 還是 NRBC」；看胞質顏色——灰藍（含血紅素）為 NRBC，清澈藍色為淋巴球。
NRBC 以每 100 顆白血球計數；自動血球計數可能將 NRBC 算入 WBC，需校正：corrected WBC = WBC × 100 /（100 + NRBC）。
成人血中出現 NRBC 皆屬異常：溶血、嚴重缺氧、失血後大量造血、thalassemia major、脾切除後、骨髓浸潤或纖維化。
NRBC 伴隨不成熟顆粒球與 teardrop cells 稱為 leukoerythroblastic picture，應懷疑骨髓浸潤（如轉移癌、myelofibrosis）。
新生兒血中少量 NRBC 屬生理性；成人加護病房病人出現 NRBC 與不良預後相關。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為小淋巴球；NRBC 核更濃縮近乎固縮、核偏位，胞質為灰藍或粉紅（含血紅素），淋巴球則胞質清澈藍色。

quiz.q: 圖中這顆有核細胞是什麼？自動計數若有 20 NRBC/100 WBC，WBC 應如何校正？
quiz.a: Nucleated RBC（polychromatophilic normoblast）；corrected WBC = WBC × 100/120

2898.recognize_zh: 同一視野並列不同強度：上方中性球有密集藍色顆粒（約 3 分），下方細胞整個被深藍色沉澱蓋住看不到核（4 分），右側與左下的淡紅色細胞則沒有顆粒（0 分）。
features: Upper neutrophil with dense blue granules, nucleus still faintly visible (about 3+)
Lower cell with intense confluent dark blue precipitate obscuring the nucleus (4+)
Adjacent pale cells with red nuclei and no blue granules (score 0)
Unstained red cells in background
2898.describe_en: High-power view of a leukocyte alkaline phosphatase-stained peripheral blood smear demonstrates the grading spectrum within a single field. One neutrophil contains dense blue granules with a faintly visible nucleus (approximately 3+), another shows intense confluent dark blue reaction product completely obscuring the nucleus (4+), and nearby cells with red-counterstained nuclei lack any granules (0). The LAP score is the sum of grades for 100 consecutive neutrophils.

ddx.vs: These show sparse to moderate granules with clearly visible nuclear lobes, unlike the heavily stained cells here.
Lymphocytes and monocytes are excluded from scoring and are recognized by round or folded nonsegmented nuclei.

exam.answer_en: LAP stain grading — neutrophil with dense granules (3+) and one with confluent precipitate obscuring the nucleus (4+) beside unstained 0 cells
pearls_zh: 考法：辨別 3+ 與 4+——3+ 顆粒密集但核仍隱約可見；4+ 為融合深藍沉澱完全遮蓋核。考官會指兩顆比較。
LAP score = 100 顆連續 neutrophil 的分數總和（最高 400）；多顆 3+/4+ 提示高 LAP，常見於 leukemoid reaction、PV、感染或懷孕。
Leukemoid reaction vs CML：前者 LAP 高、常有 toxic granulation/Döhle bodies、無 basophilia；CML LAP 低、basophilia、myelocyte bulge，最終以 BCR::ABL1 確認。
PV 常 LAP 升高，是舊版 PV 診斷的輔助準則之一；現代以 JAK2 V617F/exon 12 突變為主。
原理：naphthol phosphate 受 neutrophil 的 alkaline phosphatase 水解後與 diazonium salt 偶合形成有色沉澱（本片為藍色，依試劑也可為紅棕色），核以對比色復染。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把核完全被遮蓋的 4+ neutrophil 誤認為 basophil（顆粒遮核）：本片為 LAP 酵素染色而非 Wright，藍色是 reaction product，basophil 在此染色不應呈強陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中深藍沉澱融合、完全看不到核的細胞在 LAP 評分為幾分？

2706.recognize_zh: 多顆紅血球內可見少數細小、深藍色顆粒成簇位於細胞邊緣，包括中央一顆偏藍的橢圓形細胞；顆粒成群而非均勻布滿整顆細胞，符合 Pappenheimer 小體。背景並有棘狀紅血球。
features: Several red cells with small clusters of dark blue granules near the cell margin
Polychromatic oval cells containing grouped basophilic granules
Granules sparse and clustered, not uniformly distributed
Scattered echinocytes (crenated cells) and occasional hypochromic cells
Otherwise normochromic red cells with central pallor
2706.describe_en: High-power peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with scattered echinocytes and a few hypochromic and polychromatic cells. Multiple red cells, including two polychromatic oval cells, contain small clusters of dark basophilic granules located toward the cell periphery. The granules are few and grouped rather than finely dispersed throughout the cell. Findings are consistent with Pappenheimer bodies; confirmation with Prussian blue staining and evaluation for sideroblastic anemia, hyposplenism, or thalassemia is recommended.

ddx.vs: Basophilic stippling fills the entire red cell with evenly spaced granules and is iron-negative on Prussian blue.
Malaria rings show a blue cytoplasmic ring with a red chromatin dot, sometimes appliqué forms, rather than clusters of structureless dark granules.
Stain precipitate lies in a different focal plane, also overlies background areas, and is not confined within red cells.

exam.answer_en: Pappenheimer bodies — several red cells, including polychromatic oval cells, containing small peripheral clusters of basophilic iron granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指含顆粒的 polychromatic 紅血球問「為何年輕紅血球較常見這些顆粒」——網狀紅血球仍含未利用的鐵與粒線體殘餘，含鐵顆粒多在脾臟 pitting 前被看到。
多顆紅血球同時出現 Pappenheimer bodies 應聯想 hyposplenism/脾切除、sideroblastic anemia、thalassemia 或嚴重溶血。
Sideroblastic anemia 的鐵指標常見 ferritin 與 transferrin saturation 升高（鐵負荷過量），與缺鐵的低色素貧血相反。
可逆性病因要主動找：酒精、isoniazid（pyridoxine 相關）、linezolid、chloramphenicol、copper deficiency（常因 zinc 過量或胃繞道）。
先天性 X-linked sideroblastic anemia（ALAS2 突變）部分對 pyridoxine（vitamin B6）有反應。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 echinocyte 的鋸齒邊緣或染料沉澱誤為顆粒：染料沉澱在紅血球之外也可見且大小不一、位於不同焦平面；真正 Pappenheimer bodies 位於細胞內、成小群。

quiz.q: Isoniazid 引起 sideroblastic anemia 的機轉與哪個維生素有關？
quiz.a: Vitamin B6（pyridoxine）拮抗，影響 ALAS 的輔因子 pyridoxal phosphate

2642.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆單核、不分葉的巨核細胞，核偏位呈圓卵形，細胞質豐富帶細顆粒，周圍為大量帶狀核與分葉嗜中性球；此細胞明顯大於周邊顆粒球，較像小型單核巨核細胞而非嚴格定義的微小巨核細胞。
features: Megakaryocyte with a single, non-lobated, eccentric round-oval nucleus
Abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm consistent with platelet-producing megakaryocytic cytoplasm
Cell is several times the diameter of adjacent granulocytes, larger than a strict micromegakaryocyte
Background of numerous band and segmented neutrophils, metamyelocytes and myelocytes (granulocytic predominance)
Occasional eosinophil and erythroid precursors in the surrounding field
2642.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a megakaryocyte with a single, non-lobated, eccentrically placed round nucleus and abundant finely granular cytoplasm, set in a background rich in maturing granulocytes including bands, segmented neutrophils, and metamyelocytes. The cell is clearly larger than the surrounding granulocytes and therefore exceeds the size usually used to define a true micromegakaryocyte (at or below the size of a promyelocyte). It is better described as a small hypolobated (mononuclear) megakaryocyte. Only one megakaryocyte is present, so the proportion of dysplastic forms cannot be assessed; a count across the aspirate and biopsy is needed before attributing this to a reactive versus myelodysplastic process.

ddx.vs: True micromegakaryocytes are no larger than a promyelocyte with one or two small round nuclei, whereas this cell is considerably larger than neighboring granulocytes.

ddx.dx: Hypolobated megakaryocytes of MDS with isolated del(5q)
ddx.vs: 5q- syndrome shows numerous normal-sized to small monolobated megakaryocytes accompanied by macrocytic anemia and preserved or increased platelets, confirmed by karyotype.
Osteoclasts are multinucleated with many separate, evenly spaced nuclei rather than a single non-lobated nucleus.
Plasma cells and blasts are much smaller and lack the voluminous finely granular megakaryocytic cytoplasm.

2578.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨大、核高度分葉的巨核細胞，其淡藍胞質內包含多顆完整的分葉嗜中性球，這就是細胞穿入現象（emperipolesis），常見於骨髓增生性腫瘤（MPN）。
features: Very large megakaryocyte with a hyperlobated, complex nucleus
Abundant pale blue-lilac cytoplasm with fine granularity
Several intact segmented neutrophils located within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis)
Engulfed cells retain normal nuclear morphology without degeneration, unlike phagocytosis
Background of maturing myeloid cells and red cells
2578.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large megakaryocyte with a hyperlobated nucleus and abundant pale granular cytoplasm containing several intact segmented neutrophils. The internalized cells are morphologically preserved, indicating emperipolesis rather than phagocytosis. Scattered maturing myeloid cells are present in the background. Emperipolesis is a nonspecific phenomenon but is frequently prominent in myeloproliferative neoplasms; findings are consistent with the title in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytic histiocytes have a single oval nucleus and contain degraded red cells or nuclear debris in vacuoles, whereas here intact neutrophils lie within a lobated megakaryocyte.
Overlapping cells lie on top in a different plane without a surrounding clear halo, while emperipolesed cells sit within the cytoplasm, often in a vacuole.
In Rosai-Dorfman disease the host is an S100-positive histiocyte with a vesicular nucleus in lymph node or tissue, not a marrow megakaryocyte.

exam.answer_en: Emperipolesis — intact neutrophils within the cytoplasm of a large hyperlobated megakaryocyte, frequent in MPN
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨核細胞胞質內的完整嗜中性球，問這現象的名稱，並與 phagocytosis、hemophagocytosis 區分。
Emperipolesis 指活細胞穿行於另一細胞內且未被分解；吞噬作用則被吞細胞會被消化、變性。
巨核細胞 emperipolesis 在 primary myelofibrosis 與其他 MPN 中常增加，被認為與釋出 TGF-β 等纖維化因子有關，但本身不具診斷特異性。
Rosai-Dorfman disease 的 emperipolesis 發生在 S100+ 組織球（多含淋巴球），是另一個常考情境。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 hemophagocytosis 或抹片重疊：噬血組織球為單一卵圓核並含變性紅血球或碎片；重疊細胞位於不同平面、無空暈。

quiz.q: 圖中巨核細胞胞質內含完整嗜中性球的現象稱為什麼？與 phagocytosis 的差別為何？
quiz.a: Emperipolesis；被包入的細胞保持完整存活，未被消化

2514.recognize_zh: 三顆大小與紅血球相近的淋巴球，核佔滿細胞、染色質濃縮，核表面有交錯溝紋呈腦迴狀（cerebriform），胞質極少，是 Sézary 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Three small to intermediate lymphocytes, approximately red-cell sized to slightly larger
Nuclei with intersecting grooves and folds giving a cerebriform surface
Condensed, hyperchromatic chromatin; nucleoli not seen
Very scant pale cytoplasm with small surface projections
Background red cells with a few platelets
2514.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows three small to intermediate lymphocytes with condensed hyperchromatic chromatin and nuclear membranes bearing intersecting grooves and folds, producing a cerebriform configuration. Cytoplasm is scant with minor surface irregularities, and nucleoli are not identified. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with Sézary cells; correlation with erythroderma and flow cytometry demonstrating a clonal CD4+ T-cell population with CD7 and/or CD26 loss is required for Sézary syndrome.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells have deeply lobated petal-shaped nuclei rather than fine surface grooves and are HTLV-1 associated.
Circulating follicular lymphoma cells show a single deep cleft and are CD10+ B cells, not multiple convoluted grooves in CD4+ T cells.
Hairy cells have oval or bean-shaped nuclei with abundant pale cytoplasm and circumferential hairy projections, and are CD11c/CD25/CD103 positive.

exam.answer_en: Sézary cells — red-cell-sized lymphocytes with intersecting nuclear grooves producing cerebriform nuclei, scant cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍下三顆腦迴狀核淋巴球，考官問名稱，並追問診斷 Sézary syndrome 需要的臨床與 flow 條件。
Sézary syndrome 定義：erythroderma（常 ≥ 80% 體表面積）、全身淋巴結腫大、周邊血克隆性 CD4+ T 細胞（與皮膚相同 TCR clone）。
Mycosis fungoides 分期中 B2 代表血液侵犯（Sézary cells ≥ 1000/µL 並有克隆），預後較差。
Sézary cells 有 small（Lutzner）與 large 兩型；形態計數主觀，現行以 flow 定量 CD4+CD7−／CD26− 為主。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 hairy cell 或 follicular lymphoma buttock cell 混淆：hairy cell 胞質多有毛狀突起；buttock cell 只有單一深裂縫且為 CD10+ B 細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞在 mycosis fungoides／Sézary syndrome 分期中，血液達何種數量並具克隆性時屬 B2？
quiz.a: Sézary cells ≥ 1000/µL 並有 TCR 克隆（B2）

2450.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片細胞密集，大多數是核圓、胞質少的原始細胞，大小從小型到中大型不一，混有少數分葉中性球與有核紅血球；此原始細胞片狀增生符合 ALL，T 細胞系需免疫表型確認。
features: Hypercellular aspirate dominated by blasts
Blasts vary from small to medium-large with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin; nucleoli visible in larger cells
Scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Scattered residual neutrophils, erythroid precursors and smudged cells
2450.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power is hypercellular and composed predominantly of blasts ranging from small to medium-large, with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin, variably visible nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. Residual neutrophils and erythroid precursors are sparse, and scattered smudged cells are present. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; T-lymphoblastic leukemia should be confirmed by flow cytometry (cytoplasmic CD3, CD7, TdT).

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; separated by B-lineage versus T-lineage antigen expression.
Myeloblasts are larger with more cytoplasm, granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive.
Hematogones show a spectrum of maturation with homogeneous condensed chromatin and a normal, maturing B-cell immunophenotypic pattern.

2322.recognize_zh: 周邊血中四顆大型母細胞聚在一起，細緻染色質、藍色細胞質，其中幾顆細胞質內有細小深色顆粒（可能為嗜鹼性顆粒），右側一顆有清楚淡藍細胞質邊緣，符合 CML 急性轉化中的母細胞。
features: Cluster of four large blasts with high N:C ratio and fine chromatin
Several blasts with fine dark cytoplasmic granules, suggestive of basophilic differentiation
One blast with a smooth rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm and small nuclear vacuole
Irregular, folded nuclear contour in the left-hand blast
Smudged cell debris at upper right and red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis
2322.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of four large blasts with fine chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm; several contain fine dark cytoplasmic granules suggestive of basophilic differentiation, while one is agranular. Smudged cell debris and red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis are present. Findings are consistent with blast phase of CML, BCR-ABL1-positive, possibly with basophilic features; flow cytometry and cytochemistry can clarify lineage.

ddx.vs: Blasts with basophilic granules without a CML history or BCR-ABL1 favor this rare de novo entity.
Mast cells have round/oval nuclei with evenly distributed metachromatic granules, express CD117 and tryptase, and carry KIT D816V rather than BCR-ABL1.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei, dense azurophilic granules and Auer rods with PML::RARA, rather than fine dark basophilic granules.

2194.recognize_zh: 低倍下皮下脂肪小葉被密集的淋巴樣細胞瀰漫浸潤，細胞填滿脂肪空泡之間形成蕾絲狀（lace-like）分布，屬小葉性脂膜炎型態，是皮下脂膜炎樣 T 細胞淋巴瘤的結構線索。
features: Lobular pattern of involvement of subcutaneous fat
Dense lymphoid infiltrate filling spaces between adipocytes in a lace-like pattern
Relative sparing of septa with no discrete nodules or follicles
Individual cell cytology not assessable at this low magnification
No overlying dermis or epidermis included in this field
2194.describe_en: Low-power sections of subcutaneous adipose tissue show a diffuse, predominantly lobular lymphoid infiltrate that fills the spaces between adipocytes in a lace-like pattern. No lymphoid follicles or discrete nodules are identified, and the dermis is not represented in this field. Cytologic atypia and adipocyte rimming require higher magnification. The architecture is that of a lobular panniculitis-like infiltrate and, with appropriate cytology and a CD8+ TCR-alpha/beta cytotoxic phenotype, is consistent with subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Lupus profundus often shows lymphoid follicles with germinal centers, plasma cells, hyalinized fat necrosis and overlying interface dermatitis.
Erythema nodosum centers on thickened fibrous septa with Miescher granulomas rather than a dense lobular lymphoid infiltrate.
PCGD-TCL frequently extends into dermis and epidermis and is TCR-gamma positive, which requires IHC to separate.

2066.recognize_zh: 中低倍 H&E 下，被膜下方一大片深藍色、密集的腫瘤細胞中，均勻散布著淡染的組織球（tingible-body macrophages），形成「星空」（starry-sky）樣外觀，是 Burkitt 淋巴瘤最常被考的低倍特徵。
features: Dense sheet of basophilic small-to-medium lymphoid cells beneath a thin fibrous capsule
Evenly distributed pale tingible-body macrophages with clear halos producing a starry-sky pattern
Starry-sky zone is sharply demarcated from a looser, mixed lymphoid zone at the bottom
High cellular density with little intervening stroma
Individual cytologic detail is limited at this magnification
2066.describe_en: Low-to-medium power section shows a dense, basophilic lymphoid proliferation beneath a thin capsule, with evenly scattered pale tingible-body macrophages creating a starry-sky pattern. The lesion is sharply demarcated from a looser mixed lymphoid population below. Nuclear detail cannot be fully evaluated at this magnification, and a starry-sky pattern alone is not specific. Findings are suggestive of Burkitt lymphoma in the appropriate context, requiring high-power cytology, Ki-67 and MYC studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers also contain tingible-body macrophages but are polarized, surrounded by a mantle zone, and composed of mixed centrocytes and centroblasts.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma can show a starry-sky pattern but has finer blastic chromatin and is TdT positive.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with high proliferation
ddx.vs: DLBCL may show a starry-sky pattern but has larger, more pleomorphic cells, BCL2 expression in many cases, and lacks the Burkitt immunophenotype.

exam.answer_en: Burkitt lymphoma (suggestive at this power) — dense basophilic sheet with evenly distributed tingible-body macrophages, starry-sky pattern
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍指著藍色背景中的淡色空洞問「這些白點是什麼細胞？形成什麼型態？」答：tingible-body macrophages 吞噬凋亡碎片，starry-sky pattern。
Starry sky 反映高增殖加高凋亡，不具特異性：lymphoblastic lymphoma、高增殖 DLBCL 也可見，必須再看高倍細胞學與 Ki-67（Burkitt 近 100%）。
確診三件事：CD10+/BCL6+/BCL2 陰性的 germinal center 表型、Ki-67 近 100%、FISH 證實 MYC 重排（最常 t(8;14)）且無 BCL2 重排。
臨床：成人 sporadic 型常以腹部（回盲部）腫塊表現，endemic 型與 EBV 及顎骨病灶相關；治療前要預防 tumor lysis syndrome。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 reactive germinal center 混淆：後者也有 tingible-body macrophages，但有 mantle zone、亮暗區極化且細胞混雜；Burkitt 為瀰漫單調片狀、無 mantle。

quiz.q: 圖中散布的淡染細胞是什麼？它們構成的低倍型態叫什麼？
quiz.a: Tingible-body macrophages；starry-sky pattern

1874.recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴球體積明顯變大，細胞質豐富、呈淡藍灰色且邊緣輕微被周圍紅血球擠壓變形，細胞核圓、染色質較疏鬆而無明顯核仁，符合反應性（非典型）淋巴球。
features: Large lymphocyte, about two to three times the diameter of a red cell
Lower N:C ratio with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Round nucleus with moderately condensed but slightly open chromatin; no prominent nucleolus
Cytoplasmic border molded by adjacent red cells with slightly darker periphery
No cytoplasmic granules or vacuoles
1874.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with a round nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli, and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm whose border is molded by adjacent erythrocytes. There are no granules or vacuoles. Surrounding red cells show mild variation in shape, including a teardrop form. Findings are consistent with a reactive (atypical) lymphocyte, as seen in viral infections such as infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Blasts have fine, homogeneous chromatin with nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, whereas reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm and more mature chromatin.
Monocytes have folded or lobulated nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray cytoplasm containing fine granules and vacuoles.
Plasma cells have an eccentric nucleus with clock-face chromatin, deep blue cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof.
Lymphoma cells form a monomorphic population with nuclear irregularity and a clonal immunophenotype, whereas reactive lymphocytes show a heterogeneous spectrum of sizes and shapes.

exam.answer_en: Reactive (atypical) lymphocyte — large lymphocyte with abundant pale blue cytoplasm molded around adjacent red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指著大淋巴球問「細胞質邊緣被紅血球擠壓的特徵叫什麼？代表什麼？」答：cytoplasmic molding／scalloping，典型 reactive lymphocyte（Downey type II）。
最常見原因：EBV infectious mononucleosis；其他如 CMV、急性 HIV、病毒性肝炎、Toxoplasma、藥物反應。反應性淋巴球主要為活化的 CD8+ T 細胞。
IM 確診：heterophile antibody（Monospot）或 EBV VCA IgM；兒童早期 heterophile 可偽陰性。
良性判讀依據：細胞大小與形態呈多樣光譜，與同片正常淋巴球連續；若為單一形態異常族群，應以 flow 排除淋巴瘤或白血病。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 monocyte 或 lymphoblast：單核球核折疊、細胞質灰色有細顆粒與空泡；lymphoblast 染色質細緻有核仁且細胞質極少。反應性淋巴球核染色質較成熟、細胞質豐富。

quiz.q: 此細胞在感染性單核球症中，主要屬於哪一種淋巴球亞群？
quiz.a: 活化的 CD8+ cytotoxic T cells

1618.recognize_zh: Giemsa 染色下同一視野可見三區：右側為核大、染色質開放並有核分裂的生發中心大細胞，中間是一條密集深染小淋巴球帶（外套區），左側為較疏鬆的小淋巴球與內皮細胞區，呈現反應性濾泡的分區。
features: Right: large cells with vesicular nuclei, visible nucleoli and a mitotic figure (germinal center centroblasts)
Center: band of densely packed small round lymphocytes with dark chromatin (mantle zone)
Left: looser zone of small lymphocytes with pale cytoplasm and scattered endothelial/stromal cells
Occasional cells with plasmacytoid features and moderate cytoplasm
Clear zonation between compartments without a monotonous infiltrate
1618.describe_en: Giemsa-stained section of lymph node at high power shows the edge of a reactive follicle. On the right, the germinal center contains large cells with vesicular nuclei, nucleoli and mitotic activity; this is bordered by a dense band of small dark lymphocytes representing the mantle zone, and on the left by a looser zone of small lymphocytes and stromal cells. The zonation is preserved without cytologic atypia. Findings are consistent with a normal secondary follicle showing germinal center, mantle and outer zones.

ddx.vs: FL follicles show attenuated or absent mantles and a monotonous centrocyte-rich population without zonation, and are BCL2 positive.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL expands the mantle zone with slightly irregular cyclin D1-positive cells around naked germinal centers, rather than the thin normal mantle seen here.

1490.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量很高，許多中型細胞核呈腎形、摺疊或凹陷（monocytoid），胞質淡嗜伊紅，夾雜分葉的顆粒球與深染的紅系前驅細胞，呈現 CMML 中單核球與顆粒球共同增生的混合樣貌。
features: Hypercellular marrow with markedly reduced fat
Numerous medium-sized cells with oval, reniform or folded nuclei and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (monocytic cells)
Admixed maturing granulocytes with band and segmented nuclei
Scattered small cells with round dense nuclei consistent with erythroid precursors
Some cells with open chromatin and small nucleoli; no discrete sheets of blasts
Megakaryocytes not prominent in this field
1490.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section (H&E) shows a markedly hypercellular marrow. There is a proliferation of medium-sized cells with oval, reniform to folded nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm, consistent with monocytic cells, admixed with maturing granulocytes and scattered erythroid precursors. No sheets of blasts are identified, although promonocytes cannot be reliably distinguished on H&E. Findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical context (persistent peripheral monocytosis); CD14/CD68R/CD163 and CD34 immunostains help quantify monocytes and blasts.

ddx.vs: Requires >=20% blasts plus promonocytes, which appear as sheets of immature cells with fine chromatin and nucleoli rather than a maturing mixed infiltrate.
CML shows granulocytic hyperplasia with small hypolobated megakaryocytes and basophilia, and is defined by BCR-ABL1.
Reactive marrow lacks dysplasia and clonal markers (e.g., TET2, SRSF2, ASXL1) and the monocytosis resolves.
aCML has dysgranulopoiesis with <10% monocytes in blood, whereas CMML requires monocytes >=10% of leukocytes and absolute monocytosis.

60306.recognize_zh: 在大致正常的紅血球之間，可見少數小而染色較深、有直線切緣或尖角的紅血球碎片，以及一側被切平的頭盔狀細胞（helmet cells），符合裂紅血球（schistocytes）。
features: Scattered small, dense red cell fragments with straight edges and angular points
Occasional helmet-shaped cells with one flattened, cut border
Fragments are fewer than intact cells; most red cells are normocytic discocytes with central pallor
Platelets appear sparse in this field
No agglutination, nucleated red cells or leukocytes seen
60306.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mostly normocytic, normochromic red cells with scattered schistocytes, including small angular fragments and helmet-shaped cells with straight cut edges. Platelets appear sparse in the field. No spherocyte predominance, agglutination or inclusions are seen. Findings are consistent with schistocytes; a count of more than about 1% of red cells in an appropriate setting supports microangiopathic hemolytic anemia (TTP, HUS, DIC) or mechanical hemolysis, and should be correlated with platelet count and hemolysis markers.

ddx.vs: Bite cells are intact cells with a rounded bite-like defect, not small fragments with straight edges and sharp corners.
Artifact produces fragments mainly at the feathered edge or near crushed cells, whereas true schistocytes are distributed in the evaluable monolayer.
Microspherocytes are small but round and smooth-contoured, lacking the angular cut edges of schistocytes.

exam.answer_en: Schistocytes — small angular red cell fragments and helmet cells with straight cut edges among normocytic RBCs, platelets sparse
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指有直線切緣的小碎片問名稱，並追問「多少比例才有意義？要驗哪些溶血指標？」
ICSH 建議：schistocytes 超過約 1% 在適當臨床情境下支持 TMA；計數應在薄而分散區進行。
溶血指標：LDH 升高、haptoglobin 降低、indirect bilirubin 升高、reticulocytosis、DAT 陰性（非免疫性）。
PLASMIC score 可用於估計 severe ADAMTS13 deficiency（TTP）的可能性，高分者應盡速 plasma exchange。
機械性溶血原因：人工瓣膜或瓣周漏、LVAD、march hemoglobinuria；DIC 則合併凝血時間延長與 fibrinogen 下降。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與推片假性碎裂或 microspherocyte 混淆：假影碎片常集中於抹片尾端；microspherocyte 為圓形無切緣。真正 schistocyte 有直線切緣或尖角。

quiz.q: 圖中碎片狀紅血球叫什麼？ICSH 建議超過約多少比例時在臨床情境下支持 TMA？
quiz.a: Schistocytes；約 >1%

146.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有大量中至大型母細胞，染色質細緻、核形不規則，細胞質灰藍色、無顆粒，部分於細胞膜下可見小空泡或偽足樣突起；切片瀰漫浸潤，免疫染色 CD56、CD123、CD4、TCL1 共同陽性，符合母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）。
features: Bone marrow aspirate: numerous medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, irregular to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Blast cytoplasm moderate, grey-blue and agranular, some with small peripheral vacuoles or tail-like cytoplasmic projections (arrows)
Residual maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes admixed
Core biopsy: hypercellular marrow for age with interstitial-to-diffuse sheets of blasts between fat; high power shows irregular, folded nuclei with fine chromatin and frequent mitoses
IHC: blasts coexpress CD56, CD123, CD4 and TCL1, with a CD123/TCL1-negative residual lymphoid aggregate
146.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate shows numerous medium-to-large blasts with irregular or indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate agranular grey-blue cytoplasm, some with small cytoplasmic vacuoles or tail-like projections; residual trilineage elements are present. The core biopsy is hypercellular with interstitial and sheet-like infiltration by atypical cells with folded nuclei, fine chromatin, and frequent mitotic figures. By immunohistochemistry the neoplastic cells coexpress CD56, CD123, CD4, and TCL1, while a residual lymphoid aggregate is negative for CD123 and TCL1. Findings are consistent with involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (CD4+/CD56+)
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML can express CD4 and CD56 but usually shows MPO/lysozyme/CD14/CD11c and lacks the coexpression of bright CD123, TCL1 and CD303 seen here.

ddx.dx: AML with increased mature plasmacytoid dendritic cells (pDC-AML)
ddx.vs: In pDC-AML the pDCs are CD34-negative, CD56-negative mature-appearing cells accompanying a separate CD34+ myeloid blast population, whereas here the CD56+ CD123+ TCL1+ blasts themselves constitute the neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma or NK-lymphoblastic leukemia
ddx.vs: NK neoplasms are CD56-positive but negative for CD123, TCL1 and CD4, and NK/T-cell lymphoma is EBER-positive.
Lymphoblastic leukemias express TdT with cytoplasmic CD3 or CD19/PAX5 and lack the CD4/CD56/CD123/TCL1 plasmacytoid dendritic cell profile.

146.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD56, CD123, CD4, TCL1
captions: Bone marrow aspirate: numerous blasts with agranular grey-blue cytoplasm among residual hematopoietic cells (arrow)
Bone marrow aspirate, high power: blast with fine chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm (arrow)
Core biopsy H&E, low power: hypercellular marrow with interstitial blast infiltration
Core biopsy H&E, high power: sheets of blasts with irregular folded nuclei and mitoses
IHC: tumor cells positive for CD56, CD123, CD4 and TCL1

exam.answer_en: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm involving marrow — agranular blasts with peripheral vacuoles/pseudopods, CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCL1+
pearls_zh: 考法：看起來像無顆粒的 AML 芽細胞，考官會指細胞膜下小空泡或尾狀突起，再給 IHC 要你說出 CD4/CD56/CD123 共表現的診斷。
BPDCN 除 CD4、CD56、CD123 外，TCL1、TCF4、CD303（BDCA-2）有助確認；MPO、lysozyme、CD3、CD19 應陰性。
典型臨床：老年男性、瘀青樣紫色皮膚結節，之後侵犯骨髓、血液；病程侵襲，常見 TET2 等突變。
治療可用 CD123 標靶的 tagraxofusp，或 ALL 型化療，年輕適合者以異體移植鞏固；中樞神經侵犯需預防。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤判為單核球分化 AML（也可 CD4+、CD56+、CD123+）；AML 常 lysozyme/CD14/CD11c 陽性，BPDCN 則 TCL1 與 CD303 陽性。

quiz.q: 此芽細胞共表現哪四個 IHC 標記可支持 BPDCN？
quiz.a: CD4、CD56、CD123、TCL1

82.recognize_zh: 穿刺切片中一大片體積大、多形性的細胞，細胞質豐富且嗜酸性，核呈卵圓或腎形，偶見奇異巨核與多核細胞；IHC 呈顆粒狀細胞質染色（CD68 型）與強細胞質染色（組織球標記型），加上 PET-CT 顯示腸繫膜與後腹膜淋巴結 FDG 高攝取，符合組織球肉瘤（histiocytic sarcoma）。
features: Sheets of large, discohesive, pleomorphic cells effacing the sampled tissue, forming a solid nodule at low power with adjacent adipose tissue
Abundant eosinophilic, finely vacuolated to glassy cytoplasm with well-defined cell borders
Oval, reniform to folded vesicular nuclei with small distinct nucleoli; scattered bizarre hyperchromatic and multinucleated giant cells
Admixed small inflammatory cells in the background
IHC: diffuse granular cytoplasmic staining (CD68-like pattern) and strong diffuse cytoplasmic/membranous staining (histiocytic marker pattern) in the large cells
IHC: strong nuclear positivity in most tumor nuclei (antibody not labeled)
82.describe_en: Coronal PET-CT shows multiple FDG-avid mesenteric and retroperitoneal lymph nodes (arrows). The percutaneous core biopsy shows a solid proliferation of large, pleomorphic, discohesive cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, oval to reniform vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli, and scattered bizarre and multinucleated tumor giant cells, admixed with small inflammatory cells. By immunohistochemistry, the neoplastic cells show diffuse granular cytoplasmic staining and strong diffuse cytoplasmic staining in patterns typical of histiocytic markers (e.g., CD68, CD163), and a nuclear marker is positive in most tumor nuclei; the individual antibodies are not labeled in the figure. Myeloid (MPO, CD34), dendritic cell (S100, CD1a, langerin), lymphoid and epithelial markers are required to exclude mimics but are not shown. Findings are consistent with histiocytic sarcoma, possibly clonally related to the prior B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Myeloid sarcoma consists of more monotonous blasts with finer chromatin and scant cytoplasm and usually expresses CD34, CD117, MPO or lysozyme with CD43, whereas histiocytic sarcoma shows mature-appearing abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, CD163 positivity and lacks blast markers.
ALCL has hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei, sinusoidal growth and strong uniform CD30 (often ALK) with T-cell antigens, while histiocytic sarcoma is CD30-negative or weak and CD163/CD68-positive.

ddx.dx: Langerhans cell sarcoma / interdigitating dendritic cell sarcoma
ddx.vs: These express S100 (plus CD1a and langerin in Langerhans cell sarcoma) and often show grooved nuclei, whereas histiocytic sarcoma is S100-negative or focal and CD1a/langerin-negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic poorly differentiated carcinoma or melanoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma shows cohesive nests with keratin positivity and melanoma expresses S100, SOX10 and HMB45, whereas histiocytic sarcoma is discohesive and negative for these but positive for CD163 and lysozyme.

82.stain: PET-CT; H&E; IHC (unlabeled histiocytic and nuclear markers)
captions: Coronal PET-CT: multiple FDG-avid mesenteric and retroperitoneal lymph nodes (arrows)
H&E low power: core biopsy with a solid nodule of large eosinophilic cells and adjacent adipose tissue
H&E high power: large pleomorphic cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and bizarre multinucleated forms
IHC: diffuse granular cytoplasmic staining of tumor cells (CD68-like pattern)
IHC: strong diffuse cytoplasmic staining of large tumor cells (histiocytic marker pattern)
IHC: strong nuclear positivity in most tumor nuclei (antibody not labeled)

18.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片與切片幾乎全為脂肪、造血細胞稀少且無芽細胞增加；端粒長度流式圖中各族群數值點都落在第 1 百分位紅線以下，提示先天性端粒疾病（dyskeratosis congenita）。
features: Aspirate particles composed predominantly of fat spaces with sparse hematopoietic cells
Aspirate smear is hemodilute with few scattered nucleated cells and no increase in blasts
Core biopsy markedly hypocellular (<10%) with fat replacement and scattered small lymphocytes, red cells and rare hematopoietic precursors
No infiltrate, fibrosis or dysplastic clusters evident at this magnification
Telomere flow-FISH: median telomere length below the 1st percentile for age in lymphocytes, granulocytes, naive/memory T, B and NK cells
18.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears contain hypocellular, fat-rich particles and a hemodilute background with only scattered nucleated cells; blasts are not increased. The core biopsy is markedly hypocellular (<10%), consisting mostly of adipocytes with interstitial red cells, small lymphocytes and rare trilineage precursors, without an abnormal infiltrate. Telomere length analysis by flow-FISH shows very low (<1st percentile for age) telomere length in all leukocyte subsets tested. In the setting of a TERC mutation and family history of AML and cytopenia, findings are consistent with dyskeratosis congenita (telomere biology disorder) with marrow failure.

ddx.vs: The marrow looks identical, so separation relies on telomere length (usually normal or only mildly short) and absence of a germline TERC/TERT mutation or family history.
Also a hypocellular inherited marrow failure, but it is diagnosed by increased chromosomal breakage with DEB/MMC rather than very short telomeres.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular myelodysplastic syndrome / refractory cytopenia of childhood
ddx.vs: Shows dysplastic megakaryocytes or erythroid islands and often clonal cytogenetics such as monosomy 7, which are not seen here.
Hypocellular marrow with neutropenia but with pancreatic insufficiency and SBDS mutation, and telomeres are not in the very low range.

captions: Bone marrow aspirate particle, low power: fat-predominant, hypocellular particle
Bone marrow aspirate smear: hemodilute with sparse nucleated cells
Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E): markedly hypocellular fatty marrow
Telomere length by flow-FISH: all subsets below the 1st percentile for age

63762.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片四格免疫染色：大片小淋巴球 CD20 陽性，CD3 只有散在少數 T 細胞，但 CD5 的陽性範圍與 CD20 相當、遠多於 CD3，表示 B 細胞異常表現 CD5；cyclin D1 陰性，排除被套細胞淋巴瘤，符合 CLL/SLL。
features: Bone marrow core with an extensive interstitial to diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells between fat spaces
CD20: strong staining of the majority of infiltrating lymphocytes
CD3: only scattered small background T cells
CD5: staining extent similar to CD20 and far exceeding CD3, indicating CD5 co-expression on B cells
Cyclin D1: negative in the lymphoid infiltrate
63762.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows an extensive interstitial and diffuse infiltrate of small lymphocytes. Immunohistochemistry shows that the infiltrate consists predominantly of CD20-positive B cells with only scattered CD3-positive T cells. CD5 stains a population comparable in extent to CD20 and much larger than the CD3-positive population, indicating aberrant CD5 expression by the B cells, while cyclin D1 is negative. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (CD23 and LEF1 would further support the diagnosis).

ddx.vs: MCL is also CD20+/CD5+ but shows nuclear cyclin D1 (and SOX11) positivity, which is absent here.
Marginal zone lymphoma is usually CD5-negative, so CD5 staining would parallel CD3 rather than CD20.
LPL is typically CD5-negative with a plasmacytoid/plasma cell component (CD138, light chain restriction) and MYD88 L265P mutation.
Reactive aggregates are small, well circumscribed, paratrabecular-sparing with a mixture of CD3+ T cells and CD20+ B cells and no CD5 on B cells.

63762.stain: IHC: CD20, CD3, CD5, cyclin D1

exam.answer_en: CLL/SLL involving marrow — CD20+ B cells with aberrant CD5 co-expression (CD5 extent ≈ CD20 ≫ CD3), cyclin D1 negative
pearls_zh: 考法：比較 CD5 與 CD3 的陽性數量——CD5 陽性細胞遠多於 CD3，代表 B 細胞異常共表現 CD5。
CLL 流式：CD5+、CD23+、CD200+、sIg 與 CD20 弱、FMC7−、CD79b 弱；Matutes score 4–5 支持 CLL。
診斷門檻：周邊單株 B 細胞 ≥5×10^9/L；低於此且無淋巴結腫大等表現為 MBL；以淋巴結為主則為 SLL。
del(17p)/TP53 突變與 IGHV unmutated 預後較差，影響 BTK inhibitor 或 venetoclax 方案的選擇。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 mantle cell lymphoma（同為 CD5+）；MCL cyclin D1+、SOX11+、CD23 常陰性，CLL 則 cyclin D1−、CD23+、LEF1+。

quiz.q: 為何 CD5 陽性細胞遠多於 CD3 陽性細胞代表異常？
quiz.a: CD5 正常主要在 T 細胞；多出的 CD5+ 細胞為共表現 CD5 的腫瘤性 B 細胞

62034.recognize_zh: 中倍免疫染色（紅色膜狀呈色，標記未註明，分布像 B 細胞標記）顯示左上區域大多陰性、只有散在陽性細胞，右下則由密集成片、體積較大的膜狀陽性細胞佔據，兩區界線清楚；在 NLPHL 病例中，大片陽性的大細胞提示向瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤進展，但需對照 H&E 與其他標記。
features: Sharp interface between a largely negative area (upper left) and a dense sheet of positive cells (lower right)
Strong membranous red staining in confluent sheets of medium to large cells
Scattered individual positive cells within the negative zone
Delicate vascular channels traversing the positive sheet
Marker identity not labeled; cytologic detail limited at this magnification
62034.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain with a red chromogen (marker not specified on the image) shows a sharply demarcated, confluent sheet of medium to large cells with strong membranous positivity occupying most of the field, adjacent to an area composed of negative small cells containing only scattered positive cells. The sheet-like, diffuse distribution of positive larger cells differs from the scattered single LP cells expected in classic nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma. If this marker represents a B-cell antigen such as CD20, the pattern supports a diffuse large B-cell component; in the reported context, the findings are suggestive of NLPHL with progression to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, pending correlation with H&E and the full panel.

ddx.vs: Classic NLPHL nodules are CD20-positive meshworks of small B cells with scattered LP cells, rather than confluent sheets of large positive cells without small-cell nodularity.
THRLBCL has only scattered single large B cells in a T-cell/histiocyte background, not confluent sheets of positive large cells.
Reactive follicles form round CD20-positive nodules with germinal centers and mantle zones separated by CD20-negative T-zones, rather than a diffuse sheet of large positive cells.

ddx.dx: De novo diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphology of the sheet is similar, so recognition of residual NLPHL nodules with LP cells in the same specimen is required to classify it as transformation.
